english: [Health Protocols] Comprehensive COVID-19 health and safety protocols for school reopening including mandatory masks and temperature monitoring
ekegusii: [Amachiko Obochenu] Ase oboikeranu amachiko obochenu igoro yendwari Yenyamayaa (COVID-19) ase chisukuru koigora amo nogochika kobeka ebitambaa biogotuma emenwa nechiomioro na gopima ribera ase omobere

dholuo: Chenro mag thieth: Chenro mag thieth kod ritruok kuom COVID-19 ma oriwo tiyo gi maske kod ng'iyo chal mar liet e kinde ma skul chako tiyo kendo

english: [Kenya Education Cloud] Digital learning platform providing free educational content during COVID-19 pandemic for remote learning continuity

dholuo: Kenya Education Cloud: Ohinga mar somo mar dijitol ma chiwo weche mag somo maonge chudo e kinde mag tuo mar COVID-19 mondo ji opuonjre mabor
somali: [Kenya Education Cloud] Barashada dhijitaalka ah ee bixisa waxyaabaha waxbarasho ee bilaashka ah inta lagu jiro masiibada COVID-19 si loo sii wado barashada fog

english: [KUCCPS Portal] KUCCPS portal will open in March 2025 for university placement and course selection for 2024 KCSE candidates
ekegusii: [Eintaneti yekeombe keria ekenen gekorangeria abana gochia eyunifasisiti nechikorechi (KUCCP) neigoro omotienyi ogatato omwaka 2025 noigore ase abana beyunifasity na gochora chikosi chiabo ase abana baria barigete amatemwa abo esekondari 2024

dholuo: KUCCPS Portal: KUCCPS portal biro yawore e dwe mar Mach higa mar 2025 mar keto ji e yunivasiti kod yiero jopuonjre mag KCSE e higa mar 2024

english: [School Feeding Scale-up] Target to increase school feeding beneficiaries from 1.9 million to over 10 million children by 2030

english: [Special Needs Education] Launch of inclusive education programs with assistive technology for learners with disabilities
ekegusii: [Chisemi ase baria abaremaru] Omoroberio bwogochaka chisemi ase bonsi goetera ebinto biria bogokonya emeuko, amatino na amamama ochakirwe ase abaremaru abwo bonsi

english: EACC campaigns to encourage anonymous reporting of corruption cases.

kiswahili: EACC inafanya kampeni za kuhamasisha kuripoti visa vya ufisadi bila majina.
dholuo: EACC timo kampen mar jiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e wi weche mag mibadhi e yo ma onge ng'at ma ong'eyo.
somali: EACC waxay ololeyn ku sameyneysaa inay dhiirrigeliso warbixinta aan la aqoon ee kiisaska musuqmaasuqa.

english: EACC forms school clubs to nurture anti-corruption values.
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboikeranu na gotanga obokurumi (EACC) nkorosia bare ebiombe chisukuru erio gokong'ia values.
kiswahili: EACC huunda vilabu vya shule ili kukuza maadili ya kupambana na ufisadi.
dholuo: EACC loso club mag skunde mondo gijiw timbe mag kedo gi mibadhi.
somali: EACC waxay samaysaa kooxaha dugsiyada si ay u kobciyaan qiimaha la dagaalanka musuqmaasuqa.

english: EACC introduces a mobile app for easy reporting of corruption.
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboikeranu na gotanga obokurumi (EACC) kiabekire emeroberio emiororo erio gokemanyia obokurumi.
kiswahili: EACC inaanzisha programu ya simu kwa ajili ya kurahisisha kuripoti ufisadi.
dholuo: EACC chako tiyo gi app mar simo mondo okony e chiwo ripot mayot e wi mibadhi.
somali: EACC waxay soo bandhigtay barnaamij mobile ah oo si fudud loogu soo sheegayo musuqmaasuqa.

english: EACC introduces multiple reporting channels for whistleblowers.
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboikeranu na gotanga obokurumi (EACC) kiarure omoroberio ase abaaki enangi gokemanyia amang'ana.
kiswahili: EACC inaanzisha njia nyingi za kuripoti kwa wafichuzi.
dholuo: EACC kelo yore mang'eny mag chiwo ripot ne joma chiwo ripot.
somali: EACC waxay soo bandhigeysaa kanaalo badan oo warbixinta ah oo loogu talagalay kuwa soo sheega.

english: EACC sensitizes citizens on reporting corruption through county forums.
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboikeranu na gotanga obokurumi (EACC) ngosomia kere abanainchi buna babwenerete gokemanyia obokurumi goetera ebikaranso biekaonti.
kiswahili: EACC inahamasisha raia kuhusu kuripoti ufisadi kupitia majukwaa ya kaunti.
dholuo: EACC konyo jopiny ng'eyo kaka ginyalo chiwo ripot mag mibadhi kokalo kuom forum mag kaunti.
somali: EACC waxay shacabka u wacyi gelineysaa warbixinta musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo golaha gobolka.

english: EACC supports local offices to prevent misuse of public funds.
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboikeranu na gotanga obokurumi (EACC) ngosira kere chiofisi chia inse gotanga gotumia bobe chibesa chieserikari.
kiswahili: EACC inasaidia ofisi za mitaa kuzuia matumizi mabaya ya fedha za umma.
dholuo: EACC konyo ofise mag sirkal e geng'o tiyo marach gi pesa mag sirkal.
somali: EACC waxay taageertaa xafiisyada deegaanka si looga hortago isticmaalka xad-dhaafka ah ee lacagaha dadweynaha.

english: Educate communities! Teach banditry prevention near schools.
ekegusii: Somia ebinyoro! Somia igoro yogotanga obokebago bwokoboera abanto na kobaunereria gose kobabisa erio baegwe chibesa, ang'e nesukuru.
kiswahili: Elimisha jamii! Fundisha kuzuia ujambazi karibu na shule.
dholuo: Puonj ji! Puonj ji kaka ginyalo geng'o timbe mag mahundu ka gin machiegni gi skunde.
somali: Waxbarashada bulshooyinka! Waxbarashada ka hortagga tuugada dugsiyada ku dhow.

english: Educate girls! Teach about FGM risks in schools.
ekegusii: Somia abana abanyaroka! Basomie igoro yobobe bwokobasara (FGM) na buna gokorenta emechando ase ogosoma kwabo.
kiswahili: Elimisha wasichana! Fundisha kuhusu hatari za ukeketaji shuleni.
dholuo: Puonj nyithindo ma nyiri! Puonj e wi hinyruok mabedoe nikech ng'olo dhako e obwong'o.
somali: Gabdhaha baro, iskuulada wax ka baro khatarta FGM.

english: Educate students! Teach fire safety in schools.
ekegusii: Somia abana! Basomie buna babwenerete kwerenda ase emerero.
kiswahili: Elimisha wanafunzi! Fundisha usalama wa moto shuleni.
dholuo: Puonj nyithindo! Puonjuru nyithindo e wi geng'o masira mar mach.
somali: Waxbarashada ardayda! Waxbarashada badbaadada dabka ee dugsiyada.

english: Educate students! Teach flood safety in schools.
ekegusii: Somia abana! Basomie igoro yetoigo ase esukuru.
kiswahili: Elimisha wanafunzi! Fundisha usalama wa mafuriko shuleni.
dholuo: Puonj nyithindo! Puonj ji e wi geng'o ataro e skunde.
somali: Waxbarashada ardayda! Waxbarashada badbaadada fatahaadaha dugsiyada.

english: Educate students! Teach protest safety in schools.
ekegusii: Somia abana! Basomie enchera yokwerenda ekero kiamaandamano esukuru.
kiswahili: Elimisha wanafunzi! Fundisha usalama wa maandamano shuleni.
dholuo: Puonj nyithindo! Puonj ji e wi ritruok sama itimo nyasi moro e skul.
somali: Waxbarashada ardayda! Waxbaridda badbaadada banaanbaxyada dugsiyada.

english: Educate students! Teach terror prevention in schools.
ekegusii: Somia abana! Basomie igoro buna babwenerete gotanga obokebago bwechibunduki nechibomu.
kiswahili: Elimisha wanafunzi! Fundisha kuzuia ugaidi shuleni.
dholuo: Puonj nyithindo! Puonj ji kaka ginyalo geng'o timbe mahundu e skul.
somali: Waxbarashada ardayda! Waxbarashada ka hortagga argagixisada dugsiyada.

english: Educate teachers! Teach landslide safety in schools.
ekegusii: Somia abarimu! Somia igoro yokwerenda ase okoanyoka kweriroba chisukuru.
kiswahili: Elimisha walimu! Fundisha usalama wa maporomoko ya ardhi shuleni.
dholuo: Puonjuru jopuonj! Puonj ji e wi geng'o yiengni mag lowo e skunde.
somali: Waxbarashada macallimiinta! Waxbaridda badbaadada dhulgariirka dugsiyada.

english: Education Cabinet Secretary George Magoha outlined eight critical measures for schools resuming classes—targeted initially at Grades 4, Class?8, and Form?4.
ekegusii: Omominisita bwechisemi George Magoha akabara ebinto 8 biengencho birakonye chisukuru gotairanera ebirasi, orengete abana ba gredi 4, 8, nesekenderi ekerasi gia 4?.
kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu George Magoha alielezea hatua nane muhimu kwa shule zinazoanza tena madarasa - zilizolengwa awali katika Darasa la 4, Darasa la 8, na Kidato cha 4.
dholuo: Secretary mar Education Cabinet, George Magoha ne oketo okenge aboro madongo mag duoko somo e skunde - kochakore e klas mar 4, Class? 8, kod Form? 4.
somali: Xoghayaha Golaha Wasiirada ee Waxbarashada George Magoha ayaa soo bandhigay sideed tallaabo oo muhiim ah oo loogu talagalay dugsiyada dib u bilaabanaya fasallada markii hore loogu talagalay fasallada 4, fasalka 8, iyo Form 4.

english: Education Chief Administrative Secretary Zac Kinuthia announced that journalists seeking to cover school-related stories must now obtain prior clearance from the Ministry of Education.
ekegusii: Omoriki omonene bwechisemi Zac Kinuthia akamanyia ng'a abariki amang'ana korika amangana abwatekaine nechisukuru bono goika barigie ogwancherwa korwa eministiri yechisemi nyuma batarika amang'ana ayio.
kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Utawala wa Elimu Zac Kinuthia alitangaza kwamba waandishi wa habari wanaotaka kuripoti habari zinazohusiana na shule lazima sasa wapate kibali cha awali kutoka Wizara ya Elimu.
dholuo: Jatend migao mar weche somo Zac Kinuthia ne olando ni jofwambo madwaro ndiko weche motudore gi skul koro nyaka yud thuolo motelo koa kuom migao mar weche somo.
somali: Xoghayaha Guud ee Maamulka Waxbarashada Zac Kinuthia ayaa ku dhawaaqay in weriyayaasha doonaya in ay daboolaan wararka iskuulka la xiriira ay hadda u baahan yihiin inay ka helaan oggolaanshaha hore ee Wasaaradda Waxbarashada.

english: Education for all! Enroll in mobile schools in pastoralist regions.
ekegusii: Chisemi ase bonsi! Erike ase omoroberio bwogosoma goetera chisimi giose chikombiuta ase abatugi bari bakong'anyang'anya.
kiswahili: Elimu kwa wote! Jiandikishe katika shule zinazohamishika katika maeneo ya wafugaji.
dholuo: Puonjruok ne ji duto! Dhi e skunde mitimo e gwenge ma ji ok odakie ahinya.
somali: Waxbarashada dadka oo dhan! Isku qor dugsiyada dhaqdhaqaaqa ee gobollada xoolaha.

english: Education for all! Join nomadic schools for pastoralist kids.
ekegusii: Chisemi ase bonsi! Soa chisukuru chiokonganyanganya ase abana abatugi bokonganyanganya.
kiswahili: Elimu kwa wote! Jiunge na shule za kuhamahama kwa watoto wafugaji.
dholuo: Puonjruok ne ji duto! Donj e skunde mag jowuoth ma nigi nyithindo modak e gwenge mosokore.
somali: Waxbarashada dadka oo dhan!

english: Eliminate school levies completely – CS orders nationwide crackdown!
ekegusii: Rusia chibango chionsi. Omominisita bwechisemi orure ogchika Kenya engima!
kiswahili: Ondoa kabisa ushuru wa shule CS yaamuru msako wa kitaifa!
dholuo: Golo osuru duto mag somo e skunde.
somali: Si buuxda u baabi'i kharashaadka dugsiyada. Amarrada CS ee dalka oo dhan!

english: Elimination of school levies: All public schools must comply with free education policy.
ekegusii: Rusia besa chinde chionsi chisukuru chogogosaba: Chisikuru chionsi chieserikari goika goika chiikeranie ayio erio goikerania ogochika gwechisemi chia bosa.
kiswahili: Kuondolewa kwa ada za shule: Shule zote za umma lazima zizingatie sera ya elimu bila malipo.
dholuo: Golo osuru mag somo: Skunde duto mag sirkal nyaka luw chike mag somo maonge chudo.
somali: Ka saarista kharashaadka dugsiga: Dhammaan dugsiyada dadweynaha waa inay raacaan siyaasadda waxbarashada bilaashka ah.

english: Empower girls! Provide scholarships to keep girls in school.
ekegusii: Kae abana abanyaroka chinguru! Bae chibesa chiogosomera chiabosa erio ebakonye gotigara esukuru.
kiswahili: Wawezeshe wasichana! Toa ufadhili wa masomo ili kuwaweka wasichana shuleni.
dholuo: Miyo nyiri teko! Chiw pesa ma konyo nyiri dhi nyime gi somo.
somali: Dhiirigelinta gabdhaha, deeq waxbarasho si ay gabdhaha iskuulka u sii joogaan.

english: Empower teachers! Provide training for modern teaching methods.
ekegusii: Kae abarimu chinguru! Bae kwegera igoro yogosomia gwechinchera chia bono.
kiswahili: Wawezeshe walimu! Toa mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za kufundisha.
dholuo: Miuru jopuonj teko! Chiw tiegruok kuom yore manyien mag puonjo.
somali: Xoojinta macalimiinta! Tababar u siiya hababka waxbarashada casriga ah.

english: Empower women! Enroll in vocational training for women.
ekegusii: Kae abang'ina chinguru! Erike ase chisemi chiokwegendereria.
kiswahili: Wawezeshe wanawake! Jiandikishe katika mafunzo ya ufundi stadi kwa wanawake.
dholuo: Mi mon teko! Donj e tiegruok mar somo mamalo ne joma mine.
somali: Xoojinta haweenka! Isku qor tababarka xirfadeed ee haweenka.

english: Encourage community involvement 2025.
ekegusii: Segeta ogokora emeremo amo nebinyoro2025.
kiswahili: Himiza ushiriki wa jamii 2025.
dholuo: Jiw bedo gi tudruok gi oganda e higa mar 2025.
somali: Ku dhiirigelinta ka qaybgalka bulshada 2025.

english: Encourage STEM enrollment for girls 2022.
ekegusii: Segetae abana abanyaroka gosomera emeremo yegesansi, chisabu, egetekinorochia nobobundi (STEM) 2022.
kiswahili: Himiza uandikishaji wa STEM kwa wasichana 2022.
dholuo: Jiw somo mar STEM ne nyiri e higa 2022.
somali: Ku dhiirigelinta diiwaangelinta STEM ee gabdhaha 2022.

english: Encourage vocational subjects 2025.
ekegusii: Segeta gosomera chisemi chiokwegendereria 2025.
kiswahili: Himiza masomo ya ufundi stadi 2025.
dholuo: Jiw somo mar somo mamalo e higa 2025.
somali: Ku dhiirigelinta maadooyinka xirfadeed ee 2025.

english: Enforce attendance policies 2023.
ekegusii: Ikerania amachiko igoro yogoikerania 2023.
kiswahili: Timiza sera za mahudhurio 2023.
dholuo: Tiuru gi chike mag dhi e chokruok 2023.
somali: Hirgelinta siyaasadaha ka qaybgalka sanadka 2023.

english: Enforce code of conduct 2023.
ekegusii: Ikerania amachiko emeremo nobokoreri 2023.
kiswahili: Timiza kanuni za maadili 2023.
dholuo: Ket chike mag timbe kod chike mag yiero e higa mar 2023.
somali: Adeegsiga xeerka anshaxa 2023.

english: Engage students! Create forums to address unrest.
ekegusii: Bwaterana nabana! Rosia ribaga riogokwanerana igoro yamangana abachandete.
kiswahili: Washirikishe wanafunzi! Unda majukwaa ya kushughulikia machafuko.
dholuo: Konyuru jopuonjre! Los kuonde ma ji nyalo goyo mbaka e wi weche ma chando ji.
somali: Isku dar ardayda! Abuur goobo lagu hadlo rabshadaha.

english: Enhance library services 2024.
ekegusii: Angoyia emeroberio yechinyomba chiogosomera omwaka 2024.
kiswahili: Boresha huduma za maktaba 2024.
dholuo: Med lony e tije mag laibrari 2024.
somali: Hagaajinta adeegyada maktabadaha sanadka 2024.

english: Enroll now! Free primary education for all Kenyan children.
ekegusii: Erike bono! Amasomo abosa ase abana bechisukuru chioboroso.
kiswahili: Jiandikishe sasa! Elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa watoto wote wa Kenya.
dholuo: Ndikri sani! Nyithindo duto ma Jo Kenya yudo somo mar praimari maonge chudo.
somali: Waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee carruurta Kenya.

english: Ensure access to education during COVID 2020.
ekegusii: Tema goikera chisemi chingaki chiendwari ya COVID 2020.
kiswahili: Hakikisha upatikanaji wa elimu wakati wa COVID 2020.
dholuo: Neno ni ji oyudo somo e kinde mar COVID 2020.
somali: Si loo hubiyo helitaanka waxbarashada inta lagu jiro COVID 2020.

english: Ensure access! Provide digital platforms for all students.
ekegusii: Tema goikera! Karwe omoroberio bwegedichitari ase abana bonsi.
kiswahili: Hakikisha upatikanaji! Toa majukwaa ya kidijitali kwa wanafunzi wote.
dholuo: Beduru motang' mondo kik udonj! Miyo jopuonjre duto thuolo mar tiyo gi intanet.
somali: Hubi helitaanka, bixinta barnaamijyo dhijitaal ah oo loogu talagalay ardayda oo dhan.

english: Ensure all learners wear uniforms and carry IDs from January 6.
ekegusii: Rora nga abana bonsi mbagete chiyunifomu nakobogoria ebibande biabo korwa chitariki 6 chiomotienyi omotang'ani.
kiswahili: Hakikisha wanafunzi wote wanavaa sare na wana vitambulisho kuanzia Januari 6.
dholuo: Ne ni jopuonjre duto orwako yunifom kendo oting'o kad mar ng'eyo ng'ato chakre Januar 6.
somali: Hubi in ardayda oo dhan ay xirtaan dhar iyo aqoonsiyo laga bilaabo 6-da Janaayo.

english: Ensure clean water! Prevent cholera outbreaks in schools.
ekegusii: Rora ng'a amache mamarabu! Tanga ogwateka kwendwari yogosaa ase esukuru.
kiswahili: Hakikisha maji safi! Zuia milipuko ya kipindupindu shuleni.
dholuo: Ne ni pi ler! Geng'o tuo mar kolera kik landre e skunde.
somali: Hubi biyo nadiif ah, ka hortag cudurrada kolera ee dugsiyada.

english: Ensure compliance with safety manual.
ekegusii: Rora nga noikeranetie amachiko boronge buna are ase egetabu.
kiswahili: Hakikisha kufuata mwongozo wa usalama.
dholuo: Ne ni oluw weche manie buk moting'o chike mag rito ngima.
somali: Hubi in la raaco tilmaamaha badbaadada.

english: Ensure disability ramps 2020.
ekegusii: Rora nga ebinto biria abana abaremaru bagwesugumera mbireo 2020.
kiswahili: Hakikisha njia za ulemavu 2020.
dholuo: Bed gi kuonde ma joma ong'ol nyalo chopoe e higa mar 2020.
somali: In la damaanad qaato in dadka naafada ah ay la socdaan sanadka 2020.

english: Ensure equitable resource distribution 2020.
ekegusii: Ikerania obobagi bwechibesa boreng'aine 2020.
kiswahili: Hakikisha usambazaji sawa wa rasilimali 2020.
dholuo: Neno ni ipogo mwandu e yo makare e higa 2020.
somali: Si loo hubiyo in khayraadka loo qaybiyo si siman sanadka 2020.

english: Ensure inclusion! Provide digital access for all students.
ekegusii: Korera bonsi! Konya abana bonsi goikera egedichitari.
kiswahili: Hakikisha ujumuishaji! Toa ufikiaji wa kidijitali kwa wanafunzi wote.
dholuo: Ne ni orwakgi giduto! Miyo jopuonjre duto thuolo mar ng'eyo dhokgo e yo mayot.
somali: Hubi ka mid noqoshada ardayda oo dhan.

english: Ensure safe drinking! Provide clean water in schools.
ekegusii: Rora ng'a ase abana bakonwera amache nagaya! Karwe amache amarabu ase esukuru.
kiswahili: Hakikisha unywaji salama! Toa maji safi shuleni.
dholuo: Beduru motang' mondo kik umadh kong'o! Chiw pi maler e skunde.
somali: Hubso in la cabo biyo nadiif ah, iskuulada la siiyo biyo nadiif ah.

english: Ensure safety! Schools, address unrest causes promptly.
ekegusii: Ikerania oborendi! Chisukuru, kwanera amangana agochanda abana otari gochererwa.
kiswahili: Hakikisha usalama! Shule, shughulikia sababu za machafuko haraka.
dholuo: Beduru motang'! Skunde, onego okaw okang' mapiyo mar tieko gik makelo chwanyruok.
somali: Iskuullada, si deg deg ah wax uga qabso sababaha rabshadaha.

english: Ensure safety! Schools, prevent trafficking risks.
ekegusii: Rora ng'a oborendi mboreo! Chisukuru, tanga ekere keragere abana baibwe.
kiswahili: Hakikisha usalama! Shule, zuia hatari za usafirishaji haramu.
dholuo: Beduru motang'! Skunde, geng'o gik manyalo kelo ohala.
somali: Iskuulada, ka hortagida khatarta ganacsiga.

english: Ensure teacher-student ratio 2025.
ekegusii: Rora nga enamba ya barimu neisaine abana bare ase esukuru 2025.
kiswahili: Hakikisha uwiano wa mwalimu na mwanafunzi 2025.
dholuo: Ne ni nyaka chop higa mar 2025 jopuonjre obed maromre gi jopuonjgi.
somali: In la hubiyo heerka macalimiinta iyo ardayda sanadka 2025.

english: Ensure textbooks by January 6, 2025.
ekegusii: Rora nga nore nebitabu biogosoma nyuma ya yechitariki 6 omotienyi omotangani, 2025.
kiswahili: Hakikisha vitabu vya kiada ifikapo Januari 6, 2025.
dholuo: Bed gadier ni buge modol biro yudore e dwe mar Januar 6, 2025.
somali: Si loo hubiyo buugaagta waxbarashada 6-da Janaayo 2025.

english: Ensure water access in schools 2020.
ekegusii: Rora ng'a esukuru nere namache 2020.
kiswahili: Hakikisha upatikanaji wa maji shuleni 2020.
dholuo: Miyo jii thuolo mar yudo pi e skunde e higa mar 2020.
somali: Hubi helitaanka biyaha dugsiyada 2020.

english: Equip libraries in primary schools 2022.
ekegusii: Beka bionsi biria biganeiries ase chinyomba chiogosomera 2022.
kiswahili: Kuandaa maktaba katika shule za msingi 2022.
dholuo: Ti gi gik ma yudore e laibrari e skunde mag praimar e higa mar 2022.
somali: Qalabayso maktabadaha dugsiyada hoose 2022.

english: Event includes civic talks and games
ekegusii: Ogocha amo nechinkwana igoro yobogesaku nechogosori.
kiswahili: Tukio hilo linajumuisha mazungumzo na michezo ya kiraia
dholuo: Chokruogno oriwo twege mag ji duto koda tuke
somali: Dhacdadan waxaa ka mid ah wadahadal iyo ciyaaro dadweyne ah

english: Every child learns! Support refugee students in schools.
ekegusii: Kera omwana ngosoma are! Konya abana ba baria batamire chisegi korwa sobo gosoa chisukuru.
kiswahili: Kila mtoto hujifunza! Wasaidie wanafunzi wakimbizi mashuleni.
dholuo: Nyithindo duto puonjore! Kony jopuonjre ma oringo thuchegi e skunde.
somali: Carruur kastaa way barataa! Taageero ardayda qaxootiga ah ee dugsiyada.

english: Every Form Two student must join a civic education club – Ministry order.
ekegusii: Kera omwana bwesekenderi okerasi gia 2 goika asoe ekeombe kiamasomo obogesaku. Omominisita orure ogochika.
kiswahili: Kila mwanafunzi wa kidato cha pili lazima ajiunge na klabu ya elimu ya uraia '¬â€œ agizo la Wizara.
dholuo: Japuonjre ka japuonjre mar Form Two nyaka donj e klab moro mar somo mar oganda kaluwore gi chik ma ne ochiw gi Ministry.
somali: Arday kasta oo ka mid ah fasalka labaad waa inuu ku biiraa koox waxbarasho oo dadweyne ah sida uu sheegay Wasaaradda.

english: Every school must form a democracy club by November 30 – start today!
ekegusii: Kera esukuru goika erosie ekeombe kiobogambi nyuma yechitariki 30 omotienyi 11gochakera rero!
kiswahili: Kila shule lazima iunde klabu ya demokrasia ifikapo Novemba 30 '¬â€œ anza leo!
dholuo: Skul ka skul nyaka chak timo timbegi mar demokrasi kapok Novemba 30 ochopo. Chak kawuono!
somali: Dugsi kasta waa inuu sameeyaa koox dimuqraadiyad ah 30-ka Nofeembar laga bilaabo maanta!

english: Every school must hold mock elections Nov 28 – winners get certificates from IEBC!
ekegusii: Kera esukuru goika ekore amatema yogotemwa nyuma ya yechitariki 28 omotienyi 11ababui mbanyore ebikworokeria obobui bwabo korwa IEBC!
kiswahili: Kila shule lazima ifanye uchaguzi wa majaribio Novemba 28 " €" washindi watapata vyeti kutoka IEBC!

english: Free bus passes for all TVET students reporting in January – collect from principal.

english: Free counseling for exam stress – call 0800721524 or visit school counselor!

somali: KCSE 2025 oo lacag la'aan ah warqadaha la soo gudbiyay waa lagala soo bixi doonaa ka hor inta server-yada aanay dhicin caawa!

english: Free laptops & toolkits for all 2025 TVET engineering graduates.
ekegusii: Chikombiuta chinke chiakoboko chibekire emeroberio yonsi yogosomera ase abana bonsi bechisukuru chiobobundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria (TVET) omwaka 2025 ase abainchinia bari bakorire amasomo abo.
kiswahili: Pata kompyuta mpakato na vifaa vya bure kwa wahitimu wote wa uhandisi wa TVET wa 2025.
dholuo: Laptops kod gik ma konyo ji e tich ne joma osetieko tiegruok e weche mag TVET e higa mar 2025.
somali: Laptops & qalab lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dhammaan ardayda ka qalin jabisay injineernimada ee 2025 TVET.

english: Free laptops for all KCSE 2025 candidates who register as voters – IEBC incentive.
ekegusii: Chikombiuta chinke ase abana besekenderi bagochia gokora amatemwa abo KCSE 2025 abwo berigeta buna abaaki chikura buna ogosegeta kwa IEBC.
kiswahili: Pata kompyuta mpakato bila malipo kwa wagombea wote wa KCSE 2025 wanaojiandikisha kama wapiga kura – motisha ya IEBC.
dholuo: Laptop ma onge chudo ne jogo duto ma dhi e penj mar KCSE 2025 ma oketo nyinggi e IEBC.
somali: Laptops bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay dhammaan musharixiinta KCSE 2025 ee isdiiwaangaliya codbixiyeyaasha - dhiirigelinta IEBC.

english: Free menstrual cups for 1 million schoolgirls – collect from health center this week!
ekegusii: Ebinto biria abana abanyaroka bagotumia ase chingaki chiabo bigosibigwa naende batumia ase abana emirioni 1 ase abana abanyaroka bare esukuru, binyore korwa abakoreri bobochenu ewiki eye!
kiswahili: Vikombe vya hedhi vya bure kwa wasichana milioni 1 wa shule 2020 vinavyokusanywa kutoka kituo cha afya wiki hii!
dholuo: Ng'iewo okombe mag chwero remo kuom nyiri 1 milion ma dhi e skunde, ibiro chok e kar thieth e jumani!
somali: Koobka caadada ee lacag la'aanta ah ee 1 milyan oo gabdhood ah ayaa toddobaadkan laga soo qaadi doonaa xarunta caafimaadka!

english: Free national digital library launched – 100,000 books, no login required!
ekegusii: Ogosoma kwa bosa goetera egedichitari ochakirwe nebitabu 100,000, teganetie kwemanyekania gedichitari!
kiswahili: Maktaba ya kitaifa ya kidijitali ya bure yazinduliwa – Vitabu 100,000, hakuna kuingia kunakohitajika!
dholuo: Laibrari mar piny mangima mar digital ma onge chudo, ne ogolo buge 100,000, maonge chuno mar donjo!
somali: Maktabadda Digitaalka Qaranka ee Bilaashka ah ayaa la bilaabay 100,000 oo buug, looma baahna inaad gasho!

english: Free national revision TV channel launches Dec 1 – KBC Channel 23, 24/7!
ekegusii: Ogosomia goetera egedichitari bosa ochakirwe.
kiswahili: Chaneli ya televisheni ya kitaifa ya marekebisho ya bure yazinduliwa Desemba 1 – KBC Channel 23, 24/7!
dholuo: Ohinga mar TV mar KBC mar nono kendo nono weche manyien ma onge chudo chako tich Desemba 1 Ohinga mar Jarito mar 23, 24/7!
somali: Telefishanka dib-u-eegista qaranka ee bilaashka ah wuxuu bilaabmayaa 1-da Diseembar KBC Channel 23, 24/7!

english: Free online CBC Grade 9 revision classes start Monday – register via e-Citizen.
ekegusii: Ekerasi kiamairorero yamasomo abosa arengete okwenyara gwa kera omwana (CBC) ase abana ba geredi 9 goetera ngochaka kere etichirimo, erike goetera e-Citizen.
kiswahili: Madarasa ya bure ya marekebisho ya darasa la 9 ya CBC mtandaoni yanaanza Jumatatu – jiandikishe kupitia e-Citizen.
dholuo: Somo mag nono weche mag CBC Grade 9 ma onge chudo chakore chieng' Tich Ariyo.
somali: Casharrada dib-u-eegista ee bilaashka ah ee CBC ee fasalka 9aad waxay bilaabmaan Isniinta.

english: Free plumbing and electrical courses offered in 50 TVET institutions.
ekegusii: Chikoso chiamasomo igoro yokobwata amache goetera emetaro nesitima nkorwegwa chire ase chikolege 50 chiobobundi amo nechiosemi chiokwegendereria (TVET).
kiswahili: Kozi za bure za mabomba na umeme zinazotolewa katika taasisi 50 za TVET.
dholuo: Puonjruok pi kod stima ma onge chudo ne ochiw e kuonde 50 mag tiegruok e yor tiegruok gi lony mamalo.
somali: Koorsooyinka lacag la'aanta ah ee biyaha iyo korontada waxaa lagu bixiyaa 50 hay'adood oo TVET ah.

english: Free revision camp for 10,000 KCSE candidates starts tomorrow – register now!
ekegusii: Okonyorana amo kwa abana besekenderi (KCSE) chilifu 10,000 ase abana baria bagochia gokora amatemwa agochaka mambia, erike bono!
kiswahili: Kambi ya bure ya marekebisho kwa watahiniwa 10,000 wa KCSE inaanza kesho – jiandikishe sasa!
dholuo: Kambi mar nono kendo somo mar nono weche manyien kuom 10,000 mag KCSE chakore kiny.
somali: Xerada dib-u-eegista oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay 10,000 musharixiinta KCSE waxay bilaabaneysaa berrito. Isdiiwaangelinta hadda!

english: Free revision camp for 20,000 KCSE candidates starts Dec 1 – register now!
ekegusii: Okonyorana amo kwa abana besekenderi baria bagochia gokora amatemwa (KCSE) 20,000 ngochaka kere etariki 1 yomotienyi 12, erike bono!
kiswahili: Kambi ya bure ya marekebisho kwa watahiniwa 20,000 wa KCSE inaanza Desemba 1 – jiandikishe sasa!
dholuo: Kambi mar nono kendo somo mar nono kendo somo mar jo KCSE 20,000 chako Dec. 1 - donj sani!
somali: Xerada dib u eegista bilaashka ah ee 20,000 musharixiinta KCSE waxay bilaabaneysaa 1-da Diseembar diiwaangelinta hadda!

english: Free revision materials uploaded for KCPE and KCSE candidates.
ekegusii: Amasakara amasomo abosa yamatemwa aetete a'KCPE and KCSE abekirwe eintaneti ase abana baria bagochia gokora amatemwa.
kiswahili: Nyenzo za bure za marekebisho zimepakiwa kwa watahiniwa wa KCPE na KCSE.
dholuo: Buge mag nono ma onge chudo ne oket malo ne jopuonjre mag KCPE kod KCSE.
somali: Waxyaabaha dib u eegista ee lacag la'aanta ah ee loogu talagalay musharixiinta KCPE iyo KCSE.

english: Free revision timetable + notes for all subjects – download from education.go.ke NOW!
ekegusii: Omoroberio buna abana bagochia gokora amatemwa abo obosa amo namasomo ameng'e yamasomo abo onsi, yanyore korwa education.go.ke BONO!
kiswahili: Ratiba ya bure ya marekebisho + maelezo kwa masomo yote – pakua kutoka education.go.ke SASA!
dholuo: Chenro mar nono kendo nono weche duto ma ne osomo, ma onge chudo, inyalo yudogi e websait mar education.go.ke KINDEGI!
somali: Jadwalka dib-u-eegista oo bilaash ah + qoraallo loogu talagalay dhammaan maadooyinka - ka soo dejiso education.go.ke NOW!

english: Free sanitary towels + underwear for 2 million girls – collect from class teacher!
ekegusii: Chitauro chiria abana abanyaroka bagetubera chingaki chiabo chiomotienyi amo nechianga chinke ase abana abanyaroka chimorioni 2, chinyore korwa omwarimu oo!
kiswahili: Taulo za usafi za bure + nguo za ndani kwa wasichana milioni 2 – kusanya kutoka kwa mwalimu wa darasa!
dholuo: Sanduge mag lwoko del ma onge chudo kaachiel gi lewni ma iye ne nyithindo ma nyiri ma kwan-gi romo milion 2 ma ne ochoki kuom japuonjgi!
somali: Qalabka caafimaadka ee lacag la'aanta ah + dharka hoostiisa ee 2 milyan oo gabdhood ah ayaa laga helaa macalinka fasalka!

english: Free sanitary towels delivered to all public schools – principals must distribute today.
ekegusii: Chitauri chiria abana abanyaroka bwagwetubera chingaki chiomotienyi chiairirwe ase chisukuru chionsi chieserikari, schools abarimu abananene goika bachibage rero.
kiswahili: Taulo za usafi za bure zinazowasilishwa kwa shule zote za umma – wakuu wa shule lazima wazisambaze leo.
dholuo: Sanduge mag lwoko del ma onge chudo ma itero ne jotend skunde duto mag sirkal nyaka pog kawuono.
somali: Towallada caafimaadka ee lacag la'aanta ah ee la gaarsiiyo dhamaan dugsiyada dadweynaha waa in maanta la qaybiyaa macallimiinta.

english: Free school bus service for 500,000 rural learners starts January!
ekegusii: Chiroti chia bosa ase abana baria bagoma ime yechinsinyo chiense 500,000 ngochaka ore omotienyi omotang'ani!
kiswahili: Huduma ya basi la shule bila malipo kwa wanafunzi 500,000 wa vijijini inaanza Januari!
dholuo: Baasi mar skul ma onge chudo ne jopuonjre 500,000 ma odak e gwenge chakore Januar!
somali: Adeegga basaska dugsiga oo bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay 500,000 oo arday ah ayaa bilaabmaya Janaayo!

english: Free school uniforms for 500,000 Grade 7 learners – collection starts Monday.
ekegusii: Chiyuniformu chia bosa ase abana 500,000 ba geredi 7, ogochinyora ngochaka kore etichirimo.
kiswahili: Sare za shule bila malipo kwa wanafunzi 500,000 wa Darasa la 7 – ukusanyaji unaanza Jumatatu.
dholuo: Yudo lep skul ma onge chudo ne jopuonjre 500,000 mag klas mar 7 chakore Tich Ariyo.
somali: Dharka dugsiga oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay 500,000 arday oo fasalka 7aad ayaa laga bilaabaa Isniinta.

english: Free sign-language interpreters in 500 schools – request via principal!
ekegusii: Abarimu batari goakanwa baria bagoonchoreria ebiorokererio gochia enkwana batomirwe gochia chisukuru 500, saba onyore omwarimu oyio goetera omwarimu omonene!
kiswahili: Wakalimani wa lugha ya ishara bila malipo katika shule 500 – ombi kupitia mkuu wa shule!
dholuo: Loko dhok mar ranyisi ma onge chudo e skunde 500 kwayo kokalo kuom jatelo maduong'!
somali: Turjubaanada afka calaamadaha ah ee bilaashka ah ee 500 dugsi ayaa codsi ka bixiya madaxa dugsiga!

english: Free startup capital Ksh 200,000 for top 1,000 TVET graduates!
ekegusii: Chibesa chiogochaka ebiasara chieiringi 200,000 ase abana baria bakorire buya korwa chisukuru chiobobundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria (TVET) ase abana 1,000 bakorire amasomo ayio!
kiswahili: Mtaji wa kuanzisha biashara bila malipo Ksh 200,000 kwa wahitimu 1,000 bora wa TVET!
dholuo: Ohala mar Ksh 200,000 mar chako tich ne jopuonjre 1,000 ma osetieko tiegruok mar TVET!
somali: Lacagaha bilowga ah ee bilaashka ah Ksh 200,000 oo loogu talagalay 1,000ka ugu sareeya ee ka qalin jabisay TVET!

english: Free startup toolkits worth Ksh 150,000 for all 2025 TVET graduates!
ekegusii: Omoroberio bwogochakia obosa bwechieiringi 150,000 ase abana bonsi omwaka 2025 ase abana baria bakorire amasomo obobundi nechisemi chikwegendereria (TVET) bakorire amsomo ayio!
kiswahili: Vifaa vya kuanzisha biashara bila malipo vyenye thamani ya Ksh 150,000 kwa wahitimu wote wa TVET wa 2025!
dholuo: Gige tich ma onge chudo ma nengogi romo Ksh 150,000 ne jogo duto ma osetieko tiegruok mar TVET e higa mar 2025!
somali: Qalabka bilaashka ah ee bilowga ah oo qiimihiisu yahay Ksh 150,000 oo loogu talagalay dhammaan 2025 ka qalin jabisay TVET!

english: Free toolkits worth Ksh 100,000 for all 2025 TVET graduates in technical courses.
ekegusii: Omoroberio bwogochakia obosa bwechieiringi 100,000 ase abana bonsi omwaka 2025 ase abana baria bonsi bakorire amosomo (TVET).
kiswahili: Vifaa vya bure vyenye thamani ya Ksh 100,000 kwa wahitimu wote wa TVET wa 2025 katika kozi za ufundi.
dholuo: Gige tich ma onge chudo ma nengogi romo Ksh 100,000 ne jogo duto ma osetieko tiegruok e yore mag tiegruok gi lony e higni 2025 e yore mag lony.
somali: Qalab qalab oo lacag la'aan ah oo qiimihiisu yahay 100,000 Ksh oo loogu talagalay dhammaan ardayda ka qalin jabisay barnaamijyada farsamada ee 2025.

english: Free TVET courses in AI, robotics & coding – 5,000 slots open countrywide.
ekegusii: Amabaga amasomo abosa 5,000 a (TVET) ime yechisemi chigebandia, robotics & coding, aigoirwe kenya engima.
kiswahili: Kozi za bure za TVET katika AI, roboti na uandishi wa msimbo – Nafasi 5,000 zimefunguliwa kote nchini.
dholuo: Chenro mar tiegruok e yore mag TVET e yore mag AI, robotics & koding, thuolo mar 5,000 oseyawore e piny mangima.
somali: Koorsooyinka TVET ee lacag la'aanta ah ee AI, robotics & codinta waa 5,000 oo boos oo laga furay waddanka oo dhan.

english: Free uniforms for 600,000 Grade 7 learners – collect from school starting Monday!
ekegusii: Chitunifomu chia bosa ase abana 600,000 bageredi 7, nyora korwa esukuru gochakera etichirimo!
kiswahili: Sare za bure kwa wanafunzi 600,000 wa Darasa la 7 – zilizokusanywa kutoka shuleni kuanzia Jumatatu!
dholuo: Yunifom ma onge chudo ne jopuonjre maromo 600,000 mar klas 7 ochok e skul chakre Tich Ariyo!
somali: Dharka lacag la'aanta ah ee 600,000 ardayda fasalka 7aad ayaa laga soo ururiyaa dugsiga laga bilaabo Isniinta!

english: Free voter education app launched – scan QR code in your classroom today.
ekegusii: Egekoreri kegosomia amasomo obegasaku bosa giachakirwe, eka ebicha koyonyora abwo ase enyomba yogosomera yesukuru.
kiswahili: Programu ya elimu ya mpiga kura bila malipo imezinduliwa – skani msimbo wa QR darasani mwako leo.
dholuo: Chenro mar somo ne jotim yiero ma onge chudo ne ochak tiyo sani mar scan QR code e klas.
somali: Barnaamijka waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee bilaashka ah ayaa maanta la bilaabay si ay u baaraan koodhka QR ee fasalkaaga.

english: Free voter education TV show starts Monday 7PM on KBC – don't miss!
ekegusii: Amaorokererio yamasomo goetera etibi (TV) ngochaka are rero etichirimo ensa eyemo goetera eredio ya KBC toyorema!
kiswahili: Kipindi cha televisheni cha elimu ya mpiga kura bila malipo kinaanza Jumatatu saa 1 mchana kwenye KBC – usikose!
dholuo: Ohinga mar TV mar somo ne joyier ma onge chudo chako tich Tich Ariyo saa 7 otieno e KBC don miss!
somali: Barnaamijka tababarka codbixiyayaasha ee bilaashka ah wuxuu bilaabmayaa Isniinta 7PM ee KBC.

english: Free voter education WhatsApp bot launched – save 0111222333 and type HI now!
ekegusii: Amasomo abosa goetera omoroberio o'WhatsApp ogwetebereria bwoka oansire kobwate/kogache amag'ana goetera 0111222333 ase ogokwania HI bono!
kiswahili: Boti ya elimu ya mpiga kura ya WhatsApp imezinduliwa – hifadhi 0111222333 na andika HI sasa!
dholuo: WhatsApp bot mar somo ne joma oyiero ma onge chudo osechako tiyo.
somali: Waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha bilaashka ah botka WhatsApp ayaa la bilaabay

english: Free Zoom Pro for all Kenyan teachers – claim with TSC number today!
ekegusii: Omoroberio bwogosoma bosa ase abarimu abakenya bonsi tosabe goetera enamba yao ya (TSC) rero!
kiswahili: Zoom Pro ya Bure kwa walimu wote wa Kenya – dai kwa nambari ya TSC leo!
dholuo: Zoom Pro ma onge chudo ne jopuonj duto mag Kenya ma nigi namba mar TSC kawuono!
somali: Zoom Pro oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dhammaan macalimiinta Kenya ayaa codsanaya lambarka TSC maanta!

english: Fund arts festivals 2022.
ekegusii: Karwe chibesa! Sira chigosori chiegetamaduni 2022
kiswahili: Fadhili sherehe za sanaa 2022.
dholuo: Yudo pesa mag timo nyasi mag goro e higa mar 2022.
somali: Bandhigga xafladaha farshaxanka 2022.

english: Fund education! Support nomadic schools for pastoralists.
ekegusii: Sira chisemi! Konya chisukuru chiabatugi bari bakong'anyang'anya.
kiswahili: Fadhili elimu! Saidia shule za kuhamahama kwa wafugaji.
dholuo: Konyuru Jomoko Oyud Puonj! Konyuru joma odak e gwenge maboyo mondo opuonjre kaka ginyalo rito jamni.
somali: Taageero dugsiyada dhaqdhaqaaqa ee loogu talagalay adhijirrada.

english: Fund inclusion! Support bursaries for students with special needs.
ekegusii: Karwe chibesa ase abana bonsi na mono baria bare noboremaru ao ao! Karwe chibesa ase okogania kwa abana baria bare noboremaru ao ao.
kiswahili: Ushirikishwaji wa fedha! Saidia bursaries kwa wanafunzi wenye mahitaji maalum.
dholuo: Chulo osuru! Somo mar pesa ne jopuonjre ma nigi dwaro makende.
somali: Isku dhafka xirmada! Taageerada basariga ee ardayda baahiyaha gaarka ah qaba.

english: Fund lab equipment 2023.
ekegusii: karwe chibesa gokonya kogora ebinto biechinyomba chiobosayansi 2023.
kiswahili: Fadhili vifaa vya maabara 2023.
dholuo: Ne gik ma itiyogo e kar timo nonro e higa mar 2023.
somali: Qandaraaska qalabka shaybaarka 2023.

english: Fund programs! Support mental health in schools.
ekegusii: Karwe chibesa ase emeroberio! Sira chisemi chiogokonya nakobwenia ebirengererio biobongo, okweiranana, na gokonya koagacha oboamate na nabande esukuru.
kiswahili: Fadhili programu! Saidia afya ya akili shuleni.
dholuo: Choko pesa ne chenro mopogore opogore! Konyuru joma nigi tuoche mag paro e skunde.
somali: Taageero Caafimaadka Maskaxda ee Dugsiyada.

english: Fund research in universities 2023.
ekegusii: Kae chiyunifasiti chibesa gochisira korigia na konyora chisemi chinyia 2023.
kiswahili: Fadhili utafiti katika vyuo vikuu 2023.
dholuo: Yudo pesa mar timo nonro e yunivasiti nyaka 2023.
somali: Maalgelinta cilmi baarista jaamacadaha 2023.

english: Fund schools! Ensure timely capitation for stability.
ekegusii: Kae chisukuru chibesa! Rora ng'a chibesa chiria eserikari ekorwa ase kera omwana chiakeranire gokonya emeroberio yesukuru.
kiswahili: Fadhili shule! Hakikisha ufadhili wa wakati kwa utulivu.
dholuo: Konyuru Skunde mag Pinyruoth! Neuru ni oketgi e tich e kinde mowinjore mondo gibed gi winjruok maber.
somali: Dugsiyada maalgelinta, si loo hubiyo in waqtigeeda lagu guuleysto xasiloonida.

english: Fund schools! Support education for refugee children.
ekegusii: Karwe chibesa gosira chisukuru! Sira chisemi ase abana ba baria batamire chisegi korwa sobo.
kiswahili: Fadhili shule! Saidia elimu kwa watoto wakimbizi.
dholuo: Konyuru Skunde mag Pinyruoth! Kony nyithindo ma oringo thuchegi.
somali: Taageero waxbarashada carruurta qaxootiga ah.

english: Fund SNE programs 2023.
ekegusii: Sira emeroberio yechisemi ase abana baria bare noboremaru ao ao (SNE) 2023.
kiswahili: Fadhili programu za SNE 2023.
dholuo: Yudo pesa mag program mag SNE 2023.
somali: Maalgelinta barnaamijyada SNE 2023.

english: Fund university scholarships 2023.
ekegusii: Sira omoroberio bwokorwa chisebesa gokonya abana betunifasiti 2023.
kiswahili: Fadhili ufadhili wa masomo ya vyuo vikuu 2023.
dholuo: Konyuru jopuonjre mag yunivasiti e higa mar 2023.
somali: Maalgelinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee jaamacadaha sanadka 2023.

english: GBV desks active in every public school – report anonymously today!
ekegusii: Ensemo yogotanga gochegigwa kwabana (GBV) goge abarimu mono abanyaroka kobe ase kera esukuru yeserikari, karwe amang'ana igoro yayio otamanyekaneti!
kiswahili: Madawati ya GBV yanafanya kazi katika kila shule ya umma – ripoti bila kujulikana leo!
dholuo: Buge mawuoyo kuom timbe gero mag nindruok e kind chwo gi mon, sani yudore e skunde duto mag sirkal!
somali: Xafiisyada GBV ee ka shaqeeya dugsiyada dadweynaha oo dhan ayaa maanta si qarsoodi ah u soo waramaya!

english: GBV survivors get free counseling + legal aid – call 0800721524 now!
ekegusii: Bario bagochigigwa (GBV) konyora ogokonywa kwa bosa ase ebirengereri na kemachiko, aka esimi 0800721524 bono!
dholuo: Joma otony e tim mar GBV yudo kony ma onge chudo + kony mar chik luong 0800721524 sani!
somali: Dadka ka badbaaday GBV waxay helayaan la talin lacag la'aan ah + caawimaad sharci ah - wac 0800721524 hadda!

english: Gender-based violence reporting desks established in 1,000 schools.
ekegusii: Ensemo yokomanyia igoro yogochegigwa (GBV) chiabekirwe ime yechisukuru 1,000.
kiswahili: Waathiriwa wa GBV wanapata ushauri nasaha bila malipo + msaada wa kisheria piga 0800721524 sasa!
dholuo: Sanduge mag chiwo ripot mag timbe gero mag nindruok ne ochak e skunde 1,000.
somali: 1000 oo iskuulood ayaa lagu aasaasay boorsooyin lagu soo sheegayo rabshadaha jinsiga.

english: Get to school! Apply for transport subsidies for remote students.
ekegusii: Ika esukuru! Karwe ogosaba kwao buna oria okorwa ensinyo ytorogongo okeerigwe rigori riokorina egari.
kiswahili: Jiunge! Jiunge na vilabu vya shule ili kujifunza kuhusu utawala.
dholuo: Dhiuru e skul! Many kony mar pesa mar wuoth ne jopuonjre ma somo mabor.
somali: Iskuulka tag! Codso kaalmada gaadiidka ee ardayda fog.

english: Give back! Join community service programs in schools.
ekegusii: karwe gento geke! Kabe oyomo bakobwaterana ase emeremo yekenyoro ase chisukuru.
kiswahili: Fika shuleni! Omba ruzuku ya usafiri kwa wanafunzi wa mbali.
dholuo: Chiw ane pesago! Donj e chenro mag konyo ji e skunde.
somali: Ku biir barnaamijyada adeegga bulshada ee dugsiyada.

english: Go digital! Equip schools with computers and internet.
ekegusii: Nganya gocia egedichitari! Ichoria chikombiuta chisukuru amo neintaneti.
kiswahili: Rudisha! Jiunge na programu za huduma za jamii shuleni.
dholuo: Dhi e Intanet! Miyo skunde obed gi kompyuta kod Intanet.
somali: Iskuulada ku qalabeeya kombiyuutarada iyo internetka.

english: Grade 6 must register for KPSEA by February 28.
ekegusii: Abana bageredi 6 goika berike ase okorengwa na KPSEA nyuma yechitariki 28 chiomotienyi 2
kiswahili: Darasa la 6 lazima lijiandikishe kwa KPSEA ifikapo Februari 28.
dholuo: Jopuonjre mag klas mar 6 nyaka ndikre e KPSEA kapok ochopo tarik 28 Februar.
somali: Fasalka 6 waa inuu iska diiwaangeliyaa KPSEA 28-ka Febraayo.

english: Grade 6 register for KPSEA by Feb 28.
ekegusii: Abana bageredi gia 6 kwerika ase okorengwa na KPSEA nyuma yechitariki 28 chiotienyi 2.
kiswahili: Darasa la 6 jiandikishe kwa KPSEA ifikapo Februari 28.
dholuo: Inyalo timo penj mar KPSEA e klas mar 6 kapok ochopo Februar 28.
somali: Diiwaangelinta heerka 6 ee KPSEA 28-ka Febraayo.

english: Grade 7 & Form 1 reporting: Bring ONLY birth certificate + admission letter. No shopping lists allowed!
ekegusii: Abana bageredi 7 na esekenderi fomu 1 gosoa cchisukuru: Bogoria Esatifiketi yokoiborwa YOKA nerirube riokorangerigwa. Gotebigwa nga ogore eke na keria TiKOIYO!
kiswahili: Ripoti ya Darasa la 7 na Kidato cha 1: Lete cheti cha kuzaliwa PEKEE + barua ya udahili. Hakuna orodha ya ununuzi inayoruhusiwa!
dholuo: Klas mar 7 kod fom mar 1 mar ripot: Kelnwa mana barupe manyiso ni onyuolwa e pinyno kod barua manyiso ni wasechako somo e yunivasiti. Ok oyienwa ting'o list mag gik ma wadwaro nyiewo!
somali: Warbixinta fasalka 7 & Foomka 1: Keliya keena shahaadada dhalashada + waraaqda gelitaanka. Looma oggola liisaska wax iibsiga!

english: Grade 7 free feeding program starts Jan – 3 meals daily guaranteed!
ekegusii: Abana begeredi gia 7 mbanyore endagera ya bosa gochakera omotienyi omtang'ani chindgera mara gatato kera rituko!
kiswahili: Programu ya kulisha bila malipo ya Darasa la 7 inaanza Januari – Milo 3 kila siku imehakikishwa!
dholuo: Chenro mar pidho nyithindo maonge chudo chakore Januar 3. Chiemo mapile en gima osingi!
somali: Barnaamijka quudinta bilaashka ah ee fasalka 7aad wuxuu bilaabmayaa Jan, 3 cunto oo maalinle ah oo la damaanad qaaday!

english: Grade 7 reporting January 13: Bring only birth certificate – no shopping list allowed.
ekegusii: Abana bageredi 7 bagosoa chitariki 13 omotienyi omotang'ani: Bogori esatifiketi yokoiborwa YOKA' ingana rinde nga gora eke gose keria tiyancheirwe.
kiswahili: Kuripoti Darasa la 7 Januari 13: Leta cheti cha kuzaliwa pekee – hakuna orodha ya ununuzi inayoruhusiwa.
dholuo: Klas mar 7 biro chopo Januar 13: Inyalo mana kelo barupe manyiso ni onyuoli to ok iyie gi chenro mar nyiewo gik moko.
somali: Qeybta 7aad ee warbixinta Janaayo 13: Keliya keena shahaadada dhalashada. Liiska wax iibsiga looma oggola.

english: Grade 8 CBC revision live classes start 6PM daily – join via YouTube link in bio.
ekegusii: Amasomo okoirorera yabana begeredi kia 8 a'CBC goetera chiradi netibi nochake chinsa 12 kera rituko, soa goetera YouTube link in bio.
kiswahili: Madarasa ya moja kwa moja ya marekebisho ya CBC ya Darasa la 8 yanaanza saa 6PM kila siku – jiunge kupitia kiungo cha YouTube kwenye wasifu.
dholuo: Klas mar 8 CBC revision live classes chakre 6PM pile pile riwri gi kokalo kuom link mar YouTube e bio.
somali: Fasalka 8aad ee CBC dib u eegista fasallada tooska ah waxay bilaabmaan 6PM maalin kasta

english: Grade 9 learners transition after KJSEA results in December.
ekegusii: Okwamboka kwa abana bageredi 9 nyuma bakorire na konyora amairanerio yamatemwa abo a'KJSEA omotienyi 12.
kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya wanafunzi wa Darasa la 9 baada ya matokeo ya KJSEA mwezi Desemba.
dholuo: Jopuonjre mag klas mar 9 dhi e skul bang' KJSEA e dwe mar Desemba.
somali: Barayaasha fasalka 9aad waxay u wareegaan ka dib natiijooyinka KJSEA bishii Diseembar.

english: Graduation at South Eastern Kenya University.
ekegusii: Ogokora na gosoka kwa abana aria South Eastern Kenya University.
kiswahili: Kuhitimu katika Chuo Kikuu cha South Eastern Kenya.
dholuo: Ne otieko tiegruok e Yunivasiti mar South Eastern Kenya.
somali: Ka qalin jabisay Jaamacadda Koonfur Bariga Kenya.

english: Grow skills! Equip schools with agricultural training labs.
ekegusii: Kinia ochusi! Agacha chinyomba chiobosayansi bwoboremi chisukuru.
kiswahili: Kuza ujuzi! Panga shule na maabara ya mafunzo ya kilimo.
dholuo: Nyag lony! Miyo skunde obed gi kuonde tiegruok mag pur.
somali: Iskuulka ku qalabeeya shaybaarada tababarka beeraha.

english: Grow your business! Join agribusiness vocational courses.
ekegusii: Kinia oboonchoreria bwao! Soa chikorechi chia inse chiria chogosomia chikosi chioboremi.
kiswahili: Kuza biashara yako! Jiunge na kozi za ufundi za kilimo.
dholuo: Med kwan mar ohala mari! Dhi e tiegruok e weche mag ohala mar pur.
somali: Ku biir koorsooyinka xirfadeed ee ganacsiga beeraha.

english: Half-time used for civic talks
ekegusii: Obogati-gti bwechinsa gokwanerana amangana obogesaku
kiswahili: Nusu ya muda inayotumika kwa mazungumzo ya kiraia
dholuo: Thuolo ma ne itiyo godo e goyo mbaka mag ji duto
somali: Qeybta waqtiga loo isticmaalo wadahadalada rayidka ah

english: Have a voice! Join school boards to influence policies.
ekegusii: Kabe beriosa! Soa chikomiti chiesukuru gosegeta amachiko.
kiswahili: Kuwa na sauti! Jiunge na bodi za shule ili kushawishi sera.
dholuo: Wuouru! Donj e komiti mag skunde mondo ikony e loso chike matayo weche.
somali: Ku biir guddiyada dugsiga si aad u saameyso siyaasadaha.

english: Heal together! Access school counselors after protests.
ekegusii: Bwenia amo! Ikera omosemia bwesukuru ekero okobwatekana gwokwanga (amaandamano) abeire.
kiswahili: Ponyeni pamoja! Wafikieni washauri wa shule baada ya maandamano.
dholuo: Wachanguru kanyachiel! Ng'iyo gi jopuonj mag skul bang' ng'anyo.
somali: Iska daaweynta wadajirka ah!

english: HELB TVET loans application closes March 15, 2025.
ekegusii: Ogosaba chibesa chiria chieroni yeyunifasiti nechisukuru chiobobundi (HELB TVET) ngosieka kore chityariki 15 omotienyi 3 omwaka 2025.
kiswahili: Maombi ya mikopo ya HELB TVET yanafungwa Machi 15, 2025.
dholuo: Kway mar HELB TVET loans biro rumo tarik 15 Mach 2025.
somali: Codsiga amaahda HELB TVET wuxuu dhamaadaa 15-ka Maarso 2025.

english: Here is President William Ruto's full speech during the Jamhuri Day Celebrations on Monday, December 12, 2022. We come together on this 59th Jamhuri Day to celebrate our freedom. It is the first natio...
ekegusii: Eye nero enkwana engima yomoraisi Wiliam Ruto chingaki chiogochengera rituko ria Jamhuri etichi rimo, chitriki 12 chiomwaka 2022. Noigo twachire amo rituko eri yemiaka 59 ya Jamhuri gochengera obosibore bwaito. Eri nerituko rinene...
kiswahili: Hapa kuna hotuba kamili ya Rais William Ruto wakati wa Sherehe za Siku ya Jamhuri Jumatatu, Desemba 12, 2022. Tunakusanyika pamoja katika Siku hii ya 59 ya Jamhuri kusherehekea uhuru wetu. Ni taifa la kwanza...
dholuo: Magi e weche duto ma Ker William Ruto ne owacho e kinde nyasi mar Jamhuri Day ma ne otim Tich Ariyo, Desemba 12, 2022. Wachokore kanyachiel e odiechieng'ni mar 59 mar Jamhuri mondo wapar thuolo ma wan-go. En e piny mokwongo...
somali: Halkan waxaa ah khudbad buuxa oo uu Madaxweyne William Ruto ka jeediyay xafladaha Maalinta Jamhuri ee Isniinta, 12-ka Diseembar, 2022. Waxaan isugu imaanaynaa maalinta 59aad ee Jamhuri si aan u dabaaldegno xorriyadeena.

english: Honor academic excellence 2025.
ekegusii: Karwe ebiegwa rituko riogochengera chisemi 2025.
kiswahili: Heshimu ubora wa kitaaluma 2025.
dholuo: Nyis luor ne somo mamalo mar 2025.
somali: Si loo sharfo heerka aqooneed ee 2025.

english: Honor community educators 2025.
ekegusii: Basike abarimu bebinyoro 2025.
kiswahili: Heshimu waelimishaji wa jamii 2025.
dholuo: Nyis luor ne joma puonjo e gweng'no e higa mar 2025.
somali: Macallimiinta bulshada ee lagu sharfo 2025.

english: Honor innovators 2025.
ekegusii: basike abwo kakoreta obamanyi oboyia 2025.
kiswahili: Heshimu wavumbuzi 2025.
dholuo: Miuru duong' jo manyien e higa mar 2025.
somali: Maamulitaanka hal-abuurnimada sanadka 2025.

english: Honor outstanding teachers 2025.
ekegusii: basike abarimu bagosomia buya 2025.
kiswahili: Heshimu walimu bora 2025.
dholuo: Miuru luor jopuonj madongo 2025.
somali: Macallimiinta cajiibka ah ee 2025.

english: IEBC launches digital voter education app – download now on Google Play.
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) gosomia abanto igoro yogoaka chikura goetera egedichitari, nyora ayio goetera Google Play.
kiswahili: IEBC yazindua programu ya elimu ya wapiga kura kidijitali "pakua sasa" kwenye Google Play.
dholuo: IEBC chako tiyo gi app mar somo ne joma oyiero e yor digital ma inyalo download sani e Google Play.
somali: IEBC waxay bilaabaysaa barnaamijka waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha digital ah ee hadda laga soo dejisan karo Google Play.

english: IEBC to issue 1 million voter cards in schools next week – be ready!
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) korikia abaaki chikura abayia emirioni eyemo 1 ime yechisuku ewiki egocha, eariganie!
kiswahili: IEBC itatoa kadi za wapiga kura milioni 1 shuleni wiki ijayo "kuwa tayari!
dholuo: IEBC biro golo kad mar yiero mar milion achiel e skunde juma mabiro beduru moikore!
somali: IEBC waxay soo saari doontaa 1 milyan oo kaararka codbixiyaha ee iskuulada todobaadka soo socda.

english: IEBC to issue 500,000 voter cards in schools next week – be ready with ID!
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) chikadi chiabaaki chikura 500,000 ase chisukuru ewiki egocha, eariganie nekebande!
kiswahili: IEBC itatoa kadi za wapiga kura 500,000 shuleni wiki ijayo "kuwa tayari na kitambulisho!
dholuo: IEBC biro golo kad 500,000 mag yiero e skunde juma mabiro ikreuru gi kad mar ID!
somali: IEBC waxay toddobaadka soo socda u soo saari doontaa 500,000 kaararka codbixiyaha dugsiyada si ay u diyaar garoobaan aqoonsiga!

english: IEBC to visit 1,000 secondary schools for mass voter registration this month.
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) ngetarere chisekenderi 1,000 korikia abange buna abaaki chikura omotienyi oyo.
kiswahili: IEBC kutembelea shule za upili 1,000 kwa ajili ya uandikishaji wa wapiga kura wengi mwezi huu.
dholuo: IEBC biro limo skunde 1,000 mag sekondar mondo ondik joma biro yiero e dwe maeni.
somali: IEBC waxay booqan doontaa 1,000 oo dugsi sare oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ballaaran bishaan.

english: IEBC to visit 2,000 schools next week – ensure all Form 4 have voter cards.
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) netarere chisukuru 2,000 ewiki egocha, rora ng'a abana bonsi besekenderi bekerasi gia 4 mbabwate chikadi chiekura.
kiswahili: IEBC itatembelea shule 2,000 wiki ijayo ili kuhakikisha wanafunzi wote wa kidato cha 4 wana kadi za wapiga kura.
dholuo: IEBC biro limo skunde 2,000 juma mabiro mondo one ni Form 4 duto nigi kad mag yiero.
somali: IEBC waxay booqan doontaa 2,000 oo dugsi toddobaadka soo socda si loo hubiyo in dhammaan Form 4 ay leeyihiin kaararka codbixiyeyaasha.

english: IEBC voter registration in every school Nov 20–30 – bring ID or birth cert!
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) okorokia chikura ase chisukuru chionsi chitariki 30 omotienyi 11, reta ekebande gose esatifiketi yokoiborwa!
kiswahili: Usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC katika kila shule Novemba 20, 2020, 3 ... Ofisi ya mkuu SASA!
dholuo: IEBC ndiko ji e ombulu e skunde duto Nov 2030 kel ID kata satifiket mar nyuol!
somali: Diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha IEBC ee iskuulada oo dhan 20 Noofembar 30 saacadood ka dib waxaad keentaa shahaadada aqoonsiga ama shahaadada dhalashada!

english: IEBC voter registration starts Monday – bring ID to your school or chief's office NOW!
ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) okorikigwa chikura ngochaka kore etichi rimo, reta ekabande esukuru gose ofisi yomogambi oo BONO!
kiswahili: Usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC unaanza Jumatatu. Lete kitambulisho shuleni kwako au ofisini kwa mkuu wa shule SASA!
dholuo: IEBC chako ndiko ji e ombulu chieng' Tich Ariyo. Kel kad mar injili e skul kata e ofis mar jatend skul KINDEGI!
somali: Diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee IEBC waxay bilaabmaysaa Isniinta. U keen aqoonsiga dugsigaaga ama xafiiska madaxaaga HADDII!

english: Implement policies! Schools, prevent gender-based violence.
ekegusii: Korera emeremo acmachiko! Chisukuru, tanga obochege igoro yomonyaroka gose omomura ase esukuru.
kiswahili: Tekeleza sera! Shule, zuia ukatili wa kijinsia.
dholuo: Tiuru gi yore mag konyruok! Skunde, geng'o timbe gero mag nindruok.
somali: Iskuulada, ka hortagga rabshadaha jinsiga.

english: Implement protocols! Schools, address unrest safely.
ekegusii: Ikerania emeroberio! Chisukuru, Kwanera ingana rinde riosnsi rikorenta okwemurungania riragere omorembe na oborendi gosareka.
kiswahili: Tekeleza itifaki! Shule, shughulikia machafuko kwa usalama.
dholuo: Tiuru gi chenro moketi! Skunde, kawuru okang' mar tieko ywaruok e yor ritruok.
somali: Dugsiyada, si nabadgelyo leh ula dhaqma rabshadaha.

english: Include all! Provide laptops for rural students.
ekegusii: Renta amo bonsi! Kae abana barisabu chikombiuta chiakoboko.
kiswahili: Jumuisha yote! Toa kompyuta mpakato kwa wanafunzi wa vijijini.
dholuo: Winjuru ji duto! Chiw kompyuta mag lwedo ne jopuonjre modak e gwenge.
somali: Dhammaantood ku dar, ardayda reer miyiga ah u siiya laptops.

english: Include everyone! Ensure schools accommodate students with disabilities.
ekegusii: Renta kerta oyomo! Rora ng'a chisukuru nkorwa chire ribaga ase abana bare noboremaru.
kiswahili: Jumuisha kila mtu! Hakikisha shule zinawapa nafasi wanafunzi wenye ulemavu.
dholuo: Ji duto mondo oriwre! Neno ni skunde rwako jopuonjre ma nigi midekre.
somali: Isku day in dugsiyada ay la kulmaan ardayda naafada ah.

english: Inclusion of learners with disabilities in CBC assessment framework.
ekegusii: Burukania abana bare noboremaru nabana bande ase chisemi chiria chirengete okwenyara kwomwana nechisemi chiokwegendereria (CBC) ase omoroberio bwokobarenga.
kiswahili: Kujumuishwa kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika mfumo wa tathmini ya CBC.
dholuo: Tiyo gi jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e nonro mar CBC.
somali: Ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah ee ku jira qaab-dhismeedka qiimeynta CBC.

english: Inclusive CBC exams: Braille & sign language papers ready – collect from KNEC!
ekegusii: Amatemwa a CBC ase abana baria abare noboremaru ao ao na baria bare boronge bonsi: Amasakara nebinto biria bigokonya abana emeuko, baria batari koigwa na gokwana nao bire tayari, binyore korwa KNEC!
kiswahili: Mitihani ya CBC jumuishi: Karatasi za Braille na lugha ya ishara tayari "kukusanywa kutoka KNEC!
dholuo: Nonro mag CBC: Barupe mag Braille kod dhok mar ranyisi oikore mar kawo e KNEC!
somali: Imtixaannada CBC oo ay ku jiraan: Imtixaannada Braille & Afka Calaamadaha ayaa diyaar u ah in laga soo qaado KNEC!

english: Inclusive education now law – every public school must admit disabled learners!
ekegusii: Chisemi ase bonsi bono riabeire ogochika, kera esukuru yeserikari goika ebe nabana bare noboremaru!
kiswahili: Elimu jumuishi sasa sheria "kila shule ya umma lazima iwapokee wanafunzi wenye ulemavu!" Sera ya elimu jumuishi ilizinduliwa "kila shule lazima iwaandikishe wanafunzi wenye ulemavu!"
dholuo: Somo mar ji duto koro en chik, skunde duto mag sirkal nyaka yien jopuonjre ma nigi midekre mondo odonj e skundego!
somali: Waxbarashada ka kooban hadda waa sharci. Dugsi kasta oo dawladeed waa inuu aqbalaa ardayga naafada ah!

english: Inclusive education policy launched – every school must admit disabled learners!
ekegusii: Richiko igoro yechisemi ase bonsi riabekirwe, kera esukuru goika erwe ribaga ase abana abaremaru!
kiswahili: Sera ya elimu jumuishi yazinduliwa "kila shule lazima iwaandikishe wanafunzi wenye ulemavu!"
dholuo: Chenro mar somo ma oriwo ji duto osechako skul ka skul nyaka yie rwako jopuonjre ma nigi midekre!
somali: Siyaasadda waxbarashada oo dhanka ka mid ah ayaa la bilaabay. Dugsi kasta waa inuu aqbalaa ardayga naafada ah!

english: Inclusive sports day mandatory in all schools Dec 10 – every child must participate!
ekegusii: Rituko riokogokera chigosori goika rikoreke chitriki 10 chia kera omotienyi 12, kera omwana goika aegwe ribaga kogokera!
kiswahili: Siku ya michezo jumuishi lazima katika shule zote Desemba 10 "kila mtoto lazima ashiriki!"
dholuo: Odiechieng' mar tuke moriwo ji duto en gima ochuno e skunde duto Desemba 10 nyathi ka nyathi nyaka riwre!
somali: Xilliga isboortiga oo dhan waxaa lagu qasbaa dhammaan dugsiyada 10-ka Diseembar. Ilmaha oo dhami waa inay ka qeyb galaan!

english: Inspect dorms! Ensure fire safety compliance in schools.
ekegusii: Rora nga chinyomba chiabana bakorara mbuya chire! Ikerania amachiko gotanga ogwateka kwemerero ase chisukuru.
kiswahili: Kagua mabweni! Hakikisha unazingatia usalama wa moto shuleni.
dholuo: Nonuru kuonde ma ji nindoe! Neno ni nitie ritruok e yore mag geng'o mach e skunde.
somali: Hubi badbaadada dabka ee dugsiyada.

english: Inspect school buses 2020.
ekegusii: Rora nga chirori chiesukuru mbuya nchiikeranetie ebinto bionsi biepara nobobogoria 2020.
kiswahili: Kagua mabasi ya shule 2020.
dholuo: Nonuru mtokni mag skul 2020.
somali: Kormeerka basaska dugsiga 2020.

english: Install CCTV in schools 2020.
ekegusii: Beka chikamera chiria chikobwata ayagendererete (CCTV) ase esukuru 2020.
kiswahili: Sakinisha CCTV shuleni 2020.
dholuo: Ket CCTV e skunde e higa mar 2020.
somali: Ku rakib CCTV dugsiyada 2020.

english: Install solar power in remote schools 2020.
ekegusii: Beka ebinto biria bikobwata chinguru chierisase korenta oborabu (solar) chisukuru chionsi chia risabu 2020.
kiswahili: Sakinisha umeme wa jua katika shule za mbali 2020.
dholuo: Ket teko mar chieng' e skunde man kuonde maboyo e higa 2020.
somali: Ku rakib tamarta qoraxda dugsiyada fog 2020.

english: Integrate AI education 2024.
ekegusii: Burukania ebikoreri biria biechisemi pandia ase ogosoma 2024.
kiswahili: Unganisha elimu ya akili bandia (AI) 2024.
dholuo: Ti gi rieko mar dhano e puonjo ji e higa mar 2024.
somali: Isku dar waxbarashada AI 2024.

english: Integrate all! Support refugee students in local schools.
ekegusii: Renta amo bionsi! Konya abana ba baria batamire chisegi korwa chinsobo gosoa chisukuru.
kiswahili: Unganisha wote! Wasaidie wanafunzi wakimbizi katika shule za mitaa.
dholuo: Winjuru ji duto! Kony jopuonjre moringo thuchegi e skunde manie alworagi.
somali: Isku dar dhammaan! Taageero ardayda qaxootiga ah ee dugsiyada deegaanka.

english: Integrate digital literacy in curriculum 2025.
ekegusii: Renta amo chisemi chigedichitari ase omoroberio bwamasomo 2025.
kiswahili: Unganisha uandishi wa habari kidijitali katika mtaala wa 2025.
dholuo: Ti kod somo mar digital e somo mar 2025.
somali: Isku darka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee manhajka 2025.

english: Integrate entrepreneurship 2023.
ekegusii: Renta amo amasomo onsi 2023.
kiswahili: Unganisha ujasiriamali 2023.
dholuo: Riwruokwa mar bedo jolok ohala e higa mar 2023.
somali: Isdhexgalka ganacsiga 2023.

english: Integrate music education 2022.
ekegusii: Renta amo chisemi chiechingero 2022.
kiswahili: Unganisha elimu ya muziki 2022.
dholuo: Ti kod somo mar thum e higa 2022.
somali: Isku dar waxbarashada muusikada sanadka 2022.

english: Integrate values education 2022.
ekegusii: Renta amo chingencho chiobuya, obwegenwa na obokoreri obuya ase chisemi 2022.
kiswahili: Unganisha thamani za elimu 2022.
dholuo: Ti gi puonj kod chike mag ngima e higa mar 2022.
somali: Isku-darka qiimaha waxbarashada 2022.

english: Intern teachers salary rises to Ksh 55,000 + medical cover from Jan!
ekegusii: Omosaara bwabarimu baria bakwegera gosomia sokinire goika chisiringi 55,000 amo nobobwenia gochakera omotienyi omotangani!
kiswahili: Mshahara wa walimu wa mafunzo ya ndani waongezeka hadi Ksh 55,000 + bima ya matibabu kuanzia Januari!
dholuo: Chudo mag jopuonj ma oket e tich medore maromo Ksh 55,000 + thieth chakre Januar!
somali: Mushaharka macalimiinta xirfadlayaasha ah ayaa kor u kacaya Ksh 55,000 + caymis caafimaad laga bilaabo Janaayo!

english: Intern teachers' salary jumps to Ksh 50,000 from January – TSC confirms!
ekegusii: Omosaara bwabarimu baria bakwegera gosomia otumire gochia chisiringi 50,000 korwa omotienyi omotangani, Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu TSC giaitabire!
