dholuo: Puonjri bedo japur! Ket weche mag pur e skunde.
somali: Waxbarashada beeraha iskuulka ku dar.

english: Learn on the job! Join apprenticeship programs in industries.
ekegusii: Somera emeremo yao! Soa amasomo yebiasara ao ao ase chifactori.
kiswahili: Jifunze kazini! Jiunge na programu za uanagenzi katika tasnia.
dholuo: Puonjri timo kamano sama in e tich! Bed achiel kuom jogo matimo tiegruok mar apprenticeship e tije mopogore opogore.
somali: Waxbarashada shaqada! Ku biir barnaamijyada tababarka ee warshadaha.

english: Learners sitting for Kenya Primary School Education Assessment (KPSEA) and Kenya Junior School Education Assessment (KJSEA) will now be required to shade their answers using Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) sheets
ekegusii: Abana baria bagochia gokora amatemwa na korengwa echikuru chiboroso (KPSEA) nabana bechisekenderi chia inse (KJSEA) bono mbagaberigwe kongororia amachibu yamatemwa abo ase risakara riria riamatemwa.
kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanaofanya Tathmini ya Elimu ya Shule ya Msingi ya Kenya (KPSEA) na Tathmini ya Elimu ya Shule ya Wadogo ya Kenya (KJSEA) sasa watahitajika kuficha majibu yao kwa kutumia karatasi za Utambuzi wa Alama za Optical (OMR).
dholuo: Jopuonjre mobiro e penj mar Kenya Primary School Education Assessment (KPSEA) kod Kenya Junior School Education Assessment (KJSEA) koro biro dwaro ni gipiem dwoko margi ka gitiyo gi Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) sheets
somali: Ardayda ku fadhiya Qiimaynta Waxbarashada Dugsiyada hoose ee Kenya (KPSEA) iyo Qiimaynta Waxbarashada Dugsiyada hoose ee Kenya (KJSEA) ayaa hadda looga baahan doonaa inay jawaabooda hoos u dhigaan iyagoo adeegsanaya waraaqaha Aqoonsiga Calaamadaha Optical Mark (OMR)

english: Listeners win airtime by answering civic questions
ekegusii: Abategereri eredio baranyare koiraneria amaborio igoro yobogesaku mbaegwe ribaga goaka chisimi chiabo bosa koiraneria amaborio.
kiswahili: Wasikilizaji hushinda muda wa matangazo kwa kujibu maswali ya kiraia
dholuo: Jowinjo yudo thuolo mar chiwo dwoko e wi penjo ma ji penjo
somali: Dhageystayaashu waxay ku guuleystaan waqtiga baahinta iyagoo ka jawaabaya su'aalaha bulshada

english: Literacy platform expands into Kenyan public schools.
ekegusii: Amasomo gokonya gosoma ebitabu agareigwe goika chisukuru chionsi chieserikari.
kiswahili: Jukwaa la kusoma na kuandika lapanuka hadi shule za umma za Kenya.
dholuo: Chenro mar somo kod ndiko medo tiyo e skunde mag sirkal e piny Kenya.
somali: Barnaamijka akhriska ayaa lagu ballaariyaa dugsiyada dadweynaha ee Kenya.

english: Live CBC Grade 8 revision marathon starts 4PM daily – join free on KICD YouTube!
ekegusii: Amairorero yamasomo a CBC goetera etibi TV kera rituko arengete abana begeredi kia 8 ngochaka are chinsa ikomi chia mogoroba, soa otari goakana kende goetera KICD YouTube!
kiswahili: Marathon ya marekebisho ya darasa la 8 ya CBC inaanza saa 4 usiku kila siku jiunge bure kwenye KICD YouTube!
dholuo: Live CBC Grade 8 revision marathon chakore 4PM pile ka pile riwri nono e KICD YouTube!
somali: Marathon-ka dib-u-eegista ee CBC ee fasalka 8aad wuxuu bilaabmayaa 4pm maalin kasta

english: Live Grade 9 CBC revision starts 5PM daily – free on Education YouTube channel!
ekegusii: Amasomo yokoirorera amaiso marore ase abana bageredi 9 a CBC ngochaka are chinsa 11 chiamiogoroba kera rituko, chisemi chia bosa goetera YouTube channel!
kiswahili: Marekebisho ya moja kwa moja ya CBC ya Daraja la 9 huanza saa 5PM kila siku bila malipo kwenye kituo cha Elimu cha YouTube!
dholuo: Live Grade 9 CBC revision chakore 5PM pile pile nono e Education YouTube channel!
somali: Dib-u-eegista tooska ah ee fasalka 9aad ee CBC waxay bilaabmaysaa 5PM maalin kasta oo bilaash ah kanaalka YouTube-ka ee Waxbarashada!

english: Live KCSE 2025 prediction marathon starts 6PM daily – free on KICD channel!
ekegusii: Amasomo amaiso marore buna ekiorokererio kia ayagochi koba esekenderi KCSE 2025 kera rituko ngochaka ore chinsa 12 chiamogoroba kera rituko, abosa goetera emeroberio ya KICD!
kiswahili: Marathon ya utabiri wa moja kwa moja ya KCSE 2025 inaanza saa 12 jioni kila siku bila malipo kwenye kituo cha KICD!
dholuo: KCSE 2025 marathon mar ng'eyo weche mabiro timore chakore saa 6 odhiambo pile ka pile e KICD channel!
somali: KCSE 2025 marathon-ka saadaasha tooska ah wuxuu bilaabmayaa 6PM maalin kasta oo bilaash ah kanaalka KICD!

english: Maintain playgrounds safely 2021.
ekegusii: Ikerania amchiko ase chiogosori 2021.
kiswahili: Tunza viwanja vya michezo kwa usalama mwaka 2021.
dholuo: Rit maber kuonde tugo e higa mar 2021.
somali: Hagaajinta goobaha ciyaaraha si ammaan ah 2021.

english: Maintain school infrastructure 2023.
ekegusii: Renda oboikeranu bwamaagacho yesukuru 2023.
kiswahili: Kudumisha miundombinu ya shule 2023.
dholuo: Rit maber chenro mag skunde 2023.
somali: In la ilaaliyo kaabayaasha dugsiga sanadka 2023.

english: Make schools accessible! Install ramps for disabled students.
ekegusii: Rora ng'a abana bonsi (abaremaru gose bare nokongu ao ao) mbare neribaga gosoa esukuru! Karwe ebinto biria bigonya bari batari konyara gotenenena na kogenda.
kiswahili: Fanya shule zipatikane! Weka njia panda kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu.
dholuo: Timuru mondo ji duto oyud thuolo mar dhi e skul! Ket kuonde ma nyithindo nyalo idhogo.
somali: Iskuulada ka dhig mid la heli karo, ardayda naafada ah u rakib.

english: Modernize learning! Install smart boards in classrooms.
ekegusii: Kora ogosoma okoyia! Ibeka ebinto biria biokoererania chinkwana gati yabarimu nabana ase eborore biebirasi ime.
kiswahili: Boresha ujifunzaji! Sakinisha mbao mahiri darasani.
dholuo: Timuru dongruok e yore mag puonjruok! Ket board e klas.
somali: Waxbarashada casriyeeyso! Ku rakib looxyo casri ah fasallada.

english: Monitor air quality in schools 2024.
ekegusii: Bwatia komanya nga embeo nengiya esuchuku 2024.
kiswahili: Fuatilia ubora wa hewa shuleni 2024.
dholuo: Non chal mar muya e skunde 2024.
somali: Kormeerka tayada hawada ee dugsiyada 2024.

english: Monitor cyberbullying 2023.
ekegusii: Bwatia komanya gose abana ngocheganuia bare goetera eintaneti 2023.
kiswahili: Fuatilia unyanyasaji mtandaoni 2023.
dholuo: Non kaka ji tiyo gi intanet e higa mar 2023.
somali: La soco dhibaatada internetka sanadka 2023.

english: Monitor learning outcomes 2025.
ekegusii: Bwatia komanya amatokeo yamasomo abana 2025.
kiswahili: Fuatilia matokeo ya kujifunza 2025.
dholuo: Luwo gik ma ji puonjore e higa 2025.
somali: Raadinta natiijooyinka barashada 2025.

english: Monitor nutrition in school feeding programs 2020.
ekegusii: Bwatia komanya gose omoroberio bwendagera abana bakoria esukuru ng'a nebwenerate 2020.
kiswahili: Fuatilia lishe katika programu za kulisha shuleni 2020.
dholuo: Luwo wach chiemo e chenro mag pidho nyithindo e skul e higa mar 2020.
somali: La soco nafaqada barnaamijyada quudinta dugsiga 2020.

english: Monitor nutrition programs 2024.
ekegusii: Bwatia komanya gose emeroberio bwendagera nobwenerete omwaka 2024.
kiswahili: Fuatilia programu za lishe 2024.
dholuo: Non program mag chiemo e higa 2024.
somali: La soco barnaamijyada nafaqada ee 2024.

english: Monitor student attendance post-COVID 2021.
ekegusii: Bwatia komanya buna abana bagocha esukuru nyuma yendwari yenya'maa - KORONA omwaka 2021.
kiswahili: Fuatilia mahudhurio ya wanafunzi baada ya COVID 2021.
dholuo: Luwre kod kwan mar jopuonjre bang' COVID 2021.
somali: Kormeerka ka qaybgalka ardayda ka dib COVID 2021.

english: Motivate teachers! Offer bonuses for rural school postings.
ekegusii: Kae abarimi omoyo! Karwe chinyomba chiokomenya ase abarimu baria bagotomwa gochia chisukuru chia risabu.
kiswahili: Wahamasishe walimu! Toa bonasi kwa nafasi za shule za vijijini.
dholuo: Jiw jopuonj! Chiw mich mag pesa ne joma dhi e skunde man kuonde maboyo.
somali: Dhiirigelinta macalimiinta! Bixi gunno shaqooyinka dugsiyada miyiga.

english: Multi-agency team monitors school safety during KCSE exams.
ekegusii: Etimu ya yechiminisitiri amo nebiombe binde nkorigereria bare igoro yoborendi bwechisukuru ekero chogokora amatemwa esekenderi (KCSE).
kiswahili: Timu ya mashirika mengi hufuatilia usalama wa shule wakati wa mitihani ya KCSE.
dholuo: Grube ma nigi tije mopogore opogore nono chal mar kuonde somo e kinde penj mag KCSE.
somali: Koox ka kooban hay'ado badan ayaa kormeera ammaanka dugsiga inta lagu jiro imtixaannada KCSE.

english: New Competency-Based Curriculum for TVET launched – download free from KICD.
ekegusii: Omoroberio bwokorosia chisemi chiria chirengete okwenyara gwa kera omwana nechisemi chiokwegendereria (CBC) ase cikorechi chiobobundi na tekinorochi (TVET) oansirwe, yonyore bosa korwa KICD.
kiswahili: Mtaala Mpya Unaozingatia Umahiri wa TVET ulizinduliwa na – pakua bure kutoka KICD.
dholuo: Ne ochak chenro manyien mar tiegruok kuom lony e yore mag tiegruok gi lony e yore mag TVET ma ng'ato nyalo download nono e KICD.
somali: Barnaamijka cusub ee TVET ee ku saleysan aqoonta ayaa la bilaabay si lacag la'aan ah loogu soo dejiyo KICD.

english: New green-energy TVET curriculum launched – free download on KICD site now!
ekegusii: Chikorechi chiobobundi na tekinorochia (TVET) chiaansire omoroberio bwamasomo yechinguru chiomorero chinyia, yanyore bosa korwa omoroberio o'KICD bono!
kiswahili: Mtaala mpya wa TVET wa nishati ya kijani ulizinduliwa "upakuaji wa bure kwenye tovuti ya KICD sasa!"
dholuo: Chenro manyien mar tiegruok e yore mag TVET ma tiyo gi teko mar lowo ne ochak download e websait mar KICD sani!
somali: Barnaamijka cusub ee TVET ee tamarta cagaaran ayaa la bilaabay si bilaash ah loogu soo dejiyo bogga KICD hadda!

english: No arson in schools! Keep flammables away from dorms.
ekegusii: Sukuru tichisambwa! Beka omorero are korwa nechinyomba chiokorara.
kiswahili: Hakuna uchomaji moto shuleni! Weka vifaa vya kuwaka moto mbali na mabweni.
dholuo: Onge wang'o ji e skul! Rit gik manyalo wang' gi mach kik donj e udi.
somali: Iskuullada dab-damiska ha ka dhigin.

english: No changes to KCSE 2025 timetable after October 1.
ekegusii: Omoroberio buna amatemwa agochia gokorwa KCSE 2025 togootoranwa nyuma yetariki 1 omotienyi 10.
kiswahili: Hakuna mabadiliko kwenye ratiba ya KCSE 2025 baada ya Oktoba 1.
dholuo: Onge lokruok e chenro mar KCSE 2025 bang' Oktoba 1.
somali: Ma jiro wax isbeddel ah oo ku yimaada jadwalka KCSE 2025 ka dib 1da Oktoobar.

english: No child left behind: 100% transition from primary to secondary enforced nationwide.
ekegusii: Mwana taro oratigare magega: 1Emia ase emia (00%) goika bamboke korwa chisukuru chioboroso gochia chisekenderi obekirwe chinguru onsi Kenya.
kiswahili: Hakuna mtoto aliyeachwa nyuma: Mpito wa 100% kutoka shule ya msingi hadi shule ya upili unatekelezwa kote nchini.
dholuo: Onge nyathi moro amora mowe chien: lokruok mar 100% koa e skul mar praimar nyaka e sekondar osemi teko e piny mangima.
somali: Ilmo la'aan: 100% gudbinta dugsiga koowaad ilaa dugsiga koowaad waxaa lagu qasbay dalka oo dhan.

english: No child to repeat Grade 6 – automatic promotion to JSS enforced nationwide!
ekegusii: mwana onde tari orairorere egeredi gia 6 korende gosoa ebirasi biechisekenderi chia inse (JSS) yabebikwe chinguri Kenya engima!
kiswahili: Hakuna mtoto wa kurudia Daraja la 6 – kupandishwa cheo kiotomatiki kwa JSS kunatekelezwa kote nchini!
dholuo: Onge nyathi ma biro nwoyo somo mar 6 ma biro miyo okete e JSS e piny mangima!
somali: Ilmaha aan ku celcelin fasalka 6-aad ee kor u qaadista tooska ah ee JSS ee dalka oo dhan lagu qasbay!

english: No entry without uniform and ID from January 6, 2025.
ekegusii: Gosoa tikoiyo onye tobwati eyunifomu nekebande korwa chitariki 6 chiomotienyi 1, omwaka 2025.
kiswahili: Hakuna kiingilio bila sare na kitambulisho kuanzia Januari 6, 2025.
dholuo: Ok oyiene ng'ato donjo ka oonge gi yunifom kod ID chakre Januar 6, 2025.
somali: Ma jiro wax soo galo ah oo aan lahayn uniform iyo aqoonsi laga bilaabo 6-da Janaayo 2025.

english: No fees for public primary – report any demand to 0800721490 immediately!
ekegusii: Sukuru fisi ende teiyo eraakanwe ase chisukuru chioboroso, karwe amangana igoro yogosabwa besa chinde chionsi goetera enamba yesimi eye 0800721490 erio kegima!
kiswahili: Hakuna ada kwa ajili ya shule za msingi za umma toa taarifa kuhusu ombi lolote kwa 0800721490 mara moja!
dholuo: Onge chudo moro amora ne sirkal mar Primary. Ka ng'ato dwaro kony, goch ne 0800721490 mapiyo!
somali: Lacag la'aan doorashooyinka doorashooyinka dadweynaha si dhakhso leh ugu soo sheeg codsi kasta 0800721490!

english: No learner to be locked out for lack of uniform – principals warned!
ekegusii: Mwana onde tari oratangwe gosoa sukuru ekiagera atabwati eyunifomu, barimu abanene baonyirwe
kiswahili: Hakuna mwanafunzi atakayefungiwa nje kwa kukosa sare za shule, "wakuu wa shule walionya!"
dholuo: Onge japuonjre mabiro bedo oko nikech onge japuonj maduong' morwakore gi yunifom!
somali: Ma jiro arday lagu xiro dhar la'aantiis, macallimiinta ayaa ka digay!

english: OMR answer sheets for KPSEA 2025 now use circles instead of lines.
ekegusii: Etekinorochi yokomaki amatemwa ase okororera ritemwa rimakirie (OMR) ase okorenga amatemwa yeschisukuru chioboroso (KPSEA) 2025 bono ata enoti na tari buna yarenge yokongororia.
kiswahili: Karatasi za majibu za OMR za KPSEA 2025 sasa zinatumia miduara badala ya mistari.
dholuo: Buge mag dwoko mag OMR mar KPSEA 2025 sani tiyo gi circles kar tiyo gi line.
somali: Bogga jawaabaha OMR ee KPSEA 2025 hadda waxay isticmaalaan wareegyo halkii ay ku jiri lahaayeen khadadka.

english: On May 5 2015 KUCCPS opened its portal for 2014 KCSE candidates to apply for TVET diploma and certificate courses with a deadline of June 15 2015.
ekegusii: Chitariki isano omotienyi 5 omwaka 2015 ekeombe keria getenenerete kegochora abana gochia chiyunifasiti nechikoregi (KUCCPS) nkiaigorete eintaneti yaye ase abana besekenderi baria bokorete amatemwa a KCSE omwaka 2014 batome ogosaba kwabo ase chikosi chiobundi, nechisemi chiokwegendereria (TVET) ase ekosi yechipuloma naboigo yechisatifiketi nyuma yechitariki 15 chiomotieni 6 omwaka 2015.
kiswahili: Mnamo Mei 5, 2015, KUCCPS ilifungua lango lake kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2014 kuomba kozi za stashahada na cheti cha TVET huku tarehe ya mwisho ikiwa Juni 15, 2015.
dholuo: Chieng' Mei 5 2015 KUCCPS noyawo portal mare ne joma dwaro KCSE e higa mar 2014 mondo gichiw kwayo mar dhi e tiegruok mag tiegruok gi lony e yore mag tiegruok gi lony e yore mag tiegruok gi lony e yore mag tiegruok gi lony e yore mag tiegruok gi lony e yore mag tiegruok gi lony e yore mag tiegruok gi lony e yore mag tiegruok gi lony e yore mag tiegruok gi lony e yore mag tiegruok kod lony e yore mag tiegruok gi lony e yore mag tiegruok gi lony e yore mag tiegruok e yore mag tiegruok kod lony e weche mag tiegruok gi lony e dwe mar Jun 15 2015.
somali: Bishii Maajo 5, 2015 KUCCPS waxay furtay boggeeda musharixiinta 2014 ee KCSE si ay u dalbadaan koorsooyinka shahaadada iyo shahaadada TVET iyada oo waqtigeedu yahay Juun 15, 2015.

english: Open doors! Integrate refugee students into national schools.
ekegusii: Igora emerangu! Anchera abana ba baria batamire chisegi korwa sobo ase chisuluru chinene .
kiswahili: Milango wazi! Wajumuishe wanafunzi wakimbizi katika shule za kitaifa.
dholuo: Yawuru dhoudi! Riwo jopuonjre ma oringo thuchegi lwedo e skunde mag jopinyno.
somali: albaabada u fur, ardayda qaxootiga ah iskuulada qaranka.

english: Organize career guidance days 2021.
ekegusii: Kabe nomoroberio bwerituko riokorwa ogosemia igoro yebinto abana bagochia gosomera 2021.
kiswahili: Panga siku za mwongozo wa kazi 2021.
dholuo: Chenro mar bedo gi odiechienge mag chiwo paro e wi tije 2021.
somali: Abaabulka maalmaha tababbarka xirfadaha 2021.

english: Organize debate clubs 2020.
ekegusii: Roberia koba nebiombe biokoenena obosemia 2020.
kiswahili: Panga vilabu vya mijadala 2020.
dholuo: Chenro mar goyo mbaka e kind ji e higa 2020.
somali: Ururinta kooxaha doodda 2020.

english: Organize exchange programs 2020.
ekegusii: Roberia koira abana chisukuru chinde koumerana na korora buna bagosoma 2020.
kiswahili: Panga programu za kubadilishana 2020.
dholuo: Loso chenro mag loko ji e higa mar 2020.
somali: Abaabulka barnaamijyada isweydaarsiga 2020.

english: Organize science fairs annually 2022.
ekegusii: Roberia koba nechingaki abana bagocha amo kworokania ebi bamany ire ebiyia ase obosayansi bwabo kera omwaka 2022.
kiswahili: Kuandaa maonyesho ya sayansi kila mwaka 2022.
dholuo: Loso nyasi mag sayans higa ka higa e higa 2022.
somali: Abaabulka bandhigyada cilmiga sanadlaha ah ee 2022.

english: Over 1.5 million learners placed in junior secondary – check SMS *222# now.
ekegusii: Goetania abana bagosoma emirioni eyemo nenusu 1basoire chisekenderi chia'nse, Manya goetera akarube agake gesimi ase ogoaka *222# bono.
kiswahili: Zaidi ya wanafunzi milioni 1.5 waliojiunga na shule ya upili ya junior angalia SMS *222# sasa.
dholuo: Jopuonjre mokalo milion 1.5 moket e sekondar mar sekondar nono SMS *222# sani.
somali: In ka badan 1.5 milyan oo arday ah oo ku jira dugsiga hoose ee dugsiga sare ayaa hadda hubinaya SMS *222#.

english: Parents in arid areas: Apply now for 15,000 secondary school scholarships – deadline Nov 30.
ekegusii: Abaibori bare ase chingongo chinyomo: Toma ogosaba kwogokonywa chibesa chieserikari gosomera esekenderi 15,000, nyuma ya chitariki 30 omotienyi 11.
kiswahili: Wazazi katika maeneo kame: Tuma maombi sasa kwa ufadhili wa masomo 15,000 wa shule za upili tarehe ya mwisho Novemba 30.
dholuo: Jonyuol modak e gwenge motwo: Kwauru sani mondo uyud buse 15,000 mag somo sekondari tarik mogik Novemba 30.
somali: Waalidiinta ku nool meelaha abaaruhu ku nool yihiin: hadda codso 15 kun oo deeq waxbarasho oo dugsiga sare ah 30ka Nofeembar.

english: Parents in slums: 50,000 full scholarships available – apply before Nov 30!
ekegusii: Abaiibori bamenyete chirandi: Chisiringi 50,000 chiamasomo amagima nchireo, chisabe nyuma yechitariki 30 omotienyi 11!
kiswahili: Wazazi katika makazi duni: Ufadhili kamili 50,000 unapatikana – tuma maombi kabla ya Novemba 30!
dholuo: Jonyuol modak e gwenge mag joma odhier: 50,000 mar burses mag somo ma nigi thuolo moromo orom kapok Nov 30!
somali: Waalidiinta ku nool xaafadaha foosha xun: 50,000 oo deeq waxbarasho oo dhamaystiran oo la heli karo ayaa la dalban karaa 30-ka Nofeembar!

english: Parents must register Grade 6 learners for KPSEA by February 28, 2025.
ekegusii: Abaibori goika barike abana babo bageredi 6 ase amaosomo yenasari KPSEA nyuma yechitariki 28 chiomotienyi 2 omwaka 2025.
kiswahili: Wazazi lazima wawaandikishe wanafunzi wa Darasa la 6 kwa KPSEA ifikapo Februari 28, 2025.
dholuo: Jonyuol nyaka ndiki jopuonjre mag klas 6 e KPSEA kapok ochopo tarik 28 Februar 2025.
somali: Waalidiintu waa inay diiwaangeliyaan ardayda fasalka 6aad ee KPSEA 28-ka Febraayo 2025.

english: Parents urged to enroll all children in free primary education before January 2025 deadline.
ekegusii: Abaibori basororirwe korika abana babo gosoa amasomo a bosa yechisukuru chioboro nyuma ya yomotienyi 1 omwaka 2025.
kiswahili: Wazazi wamehimizwa kuwaandikisha watoto wote katika elimu ya msingi bila malipo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya Januari 2025.
dholuo: Ne ojiw jonyuol mondo ondik nyithindgi duto e skul mar praimari maonge chudo kapok ochopo Januar 2025.
somali: Waalidiinta ayaa lagu booriyay in dhammaan caruurta lagu qoro waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ka hor taariikhda Janaayo 2025.

english: Parents, be alert! Report terror risks near schools.
ekegusii: Abaibori, bake maiso! Manyia abagambi igoro ya ingana rinde rionsi riranyare koreta obobe.
kiswahili: Wazazi, kuwa macho! Ripoti hatari za ugaidi karibu na shule.
dholuo: Jonyuol, beduru motang'! Nyis kama nitie jo mahundu machiegni gi skunde.
somali: Waalidiinta, ka digtoonaada!

english: Parents, engage! Attend school meetings to support education access.
ekegusii: Abaibori, kwanerana! Ikerana emesangerekano yesukuru gokonya bonsi konyora amasomo.
kiswahili: Wazazi, shiriki! Hudhuria mikutano ya shule ili kusaidia upatikanaji wa elimu.
dholuo: Jonyuol, beduru motang'! Dhi e chokruoge mag skul mondo ikony ji yudo somo.
somali: Waalidiinta, ka qaybqaada shirarka dugsiga si aad u taageerto helitaanka waxbarashada.

english: Parents, stay cautious! Monitor children to prevent abductions.
ekegusii: Abaibori, tigara maiso! Bwatia orogendo rwabana baino gokonya tibatabogorigwa gose koibwa.
kiswahili: Wazazi, kuwa mwangalifu! Wafuatilie watoto ili kuzuia utekaji nyara.
dholuo: Un jonyuol, beduru motang'! Rit nyithindo mondo kik ng'ato omakgi.

kiswahili: Punguza vikwazo! Omba ruzuku ya ada ya serikali kwa familia zenye kipato cha chini.
dholuo: Goluru gik manyalo geng'ou! Kwa kony mar sirkal kuom chulo osuru ne joot ma nigi pesa matin.
somali: Isticmaal lacago dowladeed oo loogu talagalay qoysaska dakhligoodu hooseeyo.

english: Reduce class sizes 2022.
ekegusii: Keania abana ase ebirasi 2022.
kiswahili: Punguza ukubwa wa madarasa 2022.
dholuo: Duoko kwan mar jopuonjre chien e higa mar 2022.
somali: Si loo yareeyo tirada fasallada sanadka 2022.

english: Refugee learners join public schools free from January – bring UNHCR card only.
ekegusii: Abana ba baria batemete chisegi korwa sobo basoe chisukuru chieserikari bosa gochakera omotienyi omotangani Renta ekadi ya UNHCR yoka.
kiswahili: Wanafunzi wakimbizi hujiunga na shule za umma bila malipo kuanzia Januari. Lete kadi ya UNHCR pekee.
dholuo: Jopuonjre ma oringo thuchegi donjo e skunde mag sirkal maonge chudo chakre dwe mar Januar mana ka giting'o kad mar UNHCR.
somali: Ardayda qaxootiga ah ee iskuulada dadweynaha ku biira bilaash laga bilaabo Janaayo waxay keenaan kaliya kaarka UNHCR.

english: Register all Grade 6 for KPSEA via CBA portal by February 28.
ekegusii: Rika abana bonsi bageredi 6 ase KPSEA goetera eintaneti ya CBA nyuma yechitariki 28 omotienyi 2.
kiswahili: Sajili wanafunzi wote wa Darasa la 6 kwa KPSEA kupitia lango la CBA ifikapo Februari 28.
dholuo: Inyalo riwo jogo duto man e klas mar 6 e KPSEA kokalo e CBA portal kapok tarik 28 Februar ochopo.
somali: Diiwaangelinta dhammaan fasalka 6 ee KPSEA iyada oo loo marayo bogga CBA 28-ka Febraayo.

english: Register as a voter today at your nearest public university – ID processing is free.
ekegusii: Erike buna omoaki chikura rero ase egetuo kiambarebare kieyunifasity yeserikari. Konyora ekebande mbosa.
kiswahili: Jiandikishe kama mpiga kura leo katika chuo kikuu cha umma kilicho karibu nawe. Usindikaji wa vitambulisho ni bure.
dholuo: Ndikri kaka jang'ad bura kawuono e yunivasiti mar sirkal ma ni machiegni kodi.
somali: Isdiiwaangelinta codbixiyaha maanta jaamacaddaada ugu dhow ee dadweynaha waa lacag la'aan.

english: Register for KCPE 2020 despite delays.
ekegusii: Erike gokora amatemwa KCPE omwaka 2020 nonya okonyorwa koreo.
kiswahili: Jisajili kwa KCPE 2020 licha ya kuchelewa.
dholuo: Ndikri ne KCPE 2020 kata obedo ni nitie pek moko.
somali: Diiwaangelinta KCPE 2020 inkastoo dib u dhac.

english: Repair schools! Rebuild flood-damaged infrastructure.
ekegusii: Rosia amaagacho esukuru aomogete! Agacha keboyia amaagacho asaretigwe nemegoko.
kiswahili: Rekebisha shule! Jenga upya miundombinu iliyoharibiwa na mafuriko.
dholuo: Loso skunde! Gedo manyien mar kuonde moting'ore gi lowo ma ne ataro oketho.
somali: Dhis dugsiyada, dib u dhiska kaabayaasha burburay fatahaadaha.

english: Report any school charging fees above Ksh 0 to 0800721490 – we are watching!
ekegusii: Karwe amang'ana igoro yasukuru ende yonsi egoakania chibesa goetania goetera 0800721490, ntorigereretie!
kiswahili: Ripoti ada zozote za shule zinazotoza zaidi ya Ksh 0 hadi 0800721490 – tunaangalia!
dholuo: Nyis skul moro amora ma kwano osuru maloyo Ksh 0 e 0800721490 waneno!
somali: Ka warbixi kharashaadka dugsiga ka sarreeya Ksh 0 ilaa 0800721490 waxaan daawaneynaa!

english: Report bullying incidents immediately.
ekegusii: Manyia abarimu kegima igoro ebikoro bigosaria oboamate gati ya bana.
kiswahili: Ripoti matukio ya unyanyasaji mara moja.
dholuo: Ka nitie wach moro ma chandi, ler wachno mapiyo.
somali: Si dhakhso ah u soo sheeg dhacdooyinka dhibaatada.

english: Report bullying instantly via 0800721524 – zero tolerance in all schools!
ekegusii: Manyia kegima ebikoro bigosaria oboamate gati ya bana. Goetera esimi 0800721524, Ogochika oko goikeranigwe chisukuru chionso!
kiswahili: Ripoti uonevu mara moja kupitia 0800721524 – kutovumilia kabisa katika shule zote!
dholuo: Lando wach luoro mapiyo kokalo 0800721524 zero tolerance e skunde duto!
somali: Si dhakhso ah ugu soo sheeg dhibaatada iskuulka 0800721524

english: Report exam malpractice to KNEC hotline 0800721490 during national exams.
ekegusii: Manyia KNEC igoro yoboibi bwa amatemwa goetera enamba yamorero 0800721490 ekero kia amatemwa
kiswahili: Ripoti makosa ya mtihani kwa simu ya dharura ya KNEC 0800721490 wakati wa mitihani ya kitaifa.
dholuo: Lando ketho mag penj ne KNEC hotline 0800721490 e kinde penj mag piny.
somali: Warbixinta khaladaadka imtixaanka ee khadka tooska ah ee KNEC 0800721490 inta lagu jiro imtixaannada qaranka.

english: Report issues! Schools, set up grievance systems.
ekegusii: Manyia igoro yobokong'u bonde bwonsi! Chisukuru, karwe ribaga riokomanyigwa emechando.
kiswahili: Ripoti masuala! Shule, weka mifumo ya malalamiko.
dholuo: Lando wach ma chandou! Skunde, keto chenro mag ng'ado bura.
somali: Iskuullada, nidaamyada cabashooyinka.

english: Report malpractice to KNEC hotline 0800721490.
ekegusii: Manyia KNEC igoro yoboibi bwa amatemwa goetera 0800721490.
kiswahili: Ripoti ukiukwaji wa sheria kwa simu ya dharura ya KNEC 0800721490.
dholuo: Nyis ji wach ketho e yore mag thieth e simo mar KNEC 0800721490.
somali: Warbixinta khaladaadka ku saabsan khadka tooska ah ee KNEC 0800721490.

english: Report malpractice to KNEC hotline during KCSE 2025.
ekegusii: Manyia KNEC igoro yoboibi bwa amatemwa goetera anamba ya morero ase amatemwa KCSE 2025.
kiswahili: Ripoti ukiukwaji wa sheria kwa simu ya dharura ya KNEC wakati wa KCSE 2025.
dholuo: Lando timbe maok kare ne KNEC hotline e kinde mar KCSE 2025.
somali: Warbixinta khaladaadka khadka tooska ah ee KNEC inta lagu jiro KCSE 2025.

english: Report malpractice to KNEC hotline.
ekegusii: Manyia KNEC igoro yoboibi bwa amatemwa goetera enamba yamorero.
kiswahili: Ripoti ukiukwaji wa sheria kwa simu ya dharura ya KNEC.
dholuo: Nyis KNEC ka nitie wach moro amora mar ketho chik.
somali: Warbixinta khaladaadka ku saabsan khadka tooska ah ee KNEC.

english: Report risks! Call police or teachers to prevent abductions.
ekegusii: Manya na komanyia abande igoro yomochando gose okogosereria konde gwonsi gotaraba! Rangeria abasikari gose omwarimi gotnga akoibwa kwa abana.
kiswahili: Ripoti hatari! Piga simu polisi au walimu ili kuzuia utekaji nyara.
dholuo: Nyis kama nitie hinyruok! Luong polise kata jopuonj mondo ogeng' mako ji.
somali: Wac booliska ama macalimiinta si looga hortago afduubka.

english: Report sexual harassment in school via 0800721524 – anonymous & free!
ekegusii: Manyia abarimu igoro yechingencho gati yabamura na abanyaroka gose chioboegi chintancheiri esukuru goetera 0800721524 otari kwemanyekania ase bosa!
kiswahili: Ripoti unyanyasaji wa kijinsia shuleni kupitia 0800721524 – bila kujulikana na bure!
dholuo: Lando achaye mag nindruok e skul kokalo e 0800721524 maonge ng'ama ong'eyo nying'no kendo nono nono!
somali: Ka warbixi dhibaatada galmada ee iskuulka 0800721524 si aan la aqoon oo lacag la'aan ah!

english: Residents bring questions on constitutional rights
ekegusii: Abamenyi renta amabori igoroyamachiko oboronge.
kiswahili: Wakazi wauliza maswali kuhusu haki za kikatiba
dholuo: Jokanyo kelo penjo e wi ratiro mag sirkal
somali: Dadka deggan waxay su'aalo ka weydiiyaan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah

english: Resolve conflicts peacefully! Report grievances to school boards.
ekegusii: Kora okominana nomorembe! Manyia amangana ogotaisaneka ase ekomiti yesukuru.
kiswahili: Tatua migogoro kwa amani! Ripoti malalamiko kwa bodi za shule.
dholuo: Tiuru gi Yore mag Loso Kuwe! Ka nitie wach moro ma chando chunyi, wuo gi jodong-skunde.
somali: Khilaafaadka nabadeed ku xaliya!

english: Resolve disputes! Train students in peer mediation.
ekegusii: Karue amangana igoro yogotaigwanana! Egeria abana enchera yokobwatana barabwo ase barabwo.
kiswahili: Tatua migogoro! Wafunze wanafunzi kuhusu upatanishi wa rika.
dholuo: Tiuru gi rieko e tieko ywaruok. Tiego jopuonjre e yore mag goyo mbaka gi jowetegi.
somali: Xallinta khilaafaadka!

english: Safe reopening: All schools must follow 10-point COVID protocol – CS orders!
ekegusii: Koigora mochando otaiyo: Chisukuru chionsi gika chibwatie amangana 10 igoro yogwetanga nenyamayaa. Ogochika kwomonisita bwechisemi!
kiswahili: Kufunguliwa tena kwa usalama: Shule zote lazima zifuate itifaki ya COVID ya pointi 10 - maagizo ya CS!
dholuo: Yawruok kendo: Skunde duto nyaka luw chike 10 mag chike mag COVID CS!
somali: Dib-u-furitaanka nabadgelyo leh: Dugsiyada oo dhan waa inay raacaan 10 qodob oo ka mid ah qawaaniinta COVID-ka ee amarrada CS!

english: Safe school transport: All matatus ferrying students must have speed governors!
ekegusii: Obobogoria obuya bwabana: Matatu chionsi chikobogoria abana goika chibe negento keria kegotanga orogendo rwaigoro!
kiswahili: Usafiri salama shuleni: Matatu zote zinazosafirisha wanafunzi lazima ziwe na vidhibiti mwendo!
dholuo: Wuoth maber mar dhi e skul: Jopuonjre duto ma ting'o matatu nyaka bed gi gik ma geng'o ng'wech!
somali: Gaadiidka iskuulka ee ammaan ah: Dhammaan ardayda maraakiibta matatus waa inay lahaadaan maamulayaasha xawaaraha!

english: Safe schools! Communities, protect schools from banditry.
ekegusii: Sukuru chitari namochando! Ebinyoro, renda chisukuru korwa oboibi gose obokebago
kiswahili: Shule salama! Jamii, linda shule dhidi ya ujambazi.
dholuo: Skunde mag geng'ruok! Jo gweng', rituru skunde kik hiny.
somali: Dugsiyada nabadgelyo leh, bulshooyinka, dugsiyada ka ilaalinta burcad-badeedda.

english: Safety audit by Sept 30 using 2008 Manual.
ekegusii: Okomanya nga chisukuru mbuya chire nyuma yechitariki 30 omotienyi 9 goetera egetabu kiomwaka 2008.
kiswahili: Ukaguzi wa usalama ifikapo Septemba 30 kwa kutumia Mwongozo wa 2008.
dholuo: Nonro mar ritruok nyaka chop Septemba 30 kotiyo gi buk mar 2008 miluongo ni Manual.
somali: Kormeerka ammaanka 30ka Sebtember iyadoo la adeegsanayo Buugga Guud ee 2008.

english: Safety guidelines for school reopening 2021.
ekegusii: Omoroberio omoikeranu gotanga obokongu ekero chisukuru chikoigora omwaka 2021.
kiswahili: Miongozo ya usalama kwa ajili ya kufungua tena shule 2021.
dholuo: Puonj mag ritruok e chako skul kendo 2021.
somali: Tilmaamaha badbaadada ee dib u furitaanka dugsiyada 2021.

english: Save water! Teach students water conservation in drought-prone areas.
ekegusii: Gacha amache! Somia abana buna bakogacha amache chingaki chiegurargura ase chingongo chiria chinyomo.
kiswahili: Okoa maji! Wafundishe wanafunzi uhifadhi wa maji katika maeneo yanayokabiliwa na ukame.
dholuo: Kik iketh pi! Puonj nyithindo kaka ginyalo tiyo gi pi e yo mowinjore kuonde ma oro ng'enyie.
somali: Biyaha badbaadi! ardayda baro sida loo badbaadiyo biyaha meelaha abaarta u nugul.

english: Say no to bribes! Report corrupt practices to EACC.
ekegusii: kana riaki! Mnyia ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokorekanu (EACC).
kiswahili: Kataa rushwa! Ripoti vitendo vya ufisadi kwa EACC.
dholuo: Tamri kawo asoya! Lando timbe mag mibadhi ne EACC.
somali: Dhibaatooyinka musuqmaasuqa u sheeg EACC.

english: Say no to FGM! Call 116 to report risks and protect girls.
ekegusii: Teba yaya ase ogokebwa kwabana abanyaroka (FGM)! Aka esimi 116 komanyia ngencho ende yonsi yogokebwa na korenda abanyaroka.
kiswahili: Sema hapana kwa ukeketaji! Piga simu 116 ili kuripoti hatari na kuwalinda wasichana.
dholuo: Wacho ni ooyo ne FGM! Luong namba 116 mondo inyisgo ni nitie hinyruok kendo rito nyiri.
somali: Wac 116 si aad u sheegto khataraha iyo ilaalinta gabdhaha.

english: School records full transition to high school, expands vocational training.
ekegusii: Esukuru yaikeranirie okwamboka gochia esekenderi ya igoro, garei chikirechi chinke
kiswahili: Shule inarekodi mpito kamili hadi shule ya upili, inapanua mafunzo ya ufundi.
dholuo: Skundego chiwo thuolo mondo nyithindo odonj e skunde mamalo, kendo gipuonjogi tije mopogore opogore.
somali: Dugsigu wuxuu diiwaangeliyaa gudbinta buuxda ee dugsiga sare, wuxuu ballaariyaa tababarka xirfadeed.

english: Schools closed for elections? Use the break to update your voter details via *222#.
ekegusii: Chisukuru chiasiekirwe ase engencho yobochori? Tumia ribaga eri komanya ng'a ekadi yao yogoka chikura mbuya ere getera *222#.
kiswahili: Shule zimefungwa kwa ajili ya uchaguzi? Tumia mapumziko kusasisha maelezo yako ya mpiga kura kupitia *222#.
dholuo: Be skunde ne olor nikech yiero? Ti gi thuolono mondo ilos weche mag kwan mari kokalo kuom *222#.
somali: Iskuulada ayaa la xiray doorashada? Isticmaal fasaxa si aad u cusbooneysiiso faahfaahinta codbixiyeyaashaada adoo isticmaalaya *222#.

english: Schools directed to hold mock elections to teach democratic process.
ekegusii: Chisukuru chiachikirwe gokora obochori bwabana kwegeria abana igoro yemeroberio yobochori eng'ikeranu.
kiswahili: Shule zaagizwa kufanya uchaguzi wa majaribio ili kufundisha mchakato wa kidemokrasia.
dholuo: Skunde ne ochik mondo otim yiero ma ok adier mondo gipuonj ji kaka sirkal tiyo gi demokrasi.
somali: Dugsiyada waxaa lagu amray in ay qabtaan doorasho been abuur ah si ay u bartaan habka dimuqraadiyadda.

english: Schools directed to install CCTV and employ guards for security.
ekegusii: Chisukuru chiachikirwe kobeka ebimiongeri amang'ana (CCTV) na korika abasikari ase oborendi.
kiswahili: Shule zaagizwa kufunga CCTV na kuajiri walinzi kwa ajili ya usalama.
dholuo: Skunde ne ochik mondo orwak kamera mag CCTV kendo tiyo gi jorit mag geng'o ji.
somali: Dugsiyada waxaa lagu amray in la rakibo CCTV iyo in la shaqaaleeyo ilaalada amniga.

english: Schools in Kenya will reopen from 12 October, starting with Grade 4, Class 8 and Form 4
ekegusii: Chisukuru Kenya nigo chiraigore gochakera chitariki 12 omotienyi 10, chigochakera abana bageredi 4, Kerasi 8 na abana besekenderi fomu 4
kiswahili: Shule nchini Kenya zitafunguliwa tena kuanzia tarehe 12 Oktoba, kuanzia darasa la 4, darasa la 8 na kidato cha 4.
dholuo: Skunde e Kenya biro chako tich kendo chakre Oktoba 12, chakre e Klasi mar 4, Klasi mar 8 kod Klasi mar 4
somali: Dugsiyada Kenya ayaa dib loo furi doonaa 12-ka Oktoobar, laga bilaabo fasalka 4, fasalka 8 iyo fasalka 4

english: Schools reopen after COVID-19 closure for Grade 4, 8, form 4.
ekegusii: Chisukuru nchigore motwe yogosiekwa ase engencho yenwari Yenyamayaa (COVID-19) ase abana bageredi 4, 8, na fomu 4.
kiswahili: Shule zitafunguliwa tena baada ya kufungwa kwa COVID-19 kwa Darasa la 4, 8, na kidato cha 4.
dholuo: Skunde chako kendo bang' COVID-19 kuom klas 4, 8, form 4.
somali: Dugsiyada ayaa dib loo furay ka dib xiritaanka COVID-19 fasalka 4, 8, foomka 4.

english: Schools reopen January 6 – no learner to be sent away for fees. Report violators to 0800721490 NOW!
ekegusii: Chisukuru nchigore chitariki 6 omotienyi omotang'ani, mwana onde tari oraserigwe ase engencho yogotaakana efisi. Manyia okobuna kwerichiko eri goetera 0800721490 BONO!
kiswahili: Shule zitafunguliwa tena Januari 6 – hakuna mwanafunzi atakayefukuzwa kwa ajili ya karo. Waripoti wanaokiuka sheria kwa 0800721490 SASA!
dholuo: Skunde chako kendo Januar 6 onge japuonjre ma ibiro riemb nikech chudo. Riw jogo moketho chik e 0800721490 KINDEGI!
somali: Dugsiyada dib ayaa loo furayaa 6-da Janaayo, wax arday ah looma dirayo lacag.

english: Schools reopen on January 6, 2025 for Term 1 of the academic year.
ekegusii: Chisukuru nigo chikoigora chitariki 6 chiomotienyi omotangani 2025 ase etamu entang'ani 1 yomwaka bwechisemi.
kiswahili: Shule zitafunguliwa tena Januari 6, 2025 kwa Muhula wa 1 wa mwaka wa masomo.
dholuo: Skunde chako kendo tarik 6 Januar, 2025 e Tijwa Mokwongo mar higa mar somo.
somali: Dugsiyada dib ayaa loo furayaa 6-da Janaayo 2025, muddada 1aad ee sanadka tacliinta.

english: Schools start third term August 25, 2025.
ekegusii: Chisukuru chigore etamu ya gatato chitariki 25 chiomotienyi 8, 2025.
kiswahili: Shule zinaanza muhula wa tatu Agosti 25, 2025.
dholuo: Skunde chako semester mar adek tarik 25 Agost 2025.
somali: Dugsiyada waxay bilaabi doonaan fasalka saddexaad August 25, 2025.

english: Schools to hold mock elections every term – new CBC requirement.
ekegusii: Chisukuru nchibe nobochori bwoborai bwabana kera etamu buna ayaganeirie ase amasomo a'CBC.
kiswahili: Shule kufanya uchaguzi wa majaribio kila muhula kulingana na sharti jipya la CBC.
dholuo: Skunde biro bedo gi yiero moro amora ma ok adier e kinde mar somo kaluwore gi chike manyien mag CBC.
somali: Dugsiyada inay qabtaan doorashooyin been abuur ah xilli kasta shuruudaha cusub ee CBC.

english: schools to remain closed for the rest of the year and reopen in 2021. All national exams to be taken in 2020 have been canceled ~ CS George Magoha
ekegusii: Chisukuru nchitigare gosiekwa ase omwaka omogima na koigorwa omwaka 2021. Amatemwa amanene are gokorwa 2020 ateneniigwe. Omominisita Bwechisemi George Magoha
kiswahili: Shule zitaendelea kufungwa kwa mwaka mzima na kufunguliwa tena mwaka wa 2021. Mitihani yote ya kitaifa itakayofanywa mwaka wa 2020 imefutwa ~ Waziri George Magoha
dholuo: skunde biro siko ka olor kuom higa mangima to ibiro yawgi kendo e higa mar 2021. Pim duto mag piny 2020 osegol oko ~ CS George Magoha
somali: Dugsiyada ayaa la xiray sanadka oo dhan waxaana dib loo furi doonaa sanadka 2021. Dhammaan imtixaannada qaranka ee la qaadan doono sanadka 2020 ayaa la joojiyay ~ CS George Magoha

english: Secure data privacy 2021.
ekegusii: Renda amangana arikire yesukuru taikerwa gose gotumeka bobe 2021.
kiswahili: Faragha salama ya data 2021.
dholuo: Rito weche mag data e higa mar 2021.
somali: Keydinta xogta sirta ah 2021.

english: Secure exam materials 2021.
ekegusii: Renda amatemwa namachibu taibwa 2021.
kiswahili: Vifaa vya mtihani salama 2021.
dholuo: Rit maber gik mitiyogo e penj mar 2021.
somali: Waxyaabaha imtixaanka 2021 ee ammaanka ah.

english: Secure funding for bursaries 2025.
ekegusii: Nyora chibesa chiechibasari 2025.
kiswahili: Ufadhili wa uhakika kwa ajili ya ufadhili wa masomo 2025.
dholuo: Yudo pesa mag bursaries 2025.
somali: Si loo helo maalgelin loo helo deeq waxbarasho sanadka 2025.

english: Secure nomads! Protect mobile schools from risks.
ekegusii: Renda baria bakong'anyang'anya! Renda chisukuru chiria chikong'anyang'anya korwa ase bokong'u bonde bwonsi.
kiswahili: Wafugaji salama! Linda shule zinazotembea kutokana na hatari.
dholuo: Rituru jowuoth! Rituru skunde mawuok kuonde mopogore opogore kik hinygi.
somali: Reer guuraa badbaado leh! Ka ilaali dugsiyada reer guuraaga khatarta.

english: Secure schools against theft and vandalism 2021.
ekegusii: Renda ebinto biesukuru tibisarigwa nechibesa tichibwa gose gosarigwa 2021.
kiswahili: Kuhakikisha shule zinapata usalama dhidi ya wizi na uharibifu 2021.
dholuo: Rito skunde kuom kuo kod kethruok 2021.
somali: Dugsiyada ka badbaadi xadgudubka iyo burburka 2021.

english: Secure schools! Implement terror prevention measures.
ekegusii: Renda chisukuru! Beka emeroberio korenda ng'a ebinto biesukuru mbuya bire, abana nabarimu boigo mbuya bare korwa.
kiswahili: Kulinda shule! Tekeleza hatua za kuzuia ugaidi.
dholuo: Rituru skunde! Tiuru gi yore mag geng'o timbe mahundu.
somali: Dugsiyada nabadgelyo! Qaado tallaabooyinka ka hortagga argagixisada.

english: Secure schools! Install security measures against banditry
ekegusii: Renda chisukuru! Beka ebinto biria bioborendi bikomoreka obokebago bonde bwonsi.
kiswahili: Kuweka shule salama! Weka hatua za usalama dhidi ya ujambazi
dholuo: Rituru skunde! Ket yore mag geng'o jomecho
somali: Dugsiyada nabadgelyo!

english: Secure schools! Prepare for landslides in high-risk areas.
ekegusii: Renda chisukuru! Eagariganie mapema gokonya omochando bwokwanyoka kweriroba chinsemo chirkwanyoka.
kiswahili: Shule salama! Jiandae kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika maeneo yenye hatari kubwa.
dholuo: Rituru skunde! Ikri ne kuonde ma lowo nyalo lwarie.
somali: Dugsiyada nabadgelyo leh, diyaar u noqo dhulgariir ku dhaca meelaha khatarta sare leh.

english: Secure wireless networks 2021.

dholuo: Tieguru jopuonj! Kony jopuonjre duto mondo opuonjre e yor kompyuta.
somali: Tababar barayaasha! Taageero barashada dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda oo dhan.

english: Train teachers! Support inclusive education for disabled students.
ekegusii: Somia abarimu! Sira amasomo a bionsi ase abana bare noboremaru ao ao.
kiswahili: Wafunze walimu! Saidia elimu jumuishi kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu.
dholuo: Tieguru jopuonj! Konyuru jopuonjre ma nigi midekre mondo oyud tiegruok maber.
somali: Tababarka macalimiinta! Taageero waxbarasho oo dhanka ah oo loogu talagalay ardayda naafada ah.

english: Train teachers! Teach cholera prevention in schools.
ekegusii: Somia abarimu! Somia buna oranyare gotanga endwari yogosaa esukuru.
kiswahili: Wafundishe walimu! Wafundishe kuzuia kipindupindu shuleni.
dholuo: Tieguru jopuonj! Puonjuru nyithindo kaka ginyalo geng'o kolera.
somali: Waxbarashada ka hortagga kolera dugsiyada.

english: Train teachers! Teach protest safety protocols.
ekegusii: Somia abarimu! Somia igoro yokwerenda ekero giechiburaburru esukuru.
kiswahili: Wafundishe walimu! Wafundishe itifaki za usalama wa maandamano.
dholuo: Tieguru jopuonj! Puonjgi yore mag ritruok sama itimo nyasi.
somali: Tababar macallimiinta, baro nidaamyada badbaadada banaanbaxyada.

english: Travel safely! Use designated safe routes to school in conflict zones.
ekegusii: Renda kore ese orgendo! Etera chinchera chingiya arria ase chngongo chire neminano.
kiswahili: Safiri salama! Tumia njia salama zilizotengwa kwenda shuleni katika maeneo yenye migogoro.
dholuo: Dhi maber! Ti gi yore moket mag chopo e skul kuonde ma lweny nitie.
somali: Si nabadgelyo leh u safra! Isticmaal waddooyinka ammaanka ah ee lagu magacaabo dugsiga meelaha colaadu ka taagan tahay.

english: Treasury gamifies budget learning for young audiences.
ekegusii: Tumia amangana echigosori nechinkwana erio kworokereria igoro yamangana echibesa ase abana abake.
kiswahili: Hazina hucheza kamari kuhusu ujifunzaji wa bajeti kwa hadhira changa.
dholuo: Treasury miyo somo mar budget obed mayot ne rowere.
somali: Wasaaradda Maaliyadda waxay barashada miisaaniyadda u dhigtaa mid cajiib ah dhagaystayaasha dhalinyarada ah.

english: Treasury introduces online tools for public finance monitoring.
ekegusii: Ekegancha ekenene giechibesa giansire ebikoreri bieintaneti komongera buna chibesa chigokora emeremo.
kiswahili: Hazina yaanzisha zana za mtandaoni za ufuatiliaji wa fedha za umma.
dholuo: Treasury chako tiyo gi intanet e nono pesa mag sirkal.
somali: Wasaaradda Maaliyadda waxay soo bandhigtay qalab internetka ah oo lagu maareynayo maaliyadda dadweynaha.

english: Tune in EduTV 8–10 AM for CBC lessons.
ekegusii: Beka eredio gose Etibi - EduTV chinsa 4 chia mambia ase amasomo CBC.
kiswahili: Tumia EduTV 8–10 AM kwa masomo ya CBC.
dholuo: Beduru e program mar EduTV 810 AM mondo uwinj puonj mag CBC.
somali: Hagaajinta EduTV saacadaha 8 iyo 10 subaxnimo ee casharrada CBC.

english: Tune in to EduTV Channel daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM for CBC lessons.
ekegusii: Beka eredio gose Etibi - EduTV kera rituko gochakera chinsa 2 chia mambia gika chinsa 4 gotegerera CBC.
kiswahili: Tumia EduTV Channel kila siku kuanzia saa 8:00 AM hadi saa 10:00 AM kwa masomo ya CBC.
dholuo: Beduru e chanel mar EduTV pile ka pile chakre sa 8:00 okinyi nyaka sa 10:00 okinyi mondo uyud puonj mag CBC.
somali: Dhageyso kanaalka EduTV maalin kasta saacadaha 8:00 subaxnimo ilaa 10:00 subaxnimo casharrada CBC.

english: Tune in to EduTV daily 8–10 AM for CBC lessons.
ekegusii: Beka eredio gose Etibi - EduTV kera rituko gochakera chinsa 2 goika chinsa 4 chia mambia otegerere amasomo CBC.
kiswahili: Tumia EduTV kila siku saa 8:00 AM kwa masomo ya CBC.
dholuo: Luwreuru gi program mar EduTV pile ka pile e sa 10 okinyi mondo uwinj puonj mag CBC.
somali: Ku dheji EduTV maalin kasta saacadaha 8 iyo 10 subaxnimo si aad u hesho casharrada CBC.

english: Tune in to Kenya Education Cloud for Grade 4–8 CBC lessons.
ekegusii: Beka eredio gose Etibi - Kenya Education Cloud ase abana bageredi 8 gotegerera amasomo CBC.
kiswahili: Tumia EduTV Cloud ya Elimu ya Kenya kwa masomo ya CBC ya Darasa la 4–8.
dholuo: Luw Kenya Education Cloud mondo iyud somo mag CBC mar klas mar 48.
somali: Ku dheji Kenya Education Cloud si aad u hesho casharrada CBC ee fasalka 4-aad.

english: Universities collaborate to provide virtual library resources universally accessible to all enrolled students.
ekegusii: Chiyunifasiti nkobwaterana chire korwa ebinto biogosomera goetra eintnaeti ase abana bonsi besukuru.
kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vinashirikiana kutoa rasilimali za maktaba pepe zinazopatikana kwa wanafunzi wote waliojiandikisha.
dholuo: Yunivasiti tiyo kanyachiel mondo gichiw gik ma yudore e laibrari e yo mayot ma jopuonjre duto nyalo tiyogo.
somali: Jaamacadaha waxay iskaashi la sameeyaan si ay u bixiyaan khayraadka maktabadda dalwaddii oo si caalami ah loo heli karo dhammaan ardayda diiwaangashan.

english: Universities encouraged to develop and utilize Open Educational Resources (OER) for wider access to learning materials.
ekegusii: Chiyunifasity chiasegirwe korosia na gotumia ebinto biogosomera bigoikerwa na gosomwa bosa batari goakane kende (OER) kogarei na goikera gosomia na gosoma.
kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vinahimizwa kutoa mafunzo kuhusu teknolojia zinazoibuka ili kuwaandaa wanafunzi kwa ajili ya masoko ya kazi ya siku zijazo.
dholuo: Ne ojiw yunivasiti mondo olos kendo oti gi Open Educational Resources (OER) mondo giyud gik ma ginyalo puonjorego.
somali: Jaamacadaha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa in ay horumariyaan oo ay adeegsadaan kheyraadka waxbarasho ee furan (OER) si ay u helaan waxyaabo waxbarasho oo ballaaran.

english: Universities urged to offer training on emerging technologies to prepare students for future job markets.
ekegusii: Chiyunifasiti chiasoroirwe korwa amasomo igoro yechitekinorochi chiabono aerio koarigania abana kwebeka ang'e ase echiro yemeremo abwo motwe.
kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi kutoa vifaa zaidi vya kozi vinavyopatikana kama Rasilimali Huria za Elimu (OER).
dholuo: Ne ojiw yunivasiti mondo ochiw tiegruok e yore manyien mag teknoloji mondo giik jopuonjre ne tije ma biro timore e kinde mabiro.
somali: Jaamacadaha ayaa lagu booriyay inay bixiyaan tababar ku saabsan tiknoolajiyada soo koraya si ay ardayda ugu diyaariyaan suuqyada shaqada mustaqbalka.

english: Update exam policies 2021.
ekegusii: Onhoreria amachiko amatemwa omwaka 2021.
kiswahili: Sasisha sera za mitihani 2021.
dholuo: Pim chike mag penj 2021.
somali: Cusboonaysii siyaasadaha imtixaanka 2021.

english: Update health protocols 2021.
ekegusii: Onchoreria emeroberio yobochenu omwaka 2021.
kiswahili: Sasisha itifaki za afya 2021.
dholuo: Pim chike mag thieth 2021.
somali: Cusboonaysiinta nidaamyada caafimaadka 2021.

english: Update safety standards 2022.
ekegusii: Onchoreria emeroberio yoborendi omwaka 2022.
kiswahili: Sasisha viwango vya usalama 2022.
dholuo: Lok chike mag rito ngima e higa mar 2022.
somali: Cusboonaysiinta heerarka badbaadada 2022.

english: Update school records digitally 2023.
ekegusii: Gesa chiroboti chiesukuru gedichitari omwaka 2023.
kiswahili: Sasisha rekodi za shule kidijitali 2023.
dholuo: Lok rekod mag skul e yor digital 2023.
somali: Cusboonaysiinta diiwaanka dugsiga si dijitaal ah sanadka 2023.

english: Upgrade dorms! Install fire exits in schools.
ekegusii: Agacha kebiyia! Beka emerangwa nechitirisa chiogotamera ekero omorero bwatekire esukuru.
kiswahili: Boresha mabweni! Sakinisha milango ya kutolea huduma za moto shuleni.
dholuo: Meduru kwan mar joma odak e uteu! Ket kuonde ma ji nyalo kaloe ka masira oneno e skunde.
somali: Hagaajinta qolalka, rakibida albaabada dab-damiska ee dugsiyada.

english: Upgrade facilities for inclusive education 2024.
ekegusii: Rosia ebirasi nebinto biogosomera ase okorwa chisemi ase bonsi omwaka 2024.
kiswahili: Boresha vifaa vya elimu jumuishi 2024.
dholuo: Med bero chenro mag somo ne ji duto e higa mar 2024.
somali: Hagaajinta xarumaha waxbarashada oo dhanka ah sanadka 2024.

english: Upgrade facilities! Install clean water systems in schools.
ekegusii: Agacha amaagacho amayia! Beka amache amarabu esukuru.
kiswahili: Boresha vifaa! Sakinisha mifumo ya maji safi shuleni.
dholuo: Medo lony e yore mag manyo mor! Ket pi maler e skunde.
somali: Hagaajinta xarumaha! Ku rakib nidaamyada biyaha nadiifka ah ee dugsiyada.

english: Upgrade ICT infrastructure 2021.
ekegusii: Beka ebito ebiyia bietekinorochia yamangana na gokwanerana ICT omwaka 2021.
kiswahili: Boresha miundombinu ya TEHAMA 2021.
dholuo: Med dongruok e yore mag ICT e higa mar 2021.
somali: Hagaajinta kaabayaasha ICT sanadka 2021.

english: Upgrade labs in secondary schools 2024.
ekegusii: Agacha chinyomba chiobosayansi xchinyia ase chisukuru chisekenderi omwaka 2024.
kiswahili: Boresha maabara katika shule za upili 2024.
dholuo: Med lony mar lab e skunde sekondar e higa mar 2024.
somali: Tijaabinta shaybaarada dugsiyada sare 2024.

english: Upgrade sanitation! Provide safe toilets to prevent cholera.
ekegusii: Agacha chinyomba chiobochenu chinyia! Beka chichoo chingiya gotanga endwari yogosaa.
kiswahili: Boresha usafi wa mazingira! Toa vyoo salama ili kuzuia kipindupindu.
dholuo: Med bero yore mag manyo ler! Chiw kuonde yweyo maber mondo ogeng' cholera.
somali: Hagaajinta nadaafadda! Bixi musqusha ammaanka ah si looga hortago cudurka kolera.

english: Upgrade teacher salaries 2020.
ekegusii: Gesa abarimu emesaara omwaka 2020.
kiswahili: Boresha mishahara ya walimu 2020.
dholuo: Meduru osuru mag jopuonj 2020.
somali: Hagaajinta mushaharka macalimiinta 2020.

english: Use digital learning tools in classrooms 2024.
ekegusii: Tumia ebinto biosomia biegedichitari ase ebirasi omwaka 2024.
kiswahili: Tumia zana za kujifunzia kidijitali madarasani 2024.
dholuo: Ti kod gige somo mag digital e klas 2024.
somali: Isticmaal qalabka barashada dhijitaalka ah ee fasalada 2024.

english: Used during Nairobi festivals
ekegusii: Yatumegete ekero giechisiri Nairobi.
kiswahili: Inatumika wakati wa sherehe za Nairobi
dholuo: Itiyo kode e kinde nyasi mag Nairobi
somali: Waxaa loo isticmaalaa xafladaha Nairobi

english: Used in Mandera civic awareness events
ekegusii: Yatumegete Mandera ekero giokomanyia abanto igoro yoboronge bwabo.
kiswahili: Inatumika katika matukio ya uhamasishaji wa raia Mandera
dholuo: Itiyo kode e Mandera e weche mag ng'eyo oganda
somali: Waxaa loo isticmaalaa munaasabadaha wacyiga bulshada ee Mandera

english: Vaccinate students against measles 2020.
ekegusii: Chancha abana gotanga orwaye omwaka 2020.
kiswahili: Wachanje wanafunzi dhidi ya surua 2020.
dholuo: Miyo jopuonjre chanjo mar midusi mar higa 2020.
somali: Tallaalka ardayda ka dhanka ah suuxdinta 2020.

english: Vaccinate your child before Jan 6 reopening – polio & measles jab mandatory!
ekegusii: Chancha abana bao nyuma yechitariki 6 omotienyi omotangani chisukuru gachikoigora, Echancho eye neyarasima!
kiswahili: Chanja mtoto wako kabla ya kufungua tena Januari 6 – chanjo ya polio na surua lazima!
dholuo: Mi nyathii chanjo ka pok Januar 6 ochakore kendo chanjo mar polio kod midusi en gima ochuno!
somali: Ilmahaaga tallaal ka hor 6-da Janaayo dib u furitaanka tallaalka polio iyo cirrid waajib ah!

english: Vaccination mandatory for all boarding students before reopening.
ekegusii: Ogochanchwa nerasima ase abana bonsi bechisukuru chiokarara ime nyuma chisukuru chitaraigorwa.
kiswahili: Video zinaangazia sura za katiba
dholuo: Yath mar thieth en gima ochuno ne jopuonjre duto ma somo e ute ma ji nindoe kapok ochak somo kendo.
somali: Dhammaan ardayda iskuulka diyaaradaha waa in la tallaalaa ka hor inta aysan dib u furmin.

english: Wash hands daily! Prevent cholera with proper hygiene.
ekegusii: Sibia amaboko ao kera rituko! Tanga kendwari yogosaa goetera abochenu bwao.
kiswahili: Osha mikono kila siku! Zuia kipindupindu kwa usafi unaofaa.
dholuo: Luok lweteni pile ka pile! Ritri kik ibed gi tuwo mar kolera kuom rito ler.
somali: Gacmaha maalin kasta maydh! Ka hortag cudurka kolera adoo adeegsanaya nadaafadda saxda ah.

english: Welcome refugees! Enroll refugee children in local schools.
ekegusii: Mwaariganiigwe abakimbisi! Anchera abana babakimbisi gosoa chisukuru.
kiswahili: Karibuni wakimbizi! Waandikishe watoto wakimbizi katika shule za mitaa.
dholuo: Warwakuru joma oringo thuchegi! Kel nyithindo ma oringo thuchegi e skunde manie alworau.
somali: Soo dhawow qaxootiga! Carruurta qaxootiga ah ku qor dugsiyada deegaanka.

english: Work together! Communities, ensure safe school environments.
ekegusii: Kora emeremo amo! Ebinyoro, rora nga okorika kwa abana gosoa chisukuru tikori namochando.
kiswahili: Fanya kazi pamoja! Jamii, hakikisha mazingira salama ya shule.
dholuo: Tiuru kanyachiel! Dhano manie alworawa, onego obed gadier ni nitie kuonde ma ler e skul.
somali: Iska shaqee! Bulshooyinka, hubinta jawi iskuul oo ammaan ah.

english: Your vote counts! Learn about elections in school programs.
ekegusii: Ekura yao neyengencho! Soma igoro yemeroberio yobochori bweesukuru.
kiswahili: Kura yako inahesabika! Jifunze kuhusu uchaguzi katika programu za shule.
dholuo: Dwoko mari ema konyo! Puonjri weche mang'eny e wi yiero mitimo e skul.
somali: Codkaaga ayaa muhiim ah! Wax ka baro doorashooyinka barnaamijyada dugsiga.

english: Youth Agenda challenges youth to create civic tech solutions.
ekegusii: chenda yaasae yabasegetire koreta chisemi chiabo korengana nokagania kwebinyoro biabo.
kiswahili: Ajenda ya Vijana inawapa changamoto vijana kuunda suluhisho za teknolojia ya kiraia.
dholuo: Chenro mar rowere jiwo rowere mondo olos yore mag teknoloji ma konyo oganda.
somali: Barnaamijka dhalinyarada wuxuu dhalinyarada ugu baaqayaa inay abuuraan xalal farsamo oo dadweyne ah.

english: Youth voter registration drive: Visit your school for free ID processing.
ekegusii: Korika abasae buna abaaki chikura: Tarera esukuru yao ase okwerika konyora ekebande.
kiswahili: Harakati ya usajili wa wapiga kura kwa vijana: Tembelea shule yako kwa usindikaji wa vitambulisho bila malipo.
dholuo: Chenro mar riwo rowere e yiero: Dhi e sikul maru mondo iyud thuolo mar yudo kad mar yiero maonge chudo.
somali: Dhaqdhaqaaqa diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha dhalinyarada: Booqo dugsigaaga si aad u hesho aqoonsi lacag la'aan ah.

english: We are advising all health workers to ensure they are wearing masks and PPEs at all times. Please take all the measures we have announced seriously.
ekegusii: Nigo tokobasemia abakori emeremo bonsi ba nyagitari kobeka ebikoneri/chimaski amo n'ebinto biogwetanga chingaki chionsi
kiswahili: Tunawashauri wafanyakazi wote wa afya kuhakikisha wamevaa barakoa na vifaa vya kujikinga wakati wote. Tafadhali chukua hatua zote ambazo tumetangaza kwa uzito.
dholuo: Wachiwo paro ne jotich duto mag thieth mondo gine ni girwako abuog rombe kod PPEs kinde duto. Yie mondo ukaw okenge duto ma waselando kaka gik madongo.
somali: Waxaan kula talineynaa dhammaan shaqaalaha caafimaadka inay hubiyaan inay xirtaan maaskaro iyo PPE markasta. Fadlan si dhab ah u qaad dhammaan tallaabooyinka aan ku dhawaaqnay.

english: We are advising members of the public to put on masks when getting into a matatu one is advised to put on a mask. Local production of masks and PPEs has began
ekegusii: Nigo tokobasemia abamenyi ense kobeka ebikoneri kekero bagosoa ase chimatatu, omonto nigo agosemigwa kobeka egekoneri/emaski. Oboroisia bw'ebinto biogwetanga bwachakire.
kiswahili: Tunawashauri wananchi kuvaa barakoa wanapoingia kwenye matatu, mtu anashauriwa kuvaa barakoa. Uzalishaji wa barakoa na vifaa vya kujikinga umeanza.
dholuo: Wachiwo paro ne jopiny mondo orwak abuog rombe sama odonjo e matatu ng'ato opuonjore mondo orwak abuog rombe. Loso abuog rombe kod PPEs e pinyno osechako
somali: Waxaan kula talineynaa shacabka inay xirtaan maaskaro marka ay galaan matatu waxaa lagula talinayaa in ay xirtaan maaskaro.

english: This are the first steps to keeping your family safe from Covid 19; 1.Wash your hands regularly with soap & running water 2. Cover your mouth and nose with a flexed elbow or tissue, when coughing or sneezing. 3.Avoid close contact with anyone who has cold or flu-like symptoms
ekegusii: Ebi nabio ebitambokero ebitangani b i'okorenda enyomba yao korwa ase Covid 19; 1.Esibie amaboko ao ase n'amache y'egetacho, n'esabuni. 2.Tuba omonu ne'chimioro kogotumia ekegokoro kiao gose egetambaa ekero ogokorora gose goasimora. 3.Toba ang'e na omonto o nde bwensi obwate rikuba.
kiswahili: Hizi ni hatua za kwanza za kulinda familia yako kutokana na Covid 19; 1. Osha mikono yako mara kwa mara kwa sabuni na maji yanayotiririka 2. Funika mdomo na pua yako kwa kiwiko au tishu iliyokunjwa, unapokohoa au kupiga chafya. 3. Epuka kugusana kwa karibu na mtu yeyote ambaye ana dalili za mafua au mafua.
dholuo: Magi gin yore mokwongo mag rito joodu mondo kik giyud Covid 19; 1. Luok lweteni pile ka pile gi sabun kod pi ma ng'ich 2. Uum dhogi kod okumbo ni kata tishu, ka igoyo kata iting'o. 3. Wek tudruok machiegni gi ng'ato ang'ata man kod tuoche mag hoyo kata athung'a.
somali: Kuwani waa tallaabooyinka ugu horreeya si qoyskaaga looga ilaaliyo COVID 19; 1. Gacmaha si joogto ah ugu maydho saabuun iyo biyo socdo 2. Afka iyo sanka ku daboolo lafdhabarta la jiifay ama dhar, marka aad suuxdo ama suuxdo. 3. Ka fogow xiriir dhow qof kasta oo qaba calaamadaha qabowga ama hargabka

english: Alcohol and Smoking will increase the risks of having high blood pressure. While you STAY AT HOME reduce alcohol intake and smoking.
ekegusii: Amarwa n'esigara nigo bikomenta obokong'u bw'okonyora riberera riamanyinga. Ekero ore inka, keia konywa amaru gose konywa esigara.
kiswahili: Pombe na Uvutaji Sigara vitaongeza hatari za kuwa na shinikizo la damu. Unapokaa NYUMBANI punguza unywaji wa pombe na uvutaji sigara.
dholuo: Kongo kod madho ndawa biro medo nyalo mar bedo gi presa mamalo mar remo. Ka ibedo e ot, duok piny madho kong'o kod madho ndawa.
somali: Cabitaanka khamriga iyo sigaarka ayaa kordhin doona khatarta cadaadiska dhiigga sare.Marka aad guriga jogto iska yarey isticmalka khamriga iyo sigarka.

english: Be safe from coronavirus.Washing your hands is the most important way to stop transmission. 1.Wet hands 2.Apply enough soap 3.Scrub all surfaces of the hands for 20-30 seconds. 4.Rinse thoroughly with running water 5.Dry hands with a clean cloth or single-use towel
ekegusii: Etange n'ebinyinyi bia Corona. Gosibia amaboko nenchera ya bene yogotanga ogoetia kwebinyinyi. 1.Esibi amaboko 2.Eyake esabuni 3.Sugua kera ensemo yokoboko ase chisekunde 20-30 4.Sibi amaboko ase amache egetacho 5.Etinyi n'egetambaa ekerabu
kiswahili: Kuwa salama kutokana na virusi vya corona. Kuosha mikono yako ndiyo njia muhimu zaidi ya kuzuia maambukizi. 1. Lowesha mikono 2. Paka sabuni ya kutosha 3. Sugua sehemu zote za mikono kwa sekunde 20-30. 4. Suuza vizuri na maji yanayotiririka 5. Kausha mikono kwa kitambaa safi au taulo ya matumizi moja
dholuo: Bed gi arita maber kuom korona. Lwoko lweteni en yo maduong' mogik mar geng'o lando tuwo. 1. Lwoko lweteni gi pi 2. Ket sabun moromo 3. Goch lweteni duto kuom sekon 20-30. 4. Luw lweteni maber gi pi moting'o 5. Luw lweteni gi nanga maler kata matiyo go dichiel.
somali: Iska ilaali cudurka Coronavirus. Gacmahaada maydhka ayaa ah habka ugu muhiimsan ee lagu joojin karo gudbinta. 1. Gacmaha qoyan 2.Sabayl ku filan ku dheji 3.Dadka oo dhan 20-30 ilbidhiqsi ku tirtir. 4. Biyaha qulqulaya si fiican u maydho 5. Gacmaha qalalan dhar nadiif ah ama tuulo hal mar loo isticmaalo

english: You have to be registered to get the COVID-19 vaccine. You can do this at the nearest health facility or be registering on the MOH_Kenya website (http://health.go.ke). All you need is your ID card. Kindly assist your elderly relatives to get registered
ekegusii: Goika bwerike erio konyora esindani ya Covid 19. Nabo okwerika ase enyagitari ere ang'e nasore, gose ase etuvuti ya MOH_Kenya (http://health.go.ke). Ekio oganetie nekebande kiao. Konya abakoro kwerika.
kiswahili: Lazima uwe umesajiliwa ili kupata chanjo ya COVID-19. Unaweza kufanya hivi katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu au kujiandikisha kwenye tovuti ya MOH_Kenya (http://health.go.ke). Unachohitaji ni kitambulisho chako. Tafadhali wasaidie jamaa zako wazee kujiandikisha.
