english: Support education and awareness campaigns protecting children, women, refugees, and vulnerable groups
ekegusii: Segeta chisemi goetera okobamanyia abanto oboronge bwabo, korenda abana, abakungu, baria batamire chisegi korwa sobo, na baria baria baranyare konyorwa nobokongu.
kiswahili: Saidia kampeni za elimu na uhamasishaji kuwalinda watoto, wanawake, wakimbizi, na makundi yaliyo hatarini
dholuo: Tiyo gi yore mag puonjo kod chiwo paro e rito nyithindo, mon, joma oringo thuchegi, kod joma nigi chandruok
somali: Taageerada waxbarashada iyo ololaha waxbarashada carruurta, dumarka, qaxootiga iyo kooxaha aadka u nugul

english: Use community platforms to educate on disaster preparedness, emergency numbers, and safety protocols
ekegusii: Tumia emesangerekano yebinyoro komanyia na gosomia abanto buna baranyare kwerenda korwa emechando, chinamba chiesimi korangeria ogokonywa, namachiko oborendi.
kiswahili: Tumia majukwaa ya jamii kuelimisha kuhusu maandalizi ya maafa, nambari za dharura, na itifaki za usalama
dholuo: Ti gi chenro mag kanyakla mondo ikony ji ng'eyo kaka ginyalo timo ne masiche, kwan mag joma nigi namba mar chiwo kony, kod chike ma tayo ritruok
somali: Isticmaal barxadaha bulshada si aad u bartid diyaarinta musiibada, lambarrada xaaladaha degdegga ah, iyo xeerarka amniga

english: Bevigilant students are tricked into smuggling narcotics
ekegusii: Kabe maiso, abana besukuru nigo bakongainwa gosoa ebiasara biogonya kobogoria na koonia chinyasore.
kiswahili: Wanafunzi makini wadanganywa ili kusafirisha dawa za kulevya kimagendo
dholuo: Jopuonjre ma nigi chuny mar rito jonywolgo, wuondi mondo otergi e wuoth
somali: Ardayda taxadarka leh waxaa lagu khiyaanaynayaa inay isticmaalaan maandooriyaha

english: Be on the lookout for criminals who use NGOs to launder money
ekegusii: Kabe maiso igoro yebibago bigotumia NGOs korosia chibesa chia pandia.
kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu na wahalifu wanaotumia mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali kutakasa pesa
dholuo: Bed motang ' gi jomahundu ma tiyo gi riwruoge ma ok riw lwedo e lwoko pesa
somali: Ka digtoonow dambiilayaasha adeegsanaya ciidamo aan dowlad ahayn si ay lacag ugu bixiyaan

english: Report road accidents, unsafe vehicles, and reckless driving to authorities.
ekegusii: Manyia igoro yemebasekano yepara, chirori chitari ase enchera engiya, nobogendia obobe gochia ase abagambi gose abasikari.
kiswahili: Ripoti ajali za barabarani, magari yasiyo salama, na uendeshaji wa magari bila kujali kwa mamlaka.
dholuo: Nyis sirkal ka in gi aksident, mtokni ma ok ni kare, kod ka idwaro riembo mtoka.
somali: Warbixin ku saabsan shilalka waddooyinka, baabuurta aan ammaan ahayn, iyo darawalnimada khaldan.

english: Share tips and awareness on safe driving practices, traffic regulations, and accident prevention
ekegusii: Konya abarundi chirori komanya obogendi obuya namachiko yobogendia buna enchera eyemo yogotanga emebasekano yechipara.
kiswahili: Shiriki vidokezo na ufahamu kuhusu desturi salama za kuendesha gari, kanuni za trafiki, na kuzuia ajali
dholuo: Chiw paro kod paro e wi weche motudore gi riembo mtoka, chike mag ndara, kod geng'o aksident
somali: La wadaag talooyin iyo aragtiyo ku saabsan habdhaqanka wadista ammaanka ah, xeerarka wadada, iyo ka hortagga shilalka

english: Participate in public safety campaigns and trainings in schools, markets, and transport hubs
ekegusii: Kabe oyomo gosegeta oborendi bwense na nomoroberio bwokwegeria chisukuru igoro yoborendi ase chisukuru chichiro nase chirori chikorinerwa.
kiswahili: Shiriki katika kampeni na mafunzo ya usalama wa umma katika shule, masoko, na vituo vya usafiri
dholuo: Riw lwedo kampen mag rito ngima ji kod tiegruok e skunde, e chiro, kod kuonde ma ji wuokie
somali: Ka qaybqaado ololaha ammaanka dadweynaha iyo tababarka dugsiyada, suuqyada, iyo saldhigyada gaadiidka

english: Beware of Criminals posing as embassy staff to commit fraud
ekegusii: Kabe maiso igoro yebibago bigwekora abakori emeremo bobobalosi aiga Kenya erio koibera abanto
kiswahili: Jihadhari na Wahalifu wanaojifanya wafanyakazi wa ubalozi ili kufanya ulaghai
dholuo: Tang ' gi Joma Timbegi Richo ma Timore Kaka Jatich e Ofise mag Ambassade Mondo Gitim Miriambo
somali: Ka digtoonow dambiilayaasha iska dhigta safaaradda si ay khiyaano u sameeyaan

english: Report biosecurity threats such as seed or livestock smuggling to KEPHIS or local authorities
ekegusii: Manyia abagambi otari konyorwa igoro obokengeka bwogosoi chimbego chikorenta amairwaire ase oboremi bwaito gose amasingira buna chimbego chia pandia gose oboibi bwechiombe gochia ekeombe keria ekenene gia Kenya getenerete oborosia na obabagi bwechimbego (Kenya Plant Health Health Inspectorate Services (KEPHIS( gose abambi bebinyoro.
kiswahili: Ripoti vitisho vya usalama wa kibiolojia kama vile ulanguzi wa mbegu au mifugo kwa KEPHIS au mamlaka za mitaa
dholuo: Nyis KEPHIS kata sirkal mar alwora gik ma nyalo miyo ngima ji obed matek kaka kodhi kata le ma ok nyal geng'o
somali: Warbixin ku saabsan khataraha badbaadada noolaha sida abuurka ama xoolaha si qarsoodi ah loo keeno TEPHIS ama mas'uuliyiinta maxalliga ah

english: Engage in neighborhood vigilance programs and community policing initiatives.
ekegusii: Soa ase omoroberio bwokomongera ebikoru biobosaria korwa ebinyoro bine, korenda na gotanga gobosaria na amaochorerio yamachiko ase okoba maiso goetera emeroberio yoborendi bwebinyoro.
kiswahili: Shiriki katika programu za uangalizi wa ujirani na mipango ya ulinzi wa jamii.
dholuo: Tim chenro mag rito alwora kendo rit chenro mag polise.
somali: Ka qaybqaado barnaamijyada daryeelka deriska iyo mashaariicda maareynta bulshada.

english: Observe curfews and security directives to support local safety measures.
ekegusii: Bwatia amachiko buna arure nabarai una enchhera eyemo yoborendi erio korenda oborendi bwenyoro kiao.
kiswahili: Fuata amri za kutotoka nje na maagizo ya usalama ili kuunga mkono hatua za usalama za eneo husika.
dholuo: Luw chike mag dhoudi kod chike mag rito weche mag sirkal mondo omi omi omiyi teko mar rito weche mag sirkal.
somali: Ku qor xeerarka saacadaha guriga iyo tilmaamaha amniga si aad u taageerto tallaabooyinka amniga ee deegaankaada.

english: Report suspicious activities linked to gangs, terrorism, or violent demonstrations.
ekegusii: Manyia abagambi igoro yrbikoru biechitangutangu bibwatekaine nobokebago bwabanto abange, okoruta chipomu, gose okoroberekana kwobotindi.
kiswahili: Ripoti shughuli zinazotiliwa shaka zinazohusiana na magenge, ugaidi, au maandamano ya vurugu.
dholuo: Wach gik ma ok kare ma timore e kind jomahundu, jomahundu, kata joma timo timbe gero.
somali: Warbixin ku saabsan waxqabadyada shakiga leh ee la xiriira kooxaha, argagixisada ama dibadbaxyada rabshadaha leh.

english: Follow travel advisories and avoid high-risk areas to ensure personal safety
ekegusii: Bwatia amachiko nogosemigwa ase obotari na kabe are korwa ase aria aregire nechisagano goikerania oborendi bwao aye omonyene.
kiswahili: Fuata ushauri wa usafiri na epuka maeneo yenye hatari kubwa ili kuhakikisha usalama wa kibinafsi
dholuo: Luw weche ma ji wacho e wi wuoth kendo kik idonj e kuonde ma nyalo kelo hinyruok maduong' mondo omi iyud ritruok
somali: Raac talooyinka safarka oo ka fogaada meelaha sare si aad u ilaaliso nabadgelyadaada

english: Alert authorities to security risks during protests, robberies, or unrest in your area
ekegusii: manyia abagambi igoro yokogosereria kwoborendi chingaki chiokoroberekana, oboibi, gose chiminano aase ekenyoro kiao.
kiswahili: Tahadharisha mamlaka kuhusu hatari za kiusalama wakati wa maandamano, wizi, au machafuko katika eneo lako
dholuo: Chiw siem ne sirkal e wi gik manyalo hinyo ngima ji sama ikedo, ineno ka jokuoge kwalo gimoro, kata sama nitie ywaruok e alworau
somali: Mas'uuliyiinta ka digtoonaada khataraha amniga inta lagu jiro mudaaharaadyada, tuugada, ama rabshadaha deegaankaada

english: Use technology and plea bargaining policies to report corruption and support swift case resolution
ekegusii: Renta amo obokoreri bwetekinorochi amo nechinkwana komanyia igoro yobokorekanu, gotenenera amang'ana na konacha chiminano ase enchera engiya.
kiswahili: Tumia teknolojia na sera za majadiliano ya malalamiko ili kuripoti ufisadi na kusaidia utatuzi wa haraka wa kesi
dholuo: Ti gi teknoloji kod yore mag nego ji mondo inyis ni nitie mibadhi kendo ikonygi tieko kes mapiyo
somali: Isticmaal tikniyoolajiyadda iyo waraaqaha cafiska si aad u soo sheegto musuqmaasuqa oo aad u taageerto go'aanka degdegga ah ee maxkamadda

english: Educate peers on amendments requiring public officers to declare gifts and prevent conflicts of interest
ekegusii: Somia bigori biao igoro yamaonchorerio yamachiko aganetie abanto korwa ebirengererio biabo ase ogochika korengete abakori emeremo beserikari komanyia chinibo babwate na goteba ebire baetwe buna ebieegwa gotanga dkorora nga emeremo yabo teri nogwanchereria.
kiswahili: Waelimishe wenzao kuhusu marekebisho yanayowataka maafisa wa umma kutangaza zawadi na kuzuia migongano ya kimaslahi
dholuo: Puonjri ne mbeseni weche ma ne oloki ma ne dwaro ni jotelo mag sirkal ochiw chiwo mag pesa kendo gitim kamano mondo kik gibed gi ywaruok mag paro
somali: Dhalinyarada baro isbeddellada u baahan mas'uuliyiinta dawladda inay ku dhawaaqaan hadiyado iyo inay ka hortagaan khilaafaadka xiisaha

english: Highlight corruption issues in your county and urge leaders to enforce accountability
ekegusii: Teba ebinto ebikorekanu nobokorekanu bore ase ekaonti yao na koboria abarai basugume obotenereri obuya.
kiswahili: Angazia masuala ya ufisadi katika kaunti yako na uwasihi viongozi kutekeleza uwajibikaji
dholuo: Nyis ni nitie weche maricho ma timore e alworau kendo ijiw jotelo mondo oket ketho kuom riwruogno
somali: Xusuusnow kiisaska musuqmaasuqa ee gobolkaaga ka jira oo ka codso saraakiisha inay ka qaadaan mas'uuliyaddaada

english: Support youth engagement and integrity clubs in local events to prevent corruption.
ekegusii: Konya abasae ase gokwanerana na gosoa ebiombe biogotenera ekeene ase emeyega yebinyoro buna enhera eyemo yotanga obokengeka.
kiswahili: Saidia vilabu vya ushirikishwaji na uadilifu wa vijana katika matukio ya ndani ili kuzuia rushwa.
dholuo: Riwo lwedo riwruoge mag rowere kod riwruoge ma nyiso ni gimakore gi adiera e chokruoge mag alwora mondo gikwed mibadhi.
somali: Taageer shukaansiga iyo daacadnimada dhalinyarada dhacdooyinka deegaanka qaarkood si looga hortago musuqmaasuqa.

english: Attend anticorruption oversight training and workshops to deepen awareness and behavior change
ekegusii: Ika ase amoorokererio igoro yokomongera na gosanga gokong'ia okomanya namaonchorerio yebikoro.
kiswahili: Hudhuria mafunzo na warsha za usimamizi dhidi ya rushwa ili kuongeza uelewa na mabadiliko ya tabia
dholuo: Dhi e tiegruok kod chokruoge mag rito timbe mag mibadhi mondo okony ji ong'e kendo otim lokruok e kit ngimagi
somali: Ka qeybgal tababarka maareynta musuqmaasuqa iyo garaashka si aad u kordhiso wacyiga iyo isbeddelka dabeecadda

english: Engage in community programs that systematically root out corruption and rebuild public trust
ekegusii: Bwaterana nemeroberio yebinyoro eyio egokinana nobokorekanu gati yobogambi koiya obokorekanu na koirania okwegena kwa abanto ase obogambi.
kiswahili: Shiriki katika programu za jamii zinazoondoa ufisadi kimfumo na kujenga upya uaminifu wa umma
dholuo: Tim chenro mag konyo ji mondo otiek mibadhi kendo mondo ji obed gi geno kuom Jehova
somali: Ka qaybqaado barnaamijyada bulshada oo si tartiib tartiib ah u baabi'iya musuqmaasuqa iyo dib u dhiska kalsoonida dadweynaha

english: Report corrupt officials to reinforce zero tolerance in institutions.
ekegusii: Karue amang'ana igoro yabakoreri abakorekanu gosegeta gokora obokorekanu as chiofisi.
kiswahili: Ripoti maafisa wafisadi ili kuimarisha uvumilivu sifuri katika taasisi.
dholuo: Nyis jodong-kanyakla ma gin jomaricho ni gimor gi timbe maricho ma timore e riwruoge.
somali: Warbixinta rasmiga ah ee saraakiisha musuqmaasuqa si loo xoojiyo dulqaadka hay'adaha kala duwan.

english: Encourage private sector collaboration under integrity frameworks for unified anticorruption action
ekegusii: Kae omoyo abanyabiasara kobwaterana inse yamachiko obokeene gokinana keboamo gokora obokengeka.
kiswahili: Kuhimiza ushirikiano wa sekta binafsi chini ya mifumo ya uadilifu kwa ajili ya hatua za pamoja za kupambana na rushwa
dholuo: Jiwo tich ma ji timo e kindgi giwegi e bwo chenro mag rito ratiro mag riwruok mar oganda Jehova mondo oti gi yore ma romre gi mibadhi
somali: Ku dhiirrigeliya xubnaha waaxda gaarka loo leeyahay ee ku salaysan daacadnimada anshaxa si wadajir ah looga hortago musuqmaasuqa

english: Participate in campaigns promoting societal values and ethical behavior
ekegusii: Kabe oyomo ase ogosegeta engencho yoboamate obuya nobwegenwa korengana nengencho yekenyoro.
kiswahili: Shiriki katika kampeni zinazokuza maadili ya kijamii na tabia za kimaadili
dholuo: Dhi e kampen mar jiwo timbe mabeyo kod timbe mabeyo
somali: Ka qaybqaado ololaha horumarinta heerarka bulshada iyo anshaxa

english: Join public awareness events emphasizing the impact of corruption on human dignity
ekegusii: Ikerana ase okonyorana nabande kobamanyia obobe bwobokorekanu korngana namasikani ekemwanyabanto.
kiswahili: Jiunge na matukio ya uhamasishaji umma yanayosisitiza athari za ufisadi kwa utu wa binadamu
dholuo: Dhi e chokruoge mag konyo ji ng'eyo kaka mibadhi nyalo mulo luor mar dhano
somali: Ku biir dhacdooyin waxbarasho oo muujinaya saameynta musuqmaasuqa ku yeelanayo sharafta aadanaha

english: Use technology and social media to participate in anti-corruption campaigns.
ekegusii: Tumia tekinorochia nebiombo biokomanyia amang'ana erio korwa ebirengererio biao ase ogokinana nobokorekanu.
kiswahili: Tumia teknolojia na mitandao ya kijamii kushiriki katika kampeni za kupambana na ufisadi.
dholuo: Ti gi teknoloji kod weche mag tudruok e Intanet mondo ikonygi kedo gi mibadhi.
somali: Isticmaal tiknoolajiyada iyo warbaahinta bulshada si aad uga qaybqaadatid ololaha ka dhanka ah musuqmaasuqa.

english: Advocate for stronger anti-corruption measures to safeguard human rights.
ekegusii: Suguma amaonchorerio yaamachiko akorwania obokengeka korende obonge mwanyabanto.
kiswahili: Tetea hatua kali zaidi za kupambana na rushwa ili kulinda haki za binadamu.
dholuo: Dhi nyime jiwo ni mondo omi ji oyud thuolo mar timo dongruok e weche mag siasa.
somali: Taageerayaasha tallaabooyinka ugu adag ee ka dhanka ah musuqmaasuqa si loo ilaaliyo xuquuqda aadanaha.

english: Encourage the passage and enforcement of laws banning convicted individuals from public procurement
ekegusii: Segeta ogoetigwa kwa amachiko agotanga baria banyorekanire koba abakorekanu gotasoa ase sobogori bwechitenda gokorera eserikari.
kiswahili: Kuhimiza kupitishwa na utekelezaji wa sheria zinazopiga marufuku watu waliohukumiwa kufanya ununuzi wa umma
dholuo: Jiwo mondo oket chike ma kwero joma oter e buch loje mag sirkal kendo tiyo kodgi
somali: Ku dhiirigeliso in la ansixiyo sharciyo ka mamnuucaya dadka la xukumay inay dadweynaha ka soo baxaan

english: Report economic crimes and procurement fraud to demonstrate community commitment to justice.
ekegusii: Manyia abarai igor obosaria bwobogoko nobokengeka ase okogora chitenda chieserikari buna enchera yokworokia okobwaterana nebinyoro gokora ekeene.
kiswahili: Ripoti uhalifu wa kiuchumi na ulaghai wa ununuzi ili kuonyesha kujitolea kwa jamii kwa haki.
dholuo: Riw ripot mar ketho mag yuto kod wuondruok e weche mag yuto mondo onyis ni oganda ogeno ahinya weche makare.
somali: Warbixinta dambiyada dhaqaalaha iyo helitaanka khiyaanada si loo muujiyo mas'uuliyadda bulshada ee caddaaladda.

english: Follow strategic plans like the Kenya Integrity Plan to enhance sector-wide transparency
ekegusii: Bwatia omoroberio bwogokora emeremo buna oria o 'Kenya bwobokeene (Kenya Integrity Plan) kwangoi obokoreri ao ao bwa maiso marore ase eserikari.
kiswahili: Fuata mipango ya kimkakati kama vile Mpango wa Uadilifu wa Kenya ili kuboresha uwazi katika sekta nzima
dholuo: Luwo chenro mag chenro kaka Kenya Integrity Plan mondo omi dongruok e weche duto mar piny
somali: Qaado barnaamijyo istiraatiiji ah sida Kenya Integrity Project si loo wanaajiyo hufnaanta meelaha kala duwan

english: Monitor recovered public assets and advocate for their use in community welfare projects
ekegusii: Mongera buna enibo eria baibetwe na koiranigwa na gosuguma korora yatumekire gokora emeremo yogokonya ebinyoro.
kiswahili: Fuatilia mali za umma zilizopatikana na utetee matumizi yake katika miradi ya ustawi wa jamii
dholuo: Ng'ado paro kuom mwandu mag sirkal ma ne odwok kendo jiwo ni giti kodgi e tije mag konyo oganda
somali: Cilmi-baadhayaashu waxay dib u heleen hantida dadweynaha waxayna taageerayaan isticmaalka mashaariicda daryeelka bulshada

english: Support frameworks that consolidate efforts to combat corruption effectively
ekegusii: Sira emeroberio ekoreta amo chinguru chiokinana nobokorekanu ase enchera ebwenerete.
kiswahili: Kuunga mkono mifumo inayoimarisha juhudi za kupambana na rushwa kwa ufanisi
dholuo: Chenro mag konyo joma dwaro kedo gi mibadhi
somali: Qaab-dhismeedyada taageerada ah ee xoojinaya dadaalka la dagaalanka musuqmaasuqa

english: Participate in national celebrations or campaigns that emphasize ethics and integrity
ekegusii: Ikerana ase amatuko amanene yemeyega yeserikari gose chinkwana egokwanera igoro yekeene.
kiswahili: Shiriki katika sherehe au kampeni za kitaifa zinazosisitiza maadili na uadilifu
dholuo: Dhi e nyasi kata kampen ma jiwo timbe mabeyo kod tim makare
somali: Ka qaybqaado xafladaha qaranka ama ololaha lagu xoojiyo anshaxa iyo daacadnimada

english: Stay informed about government anti-corruption measures and encourage compliance
ekegusii: Tigara komanyete buya emeroberio yeserikari gokinana nobokengeka ere na segeta abanto gosika amachiko.
kiswahili: Endelea kupata taarifa kuhusu hatua za serikali za kupambana na ufisadi na uhimize kufuata sheria
dholuo: Bed gi weche momedore e wi chenro mag sirkal mar kedo gi mibadhi kendo jiw ji mondo oluwgi
somali: Warbixin ka siiya tallaabooyinka dowladda ee ka dhanka ah musuqmaasuqa iyo sharci-dejinta

english: Raise awareness about corruption effects to encourage ethical conduct among citizens
ekegusii: Manya abanto obobe bwobokengeka erio koa abanto omoyo gokorera abande buya.
kiswahili: Kuongeza uelewa kuhusu athari za rushwa ili kuhimiza mwenendo wa kimaadili miongoni mwa raia
dholuo: Med paro kuom kaka mibadhi nyalo kelo chandruoge, mondo ji obed gi timbe mabeyo
somali: Waxbarashada ku saabsan saamaynta musuqmaasuqa si loo dhiiri geliyo habdhaqanka muwaadiniinta

english: Report illicit activities to help recover stolen assets and support law enforcement

dholuo: Duol'no jiwo kambe madwaro tiyo gi yore mag oro kod mag oro barupe mondo okonygi gi kwayo mag rusa e apise magwa man Nairobi, Kisumu, Eldoret, Nyeri kod Mombasa, kendo osiemo oganda duto mondo ochimre kod mana chenro mopwodhi mag oro baupe.
somali: Hay'addu waxay ku boorineysaa shirkadaha doonaya inay ku hawlan yihiin adeegyada baakadaha iyo adeegyada gaarsiinta inay ka dalbadaan ruqsadaha looga baahan yahay xafiisyadeena Nairobi, Kisumu, Eldoret, Nyeri iyo Mombasa waxayna ka digeysaa shacabka inay ka dalbadaan adeegyada baakadaha iyo adeegyada gaarsiinta kaliya bixiyeyaasha ruqsadaha CA.

english: Machogu urged the residents to ensure that they nurture the trees to maturity after planting and not to leave it as a responsibility of the Government.
ekegusii: Machogu nasabete abaibori koenekia ng'a barende emete basimekire goika ekine buya na tari gosimeka na gotigera eserikari erende.
kiswahili: Machogu aliwasihi wakazi kuhakikisha kwamba wanaitunza miti hiyo hadi kukomaa baada ya kupanda na wasiiache kama jukumu la Serikali.
dholuo: Machogu nojiwo jogweng'no mondo ong'e ni giweyo yiende odongo e rang'iny makare bang' pidhogi, to ok giwegi mana ka gima en ting ' mar sirkal.
somali: Machogu wuxuu dadka deggan ugu baaqay inay hubiyaan in ay kor u qaadaan geedaha si ay u bislaadaan ka dib markii la beero oo aysan uga tagin mas'uuliyadda Dowladda.

english: The County Government of Kericho is advising all residents to remain on high alert due to the ongoing heavy rains being experienced across the county.
ekegusii: Teerikari yekaonti ya Kericho ngosemia ere abanto baye bonsi gotigara koba maiso igoro yembura enyinge eyio egendererete gotwa ime yekaonti engima.
kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Kericho inawashauri wakazi wote kuendelea kuwa macho kutokana na mvua kubwa inayoendelea kunyesha kote kaunti.
dholuo: Sirkal mar kaunti ma Kericho jiwo ji duto mondo obed motang' ahinya nikech koth maduong' ma dhi nyime e gwenge mag kaunti no duto.
somali: Maamulka Degmada Kericho ayaa kula talinaya dhammaan dadka deggan inay ku sii jiraan feejignaan sare sababo la xiriira roobabka xoogga badan ee socda ee ka dhaca degmada oo dhan.

english: The County Government appeals to all residents to exercise utmost caution, avoid crossing flooded roads or walking near swollen rivers, and to immediately report any emergencies or incidents to the nearest local administration office or through the County emergency hotline.
ekegusii: Eserikari yekaonti nigo egosaba abanainchi bonsi ng'a babe maiso, tibatema goeta ase amache gose oroche rorew nomorindo bwamache, na komantia eserikari igoro ya mobasekano onde bwensi gochia amokoreri bweserikari ore ange nere gose goetera enamba ya morero yekaonti goetera eintaneti.
kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti inatoa wito kwa wakazi wote kuwa waangalifu sana, kuepuka kuvuka barabara zilizofurika au kutembea karibu na mito iliyofurika, na kuripoti mara moja dharura au matukio yoyote kwa ofisi ya utawala ya karibu au kupitia simu ya dharura ya Kaunti.
dholuo: Sirkal mar kaunti no jiwo ji duto mondo otang' ahinya, kik ging'ad nderni mopong' gi pi kata wuoth machiegni gi aoche ma pi opong'o, kendo gikanyono gichiw lipot mar masira moramora e apis maduong' mar sirkal manie gweng'no kata ka gitiyo kod namba mag chwalo masiche.
somali: Maamulka Gobolka wuxuu dadka deggan oo dhan ugu baaqayaa inay sameeyaan taxaddar aad u weyn, ka fogaadaan in ay soo gudbaan wadooyinka daadsan ama ay ku socdaan webiyada barwaaqoobay, isla markaana ay isla markiiba u soo sheegaan xaaladaha degdegga ah ama dhacdooyinka xafiiska maamulka maxalliga ah ee ugu dhow ama khadka tooska ah ee xaaladaha degdegga ah ee Gobolka.

english: The County Government reiterates that the safety of residents remains its top priority and urges everyone to stay vigilant, follow official advisories, and support one another during this period of heavy rainfall.
ekegusii: Eserikari yechokaonti yaenekeirie abanainchi nga nare maiso goikerania oborendi na gosaba kera oyomo koba maiso, kobwatia obosemia, na gokonyana chingaki echi chiembura enyinge.
kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti inarudia kwamba usalama wa wakazi unasalia kuwa kipaumbele chake cha juu na inawasihi kila mtu kuwa macho, kufuata ushauri rasmi, na kusaidiana wakati huu wa mvua kubwa.
dholuo: Sirkal mar kaunti no medo jiwo ahinya ni rito ngima joodgi en gima duong' ahinya kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo obed motang', oluw puonj mag sirkal, kendo gikonyre giwegi e kinde koth maduong'ni.
somali: Dowladda Gobolka waxay ku celineysaa in badbaadada dadka deggan ay tahay mudnaanta koowaad waxayna ku boorineysaa qof walba inuu feejignaado, u hoggaansamo talooyinka rasmiga ah, kuna taageero midba midka kale inta lagu jiro xilligan roobabka culus.

english: Youth engagement took centre stage in Kisumu County this week as leaders threw down the gauntlet, urging young residents to swap spectator seats for the architect's table in governance.
ekegusii: Okobwaterana nabasae aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu ewiki eye nigo kwabete kwomonguso ase abant abange ekero abarai barwete ogosaba nga abasae babogorie egetambokero kioborendi. Gosegeta abasae batige koba magega na abarigereria korende korende kobwaterana korora ng'a ebirengererio biabo biasoire ase emeroberio yobogamb gose oborai.
kiswahili: Ushiriki wa vijana ulichukua nafasi muhimu katika Kaunti ya Kisumu wiki hii huku viongozi wakipuuza vikwazo, wakiwahimiza wakazi vijana kubadilishana viti vya watazamaji na meza ya mbunifu katika utawala.
dholuo: Riwruok mar rowere nokawo okang ' maduong ' ahinya e kaunti' mar Kisumu e jumani kane jotelo ogolo Glav, ka gikwayo rowere e gweng'no mondo olok kombe mag jowinjo mondo obed mesa mar jatelo.
somali: Iskaashiga dhalinyarada ayaa toddobaadkan ka dhacay degmada Kisumu iyadoo hoggaamiyeyaashu ay hoos u dhigeen gacanka, iyagoo ku booriyay dadka dhallinyarada ah inay ku beddelaan kuraasta daawadayaasha miiska dhismaha ee maamulka.

english: The event, held at Gilgil Stadium, was streamed live on KDF platforms to promote transparency and educate the public on the recruitment process.
ekegusii: Aya iga nigo abete aaria egetii kiemesiecho kia Gilgil, ayio aorogetigwe etibi korwa ekeombe kioboami bwoborendi bwense (KDF) gosegeta obomaiso marore na gosomia abanto buna okorika abaami gokoba.
kiswahili: Hafla hiyo, iliyofanyika katika Uwanja wa Gilgil, ilirushwa moja kwa moja kwenye majukwaa ya KDF ili kukuza uwazi na kuelimisha umma kuhusu mchakato wa kuajiri.
dholuo: Chokruogno mane otim e paw tuke mar Gilgil, ne oter e yamo e ndiri mag jolweny mag KDF mondo omi ji ong'e weche duto elela kendo gipuonj ji weche momedore e wi chenro mar ndikruok.
somali: Dhacdadan oo ka dhacday garoonka Gilgil Stadium, ayaa si toos ah loogu sii daayay barnaamijyada KDF si kor loogu qaado hufnaan iyo barashada dadweynaha ee ku saabsan habka shaqaaleysiinta.

english: He further encouraged the public to be part of the process through reporting any incidences of bribery or corruption through relevant hotlines.
ekegusii: Akagenderera gosegeta abanto koba abamo bomoroberio oyio goetera okorwa amangana igoro yobokorekanu ase amoroberio bwokorika abaami goetera enamba yesimi yamorero.
kiswahili: Aliwahimiza zaidi umma kuwa sehemu ya mchakato huo kwa kuripoti matukio yoyote ya rushwa au ufisadi kupitia simu husika za dharura.
dholuo: Nomedo jiwo oganda mondo oriw lwedo chenro no kuom chiwo ripot e wi timbe mag asoya kod mibadhi ka gitiyo kod nembni mag chwalo ote mag masiche ma apoya.
somali: Waxa uu sidoo kale bulshada ku dhiiri geliyey inay qayb ka noqdaan geedi socodka iyada oo la soo sheegayo wixii dhacdo ah ee laaluush ama musuqmaasuq iyada oo loo marayo khadadka kulul ee la xiriira.

english: Members of the public and property owners are reminded to prioritize structural safety in residential buildings.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi nabanyete enibo bwainyoriigwe korenda buna amaagacho echinyomba gose chitaracha chigwata goikerania oborendi obuya ase chinyomba chiokomenya.
kiswahili: Wamiliki wa umma na mali wanakumbushwa kuweka kipaumbele usalama wa miundo katika majengo ya makazi.
dholuo: Ji duto kaachiel gi weg mwandu iparonegi mondo oket arita maber e ute ma jodak.
somali: Shacabka iyo milkiilayaasha hantida waxaa lagu xusuusinayaa inay mudnaanta siiyaan ammaanka dhismaha dhismayaasha.

english: The Public is urged to report any incidences of recruitment malpractices to the nearest Police Station or call 0709099000, 999, 911,112 or #fichuakwaDCI 0800722203.
ekegusii: Abanto basabirwe komanyia basikari igoro yabanto korikwa gosoa ebiombe biobosaria gose goetera goaka esimi 0709099000, 999, 911,112 gose #fichuakwaDCI 0800722203.
kiswahili: Umma unahimizwa kuripoti matukio yoyote ya ukiukwaji wa sheria za ajira kwa Kituo cha Polisi kilicho karibu au piga simu 0709099000, 999, 911,112 au #fichuakwaDCI 0800722203.
dholuo: Oganda duto ijiwo mondo ochiw ripot mag mibadhi e ndikruok stesend obila machiegni kodgi kata gigochne 0709099000, 999, 911,112 kata #chiwo wach ne apisa ma timo norno 0800722203.
somali: Dadweynaha waxaa lagu boorinayaa in ay soo sheegaan dhacdooyinka kasta oo ka mid ah habdhaqanka xun ee shaqaaleysiinta Saldhigga Booliska ee ugu dhow ama u wac 0709099000, 999, 911,112 ama #fichuakwaDCI 0800722203.

english: We caution all to beware of fraudsters posing as Commission staff to solicit money in exchange for our services.
ekegusii: Nigo togokurera abanto koba maiso igoro yabasaria bagwekora koba abakomisona baita erio koibera abanto chibesa chiabo.
kiswahili: Tunawaonya wote wajihadhari na matapeli wanaojifanya wafanyakazi wa Tume ili kuomba pesa badala ya huduma zetu.
dholuo: Wachiwo siem ne ng'ato ka ng'ato mondo otang' gi joma wuondore ka gipenjo ka gitiyo e komiti mondo giyud omenda ka gichiwo chenro magwa.
somali: Waxaan u digaynaa in qof walba uu ka digtoonow khiyaanooyinka isu dhigaya shaqaale ka tirsan Komishanka si ay lacag ugu dalbadaan adeegyadeena.

english: Public Participation and Stakeholder Engagement: In accordance with Article 10(2) of the Constitution of Kenya, the Ministry of Roads and Transport invites members of the public and stakeholders to participate in public forums.
ekegusii: Okoumerana na okobwatera nabanto nabasangi ao ao: Koreng'ana nerichiko ria 10(2) riegatabu kiamachiko gia Kenya, Eminisitiri yechipara nobobogoria yachikire abanto nabasangi bande gosanga ase ebikaranso biechinkwana chia bonsi.
kiswahili: Ushiriki wa Umma na Ushiriki wa Wadau: Kwa mujibu wa Kifungu cha 10(2) cha Katiba ya Kenya, Wizara ya Barabara na Uchukuzi inawaalika wananchi na wadau kushiriki katika mijadala ya umma.
dholuo: Riwruok mar Oganda kod jokanyo: Kaluwore gi Sula mar apar (ariyo) mar Chik mar Kenya, Migao mar weche wuoth gwelo ji duto manie riwruok mar oganda kod jokanyo mondo oriwre e chenro moriwo oganda.
somali: Ka qaybgalka dadweynaha iyo ka qaybgalka daneeyayaasha: Sida ku cad qodobka 10 ((2) ee Dastuurka Kenya, Wasaaradda Wadooyinka iyo Gaadiidka waxay ku casuumaysaa xubnaha dadweynaha iyo daneeyayaasha inay ka qaybgalaan madasha dadweynaha.

english: Please be advised that the public notice circulating on social media is fake.
ekegusii: Bono manya buya nga amang'ana agoetananigwa na abanto ase abanto nayoborimo.
kiswahili: Tafadhali fahamu kwamba taarifa ya umma inayosambazwa kwenye mitandao ya kijamii ni bandia.
dholuo: Akwayo ni ung'e ni weche ma landore e mbui gin miriambo.
somali: Fadlan la ogeysii in ogeysiiska dadweynaha ee ku baahsan warbaahinta bulshada uu yahay mid been abuur ah.

english: By David Njaaga 1 month ago 'Ignore fraudulent notices': NPSC warns on fake police hiring advert The National Police Service Commission (NPSC) has warned against a fake recruitment notice for police constables circulating on social media.
ekegusii: Ase David Njaaga omotienyi oyomo oetire 'ombia amangana oborimo': NPSC kiarure ogokurerwa igoro yamangana buna porisi nkorika ere abanto buna ayobotimo. Ekeombe kiobokoreri bwa abasikari kiarure ogokurerwa ng'a amangana igoro yokorikwa kwa abasikari goetera eintneti nayoborimo.
kiswahili: Na David Njaaga mwezi 1 uliopita 'Puuza notisi za ulaghai': NPSC yaonya kuhusu tangazo bandia la kuajiri polisi Tume ya Kitaifa ya Huduma za Polisi (NPSC) imeonya dhidi ya notisi bandia ya kuajiri polisi inayosambaa kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.
dholuo: Kod David Njaaga dwe achiel mokalo 'Buon lipot mag wuondruok': NPSC chiwo siem kuom ripot mag miriambo mag ndikruok kamisen mar obila mar NPSC osechiwo siem kuom ripot mag wuondruok mag ndikruok mag polise ma landore e mbui.
somali: By David Njaaga 1 bil ka hor 'Ignore fraudulent notices': NPSC waxay ka digeysaa xayeysiis been abuur ah oo ku saabsan shaqaaleysiinta booliska Komishanka Adeegga Booliska Qaranka (NPSC) ayaa ka digay ogeysiis been abuur ah oo loogu talagalay shaqaaleysiinta booliiska oo ku baahsan warbaahinta bulshada.

english: Therefore, this move is part of a citywide cleaning exercise which has, so far, included orders requiring hawkers to vacate some of the CBD streets and business owners in the CBD to keep their premises clean and avoid loud systems disrupting the public, among others.
ekegusii: Ase igo, egetambokero eke nigo kere enchera eyemo yogosibia omochie o'nairobi oganetie nga baria bakooneria ebinto biabo isiko, ekaonti yanyorire ogwancherwa kobarusia chinsemo chiomochie gati bwetaoni (CBD) chinchera gati na abanyaduka bonsi kobeka obochenu ase ebiasara biabo na gotanga amariogi amanene yamatangaso yebiasra biabo atari kogokia abanto na ayande anga buna ayio.
kiswahili: Kwa hivyo, hatua hii ni sehemu ya zoezi la usafi wa jiji lote ambalo, hadi sasa, limejumuisha maagizo yanayowataka wachuuzi kuondoka katika baadhi ya mitaa ya CBD na wamiliki wa biashara katika CBD ili kuweka majengo yao safi na kuepuka mifumo ya kelele kuwasumbua umma, miongoni mwa mengine.
dholuo: Kuom mano, chenrono en achiel kuom chenro mar pwodho boma duto, ma nyaka sani oriwo chike ma dwaro ni joma uso e akek yore kod jo-ohala e chuny boma oket kuondegi mag tich obed maler kendo gitang' gi thum mamalo makiko winjruok ekind oganda, e kind mamoko.
somali: Sidaa darteed, tallaabadan waxay qayb ka tahay dhaqdhaqaaq nadaafadeed oo magaalada oo dhan ah oo illaa iyo hadda ka mid ahaa amarro looga baahan yahay in ganacsatada ay ka baxaan qaar ka mid ah jidadka CBD iyo milkiilayaasha ganacsiga ee CBD si ay u ilaaliyaan guryahooda nadiif ah oo ay uga fogaadaan nidaamyada dhawaaqa badan ee jahwareeraya dadweynaha, iyo waxyaabo kale.

english: County emergency response teams and security agencies remain on the ground, helping relocate displaced residents to safer areas and distributing food, blankets, and other essential supplies.
ekegusii: Bria batenerete abokonyi chingaki chiemebasekano bekaonti kobwaterana nabarendi boborendi nao bare, bagendererete korwa ogokonya ase baria bakonyanya korwa ase yemechando goetera embura enyinge na kobaa ogokonya kwendagera, ebinto biokorarera, nebinto binde biengencho.
kiswahili: Timu za kukabiliana na dharura za kaunti na mashirika ya usalama yanaendelea kufanya kazi, na kusaidia kuwahamisha wakazi waliokimbia makazi yao katika maeneo salama na kusambaza chakula, blanketi, na vifaa vingine muhimu.
dholuo: Timbe mag kaunti makonyo e masiche ma apoya kod machiwo arita pod tiyo mondo gikony joma odar odhi kuonde ma onge tuoche, kendo gichiw chiemo, lewni, kod gik mamoko madwarore.
somali: Kooxaha gargaarka degdegga ah ee degmada iyo hay'adaha amniga ayaa weli jooga goobta, iyagoo gacan ka geysanaya in dadka barakacayaasha ah ay u guuraan meelo aamin ah waxayna qaybiyaan cuntada, qashinada, iyo alaabada kale ee lagama maarmaanka u ah.

english: KeNHA assured the public that the projects will be implemented with transparency and accountability at every stage.
ekegusii: Abateneri bechipara chinene (KeNHA) baenekeirie abanto ng'a oborosia bwepara nigo borabe maiso marore nobotenereri obuya ase omoroberio bwensi.
kiswahili: KeNHA iliwahakikishia umma kwamba miradi hiyo itatekelezwa kwa uwazi na uwajibikaji katika kila hatua.
dholuo: Migawo mar weche wuoth e apaya KeNHA nosingo ne ji ni tijego ne idhi tim e yo maler kendo e yo mowinjore e okang' ka okang'.
somali: KeNHA waxay shacabka u xaqiijisay in mashaariicda la fulin doono si hufan iyo mas'uuliyad leh marxalad kasta.

english: by CHARLES MGHENYI Coast 07 November 2025 - 05:40 ADVERTISEMENT In Summary Ethekon urged Kenyans to help rebuild trust in the new IEBC, assuring that the commission has strengthened accountability systems, including robust voter identification and result transmission technology.
ekegusii: Goetera CHARLES MGHENYI Coast 07 omotienyi 11 2025 chinsa 11 nechitageka 40 OGOTANGAZA. Ase obweng'e Ethekon agasaba aba'Kenyans gokonya koirania obwegenwa ase abarai abayia baria bekeombe keria getenerete ogoaka chikura IEBC, na koenekia ng'a oboteneneri obwo oboyia bwabekire emeroberio yamaiso marore, amo na obokongoria bwegetabu bwa abaaki chikura bekeene bare ime yegatabu keria kebwate amarieta yabaaki chikura goetera etekinorochi.
kiswahili: na CHARLES MGHENYI Pwani 07 Novemba 2025 - 05:40 TANGAZO Kwa Muhtasari Ethekon aliwasihi Wakenya kusaidia kujenga upya imani katika IEBC mpya, akihakikisha kwamba tume imeimarisha mifumo ya uwajibikaji, ikiwa ni pamoja na utambuzi thabiti wa wapiga kura na teknolojia ya uwasilishaji wa matokeo.
dholuo: Kod Charles Mghenyi Coast tarik abiriyo dwe mar apar kod achiel higa mar alufu ariyo piero ariyo kod piero ario kod abich saa apar gic achiel gi dakika piero ang'wen Lendo E yo machuok Ethekon nokwayo Jo-Kenya mondo okony e gero yie kuom duol manyyien mar yiero mar IEBC , kendo mondo ging'e ni kamisen osemiyo chenro mag chiwo dwoko, moriwo koda ng'eyo joma oyiero kod lony manyasani mar lando duoko.
somali: by CHARLES MGHENYI Coast 07 November 2025 - 05:40 ADVERTISEMENT Marka la soo koobo Ethekon waxay ugu baaqday dadka Kenya inay ka caawiyaan dib u dhiska kalsoonida IEBC cusub, iyagoo xaqiijinaya in guddiga uu xoojiyay nidaamyada xisaabinta, oo ay ku jiraan aqoonsiga codbixiyayaasha adag iyo tikniyoolajiyadda gudbinta natiijooyinka.

english: Ethekon urged Kenyans to help rebuild trust in the new IEBC, assuring that the commission has strengthened accountability systems, including robust voter identification and result transmission technology.
ekegusii: Ethekon nasabete aba'Kenyansgokonya koagacha obwegenwa ase oborai oboyia bwekeombe keria getenerete goakia chikura (IEBC), koenekeria abakenya ng'a obotenereri bwabo bwkongirie obomaiso marore, amo nokomongera buna chikura korwa chisenta chigotomwa goetera tekinorochi.
kiswahili: Ethekon aliwasihi Wakenya kusaidia kujenga upya imani katika IEBC mpya, akihakikisha kwamba tume imeimarisha mifumo ya uwajibikaji, ikiwa ni pamoja na utambuzi thabiti wa wapiga kura na teknolojia ya uwasilishaji wa matokeo.
dholuo: Ethekon nojiwo Jo-Kenya mondo okony e gero yie e duol manyien mar yiero , IEBC , kendo nojiwo ni kamisen no osetego chenro mag yore maler moriwo koda ng'eyo joma oyiero kod lony ma nya sani mar chiwo duoko.
somali: Ethekon waxay ugu baaqday dadka Kenya inay gacan ka geystaan dib u dhiska kalsoonida IEBC cusub, waxayna xaqiijisay in guddiga uu xoojiyay nidaamyada xisaabinta, oo ay ku jiraan aqoonsiga codbixiyayaasha adag iyo tikniyoolajiyadda gudbinta natiijooyinka.

english: To ensure consistency in care, the report urges the Ministry of Health to make clinical guidelines accessible to all providers and to enforce postpartum monitoring standards through supervision and clinical audits.
ekegusii: Erio goikerania obuya na oboronge ase obobwenia, eripoti eye nigo yarwete ogosaba ng'a eminisitiri yobobwenia emnyie abakoreri baye emeroberio yobobwenia erio kobeka chinguru obomongeria bwomongina ekero aiboire ase okobamanyia abanyagitari abanene koenekia afia yomongina nomwana oye.
kiswahili: Ili kuhakikisha uthabiti katika huduma, ripoti hiyo inahimiza Wizara ya Afya kufanya miongozo ya kliniki ipatikane kwa watoa huduma wote na kutekeleza viwango vya ufuatiliaji baada ya kujifungua kupitia usimamizi na ukaguzi wa kliniki.
dholuo: Mondo arita maber omed nenore, lipodno jiwo migawo mar weche thieth mondo oket chike matayo weche thieth obed maler ne lakteche duto kendo one ni rang'iny mag thieth bang' nyuol onon kod nonro mag thieth.
somali: Si loo hubiyo iswaafajinta daryeelka, warbixinta ayaa ku boorineysa Wasaaradda Caafimaadka inay tilmaamaha bukaanka u dhigto mid la heli karo dhammaan bixiyeyaasha iyo inay hirgeliyaan heerarka kormeerka dhalmada kadib iyada oo loo marayo kormeerka iyo baaritaannada bukaanka.

english: Murkomen said the government also launched a toll-free hotline to enable the public to report abductions anonymously, ensuring confidentiality and encouraging information sharing.
ekegusii: Murkomen agateba nga eserikari nero yaansete omoroberio bwechisimi chiamorero gokonya abanto komanyia eserikari buna abanto bakobwatia nagotamigwa mamincha yerichikobatari kwemanyekani barabwo mbarabi,korenda obobisi na gosegeta okoerania amang'ana.
kiswahili: Murkomen alisema serikali pia ilizindua simu ya dharura ya bure ili kuwawezesha umma kuripoti utekaji nyara bila kujulikana, kuhakikisha usiri na kuhimiza ushiriki wa taarifa.

somali: 750 milyan oo doolar oo ah hantida mashruuca Thiba Dam ayaa loo wareejiyay Xukuumadda Gobolka Kirinyaga iyadoo Waiguru ay ballanqaadayso inay isbitaal ka dhigeyso Waiguru waxay taageertaa Xukuumadda Guud ee Madaxweyne Ruto, waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan inay iska caabinayaan hoggaamiyeyaasha kala qaybsanaanta ee Sagana Industrial City si ay u taageeraan beeraleyda, ay u abuuraan 150,000 oo shaqo, Waiguru ayaa sheegay in Ruto uu ballanqaaday inuu durbiyo Ksh.

english: He further pledged to work closely with Governor Timamy to foster unity in Lamu County, urging residents to shun divisive politics â '¬  especially those driven by tribal, religious, or regional differences â '¬  for the sake of progress.
ekegusii: Akagenderera korwa chiira chiogokora emeremo amo ase okobwaterana na nomogafana Timamy erio gokinia obomo aaria ekaonti ya Lamu, ogosorora abamenyi kwanga siasa yokobagana abanto mono kegima siasa erengete obogesaku, kebokanisa' keboisiramu, gose gose ogotaigwanana kerogongo erio goikerania amagenderero.
kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, aliahidi kufanya kazi kwa karibu na Gavana Timamy ili kukuza umoja katika Kaunti ya Lamu, akiwahimiza wakazi kuepuka siasa za mgawanyiko - hasa zile zinazoendeshwa na tofauti za kikabila, kidini, au kikanda - kwa ajili ya maendeleo.
dholuo: Ne omedo singore mar tiyo kanyachiel gi Gavana Timamy e jiwo winjruok e kaunti mar Lamu, kojiwo jogweng'no mondo owe siasa mag pogruok, to ahinya wuon jogo motenore gi pogruok mar oganda, din, kata alwora nikech dongruok.
somali: Wuxuu sidoo kale ballanqaaday inuu si dhow ula shaqeyn doono Guddoomiye Timamy si kor loogu qaado midnimada Gobolka Lamu, isagoo ku booriyay dadka deggan inay ka fogaadaan siyaasadda kala qaybsanaanta - gaar ahaan kuwa ay keenaan farqiga beelaha, diimaha, ama gobollada - si loo horumariyo.

english: The County Government of Mandera encourages all eligible youth to take advantage of this life-changing opportunity and contribute to the county's development.
ekegusii: Eserikari yekaonti ya Mandera yasegetire abasae bonsi bari bare nogwancherwa kobogoria ribaga eri riabeene goonchoreria obogima bwabo na gosegeta amagenderero yekaonti.
kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Mandera inawahimiza vijana wote wanaostahiki kutumia fursa hii inayobadilisha maisha na kuchangia katika maendeleo ya kaunti.
dholuo: Sirkal mar kaunti ma Mandera jiwo rowere duto mowinjore mondo oti gi thuolono e kelo lokruok e ngimagi kendo okonyo e dongruok mar kaunti no.
somali: Maamulka Degmada Mandera wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dhamaan dhalinyarada u qalma inay ka faa'iideystaan fursadan nolosha beddelaya oo ay gacan ka geystaan horumarinta degmada.

english: Speaking after the awards in Nairobi, today, CECM for Finance Jones Omwenga said the county will continue engaging the public in its decisions for impact.
ekegusii: Gokwana nyuma yokorwaebiigwa biobobui gose ogokora buya aaria Nairobi, rero, Omowasiri bwechibesa Jones Omwenga agateba ng'a ekaonti negenderere nechnkwana nabanainchi ase okorwa ebirengererio biamagenderero.
kiswahili: Akizungumza baada ya tuzo hizo jijini Nairobi, leo, CECM for Finance Jones Omwenga alisema kaunti itaendelea kuwashirikisha umma katika maamuzi yake ya athari.
dholuo: Kane owuoyo bang' yudo michgo Nairobi, kawuono CECM mar Pesa Jones Omwenga nowacho ni, kaunti no biro dhi nyime miyo ji duto thuolo mar ng'ado paro ewi gik ma biro timore kuom ber.
somali: Isagoo ka hadlayay abaalmarinta ka dib Nairobi, maanta, CECM for Finance Jones Omwenga ayaa sheegay in gobolka uu sii wadi doono inuu dadweynaha ku lug yeesho go'aamada saameynta.

english: ARTICLE 19 condemns Kenyan officials' use of violence and intimidation against students, the public, and journalists.
ekegusii: RICHIKO RIA 19 riairire bobe abobisa ba Kenya ase ogotumia eburaburu na kogosereria gochia ase abana besukuru, abanainchi, na abariki amang'ana.
kiswahili: KIFUNGU CHA 19 kinalaani matumizi ya vurugu na vitisho kwa maafisa wa Kenya dhidi ya wanafunzi, umma, na waandishi wa habari.
dholuo: "Sula apar kod ochiko kwero jotend Piny Kenya tiyo kod lweny kod ayany ewi jopuonjre, oganda, koda jofwambo kod keyo.
somali: QAYBTA 19 waxay cambaareysaa adeegsiga rabshadaha iyo cabsida ay mas'uuliyiinta Kenya u geystaan ardayda, dadweynaha, iyo suxufiyiinta.

english: 'ARTICLE 19 condemns Kenyan officials' use of violence and intimidation against students, the public, and journalists.
ekegusii: RICHIKO RIA 19 riairire bobe abobisa ba Kenya ase ogotumia eburaburu na kogosereria gochia ase abana besukuru, abanainchi, na abariki amang'ana.

english: We call on the policing authority to carry out immediate and transparent investigations into the actions, and for the government to be held accountable for its attempts to censor political commentary, artistic expression, and to block the public's access to information,' said Mugambi Kiai, Regional Director for ARTICLE 19 Eastern Africa.
ekegusii: Nigo togosaba abarai abarendi boborendi gochaka obotuki gotachererwa bwa maiso marore buna yabete, naigo eserikari kobogoria obobe bwonsi ase okomiga abanasiasa erio koboboi eki babwenerete gokwana, eki ababugi chingero babwenerete gotera, na gosiekera abanto gotaikera amang'ana,' buna atebete Mugambi Kiai, Omotenereri omonene bworogongo rwa Africa ya Mocha igoro YERICHIKO ARTICLE 19.
kiswahili: Tunatoa wito kwa mamlaka ya polisi kufanya uchunguzi wa haraka na wa uwazi kuhusu vitendo hivyo, na serikali iwajibike kwa majaribio yake ya kudhibiti maoni ya kisiasa, kujieleza kisanii, na kuzuia upatikanaji wa taarifa kwa umma,' alisema Mugambi Kiai, Mkurugenzi wa Kanda wa IBARA YA 19 Afrika Mashariki.
dholuo: Wakwayo sirkal maloso chiek mondo otim nonro mapiyo kendo e yo maler kuom gik ma ne otimorego, kendo sirkal mondo okaw okang ' mar chiko paro mag siasa, wuoyo e yor kisera, kendo geng'o ji kik obed gi weche mang'eny ma ginyalo winjo, ' Ugwe, Mugambi Kiai mar sula apar gi ochiko sirkal mar Africa ma Ugwe nowacho.
somali: Waxaan ugu baaqaynaa hay'adda booliiska inay fuliyaan baaritaano degdeg ah oo hufan oo ku saabsan tallaabooyinkaas, iyo in dowladda la xisaabtamo dadaallada ay ku tijaabiso faallooyinka siyaasadeed, muujinta farshaxanka, iyo xannibaadda helitaanka macluumaadka dadweynaha, "ayuu yiri Mugambi Kiai, Agaasimaha Gobolka ee ARTICLE 19 Bariga Afrika.

english: The government must facilitate people's right to protest, an important way for citizens to express themselves and participate in governance processes,' said Mugambi Kiai, ARTICLE 19 Eastern Africa Regional Director.
ekegusii: Eserikari goika erwe ribaga rioboronge bwabanto facilitate people's right to protest, an important way for citizens korwa ebirengererio biabo, koboria amaswari na goteba buna bategete ase obogambi bwabo,' buna atebete Mugambi Kiai, Omoteneneri Omonene bworogongo rwa Africa ya Mocha RICHIKO19.
kiswahili: Serikali lazima irahisishe haki ya watu ya kuandamana, njia muhimu kwa raia kujieleza na kushiriki katika michakato ya utawala,' alisema Mugambi Kiai, MAKALA YA 19 Mkurugenzi wa Kanda ya Afrika Mashariki.
dholuo: Mugambi Kiai, sula mar apar kod ochiko Jatelo machiko gwenge ma Afrika ma Ugwe nowacho kama: ' Sirkal onego okony ratiro mar ji mar dhi e ng'anyo, ma en yo maduong ' ma raia nyalo nyisogo ni gihero loch.
somali: "Dawladdu waa in ay fududeysaa xuquuqda dadka inay mudaaharaad sameeyaan, taas oo ah hab muhiim u ah muwaadiniinta inay ka hadlaan oo ay ka qaybqaataan geedi socodka maamulka", ayuu yiri Mugambi Kiai, Agaasimaha Gobolka ee ARTICLE 19 Bariga Afrika.

english: Accident Investigation and WIBA Processing When an accident occurs, and an employee is injured, the employer must report to DOSHS County offices within 24 hours if the accident is fatal, and within 7 days for non-fatal accidents.
ekegusii: Obotuki bwomwbasekano na na buna abanto bemebasekano bagoakanwa (WIBA) ekero emebasekano yabeire, na abakori emeremo baumiire, omotachiri goika amanyie chiofisi chiekaonti chitenerete oborendi bwango kegima (DOSHS) gati yechinsa 24 onye omobasekano ore omonene, na gati yamatuko 7 ase omobasekano emesinini.
kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa Ajali na Usindikaji wa WIBA Wakati ajali inatokea, na mfanyakazi akaumia, mwajiri lazima aripoti kwa ofisi za Kaunti ya DOSHS ndani ya saa 24 ikiwa ajali hiyo ni mbaya, na ndani ya siku 7 kwa ajali zisizo mbaya.
dholuo: Nonro mar masich apaya kod chenro mar WIBA e kinde ma masich apaya otimore, kendo jatich oyudo hinyruok, jatelo onego ochiw ripot ne apise mar kaunti mar DOSHS motelo ne seche piero ariyo kod ang'wen ka masira no rach ahinya kendo motelo ne ndalo abiriyo ka masich apaya no ok lich ahinya.
somali: Cilmi-baarista shilalka iyo ka baaraandegista WIBA Haddii shil dhaco, shaqaaluhuna dhaawacmay, shaqo-bixiyuhu waa inuu 24 saacadood gudahood u soo sheegaa xafiisyada Gobolka DOSHS haddii shilku yahay mid dhimasho leh, iyo 7 maalmood gudahood shilalka aan dhimasho lahayn.

english: Different electoral bodies in Kenya, from ECK, IIEC, to IEBC, have had a topsy-turvy trust relationship with the public.
ekegusii: Chinsemo ao ao chiobochori aiga Kenya, korwa ekeombe kiobochori gia Kenya (ECK), Ekomiti Yengaki Enke Yobochori (IIEC), goika eke kiabono gekorokwa Ekeombe Gietenererete Kiemepaka yobochori gia Kenya (IEBC), biabeire noboate botari obuya nabanainchi.
kiswahili: Miili tofauti ya uchaguzi nchini Kenya, kuanzia ECK, IIEC, hadi IEBC, imekuwa na uhusiano wa uaminifu na umma usio na matumaini.
dholuo: E piny Kenya, riwruoge mopogore opogore mag yiero, chakre ECK, IIEC, nyaka IEBC, osebedo gi winjruok maber gi ji.
somali: Hay'adaha doorashada ee kala duwan ee Kenya, laga bilaabo ECK, IIEC, ilaa IEBC, waxay lahaayeen xiriir kalsooni oo aad u adag dadweynaha.

english: The NSSF Anti-corruption Authority provides an avenue for the public to report acts of corruption and/or fraud within its programs and operations.
ekegusii: Abateneneri bekeombe keria gokorwania obokorekanu bechibesa chiobogotu (NSSF) nkorwa bare ribaga buna abanainchi babwenerete gokemanyia igoro yobokorekanu bakoumera ime yomoroberio oyo nobokoreri bwaye.
kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kupambana na Rushwa ya NSSF hutoa njia kwa umma kuripoti vitendo vya rushwa na/au ulaghai ndani ya programu na shughuli zake.
dholuo: Riwruok mar NSSF ma kedo gi mibadhi chiwo thuolo ne ji mondo ochwal lipode motendore kod timbe mag mibadhi kod /kata ma ok ber e chenrone kod timbene.
somali: Hay'adda la dagaalanka musuqmaasuqa ee NSSF waxay dadweynaha u siineysaa fursad ay ku soo wargeliyaan falalka musuqmaasuqa iyo/ama khiyaanada barnaamijyada iyo howlaheeda.

english: The committee is required to facilitate public participation and to take into account the views of the public when it makes its report to the Senate.

dholuo: Komiti no idwaro mondo omi ji duto obed gi thuolo mar wuoyo e wi wachno kendo mondo oket pachgi kuom paro ma ji nigo sama gichiwo ripode ne buche mag od buch senet.

ekegusii: Ekomiti nkoarigania ere chinkwana, konyora ebirengererio bia abanto igoro yerichiko na korosia eripoti ase chingaki chiria chibekire abwo igoro.
kiswahili: Kamati hutekeleza ushiriki wa umma, hupata maoni ya umma kuhusu Muswada na huandaa ripoti ndani ya kipindi kilichoainishwa hapo juu.
dholuo: Komitino timo ga chenro moriwo oganda duto, kawo paro mag oganda ewi chik kod loso lipot e kinde mowinjore malo kanyo.

english: By 4 months ago State wants Angata Barikkoi residents to register land leases The government now wants communities residing in the troubled Angata Barikkoi area in Trans Mara to formally register land leases with the Land Registrar to avoid conflicts.
ekegusii: Nyuma yamatuko yemetienyi enne èserekari yaganirie abamenyi ba'Angata barikoi kwerikia buna abanyene bemegondo. eserekari bono yaganirie abamenyi ase ensemo eyuo yabeire ebwateranirie nechisegi namariomana yamaremo korikia amaremo abo bene ase omoriki omonene bwqmaremo asenensemo eyuo erio gwetanga namariomana yamaremo.
kiswahili: Kufikia miezi 4 iliyopita Serikali yawataka wakazi wa Angata Barikkoi kusajili ukodishaji wa ardhi Serikali sasa inataka jamii zinazoishi katika eneo lenye matatizo la Angata Barikkoi huko Trans Mara kusajili rasmi ukodishaji wa ardhi kwa Msajili wa Ardhi ili kuepuka migogoro.
dholuo: E bwo dweche ang'wen mosekalo, sirkal mamalo ne dwaro ni jodak e taon mar Angata Barikkoi oket nyinggi e kad mar lowo. Sirkandno sani dwaro ni joma odak e alwora mar Angata Barikkoi e Trans Mara oket nyinggi e kad mar lowo kod jandik lowo mondo kik gibed gi ywaruok.
somali: 4 bilood ka hor dawladdu waxay rabtaa dadka deggan Angata Barikkoi inay diiwaangeliyaan qandaraasyada kireysiga dhulka Dowladdu waxay hadda rabtaa in bulshooyinka ku nool deegaanka Angata Barikkoi ee Trans Mara ay si rasmi ah ugu diiwaangeliyaan qandaraasyada kireysiga dhulka diiwaangelinta dhulka si looga fogaado khilaafaadka.

english: By 3 months ago KWS concludes public consultations on new park fees The public input process will culminate this Friday with a national validation forum at the Kenyatta International Convention Centre (KICC) in Nairobi.
ekegusii: Ase emetienyi 3 yaetire ekeombe keria getenenerete chingiti chiorosana (KWS) ngiakorete chinkwana chiaye igoro yekerengo ekeyia giechibesa chiogotenenia chigari aroro. Omoroberio oyo bwokonyora ebirengererio korwa ase abanto noike omoerio oye rituko ria chuma ewiki eye nakobwatigwa nokoenekigwa kwaye aaria Nairobi enyomba yemesangerekano ya Kenyatta International Convention Centre (KICC).

english: By 3 months ago Tanzanian women married to Kenyans to now receive national IDs The government has started the process of documenting Tanzanian women married to Kenyan men in Taita Taveta County.
ekegusii: Ase emetienyi 3 yaetire omokungu o'Tanzanian onywomire nomo'Kenya bono konyora ekebande gia Kenya. Eserikari yaansire omoroberio bwokorika omokungu o'Tanzanian onywomire nomosacha omo'Kenya aaria ekaonti ya Taita Taveta.

ekegusii: EACC yaboririe abakenya kuripoti obokurumi bonde bwonsi binyare gotukwa
kiswahili: EACC inawasihi Wakenya kuripoti aina zote za ufisadi kwa ajili ya uchunguzi.
dholuo: EACC jiwo Jo-Kenya mondo ochiw ripot e wi kit mibadhi duto.
somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka Kenya inay soo sheegaan dhammaan noocyada musuqmaasuqa si baaritaan loogu sameeyo.

english: The Commission urges all agencies involved in the issuance of National Identity cards to fast-track the issuance and distribution of the IDs to enable Kenyans who have attained the age of 18 to be registered as voters.
ekegusii: Orosagia rwa eserekali yasegetire chinsemo chionsi chigosanga ase okorwegwa kwa ebipande na koenanwa bwango erio abakenya baikire emiaka 18 berikie buna abaaki chikura
kiswahili: Tume inazihimiza mashirika yote yanayohusika katika utoaji wa vitambulisho vya kitaifa kuharakisha utoaji na usambazaji wa vitambulisho hivyo ili kuwawezesha Wakenya waliofikisha umri wa miaka 18 kusajiliwa kama wapiga kura.
dholuo: Kamisen jiwo riwruoge duto motudore gi chiwo opande mondo otim kinda mapiyo e chiwo kod pogo opande mondo omi Jo-Kenya ma osetieko higni apar kod aboro ondiki kaka jogo ombulu.
somali: Guddiga ayaa ku boorinaya dhammaan hay'adaha ku lug leh soo saarista kaararka aqoonsiga qaranka inay si dhakhso leh ula socdaan soo saarista iyo qaybinta aqoonsiga si ay u oggolaadaan dadka Kenya ee gaadhay da'da 18 sano inay u diiwaangeliyaan sida codbixiyeyaasha.

english: EACC urges every Kenyan to always uphold integrity and proactively participate in the fight against corruption.
ekegusii: EACC yakureire abakenya batware chiumbu chingiya na korwani obokurumi kengima
kiswahili: EACC inamsihi kila Mkenya kudumisha uadilifu na kushiriki kikamilifu katika vita dhidi ya ufisadi.
dholuo: EACC jiwo ji duto manie piny Kenya mondo omak tim makare kendo okonygi kedo gi mibadhi.
somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo reer Kenya ah inuu had iyo jeer ilaaliyo daacadnimada iyo inuu si firfircoon uga qaybqaato la dagaalanka musuqmaasuqa.

english: YOUR ROLE AS A CITIZEN 1. Shun corruption, do not tolerate or support it 2. Report any suspected corrupt conduct 3. Desist from glorifying corruptly acquired wealth. 5. Demand accountability from leaders 6. Return any stolen public property in your possession 7. Obey the law
ekegusii: Emeremo yago buna omomenyi 1 Bwange obokurumi, toremerwria gose gwancha obokurumi 2
kiswahili: JUKUMU LAKO KAMA RAIA 1. Epuka ufisadi, usivumilie au kuuunga mkono 2. Ripoti mwenendo wowote unaoshukiwa wa ufisadi 3. Epuka kusifu utajiri uliopatikana kwa ufisadi. 5. Dai uwajibikaji kutoka kwa viongozi 6. Rudisha mali yoyote ya umma iliyoibiwa uliyonayo 7. Tii sheria
dholuo: Ting' ma in-go kaka raia mokwongo. We timbe mag mibadhi, geng'gi, kata riwogi lwedo. mar airyo . Land timbe duto mag mibadhi. mar adek. We miyo mwandu ma ji yudo nikech mibadhi duong'. mar abich. Chiko jotelo mondo gikonygi. mar auchiel. Duoko mwandu duto mag sirkal ma in-go. mar abiriyo. Luwo Chik
somali: 1. Ka fogow musuqmaasuqa, ha u dulqaadanina ama ha u taageerinina. 2. Warbixi wax kasta oo lagu tuhmo in musuqmaasuq lagu sameeyay. 3. Iska daaya in aad ammaanto hantida musuqmaasuq lagu helay. 5. Madaxda ka codso xisaabinta. 6. Soo celi hantida dawladda ee lagaa xaday. 7. Xeerka addeeca.

english: (EACC) urges Kenyans to be vigilant and avoid falling prey to fraudsters issuing fake integrity clearance letters at a fee
ekegusii: EACC yasegetire abakenya koba maiso na gwetanga korwa abakurumi bakorwa amauko yoborimo ase ebesa
kiswahili: (EACC) inawahimiza Wakenya kuwa macho na kuepuka kunaswa na matapeli wanaotoa barua bandia za uadilifu kwa ada
dholuo: IECC jiwo jokenya mondo obed motang' kendo kik giyudre kod achudhe machiwo kad ma adiera kuom kawo omenda.
somali: (EACC) waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka Kenya inay feejignaadaan oo ay ka fogaadaan inay noqdaan dhibanayaasha khiyaanooyinka soo saara waraaqaha saxda ah ee loo yaqaan 'integrity clearance letters' oo lacag lagu bixiyo

english: IEBCKenya urges eligible diaspora voters in USA, Germany, South Africa, Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi & South Sudan to come out & register before Feb 4 deadline
ekegusii: IEBC yarure okoraria inga abakenya bonsi bare maiko buna USA, Bocheremani, Afrika ya Irianyi, Tanzania, Boganda, Rwanda, Burundi na Irianyi ya Sudan besokie na koerikia nyuma ya chitariki 4 omotienyi okabere chitaraika
kiswahili: IEBCKenya yawahimiza wapiga kura wanaostahiki kutoka nje ya nchi nchini Marekani, Ujerumani, Afrika Kusini, Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi na Sudan Kusini kujitokeza na kujiandikisha kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya Februari 4.
dholuo: Duol mar yiero mar IEBC e piny Kenya ojiwo jotelo mag pinje mag Amerka, Germany, Afrika ma milambo , Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi kod South Sudan mondo owuog e pinyno kapok tarik ang'wen dwe mar ariyo ochopo .
somali: IEBCKenya waxay ku boorineysaa codbixiyayaasha u qalma dibadda ee ku nool Mareykanka, Jarmalka, Koonfur Afrika, Tansaaniya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi & South Sudan inay soo baxaan oo ay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor 4da Febraayo.

english: IEBCKenya urges citizens who are not registered but are eligible to take advantage of this last week to enlist as voters
ekegusii: IEBC yaboririe abakenya batarareikia, koira ribaga eri riabene koerikia
kiswahili: IEBCKenya inawasihi raia ambao hawajajiandikisha lakini wanastahili kutumia fursa ya wiki hii iliyopita kujiandikisha kama wapiga kura
dholuo: Duol mar yiero e piny kenya jiwo ji duto ma ok osendikore kaka jogo ombulu mondo okaw thuolo mar juma mogik mar ndiko nyinggi kaka jogo ombulu.
somali: IEBCKenya waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta aan diiwaangelin laakiin xaq u leh inay ka faa'iideystaan todobaadkii la soo dhaafay si ay u diiwaangeliyaan codbixiyayaasha

english: IEBCKenya urges voters, candidates and agents to maintain order at polling stations and avoid wearing or carrying campaign materials
ekegusii: IEBC yakureire abaaki chikura,abachore na abaechenti korenda amarago na obotoereru ase ebitaseni biogwaka chikura na betange ase okobeka chiyaga chiechikampeni gose ebinyererio biechikampeni
kiswahili: IEBCKenya inawasihi wapiga kura, wagombea na mawakala kudumisha utulivu katika vituo vya kupigia kura na kuepuka kuvaa au kubeba vifaa vya kampeni
dholuo: Duol mar yiero e piny kenye jiwo jogo ombulu, joslar kombe kod jochung' mondo oket arita kwe e kuonde goyo ombulu kendo kik girwak kata ting'o gige kampen
somali: IEBCKenya waxay codbixiyayaasha, musharixiinta iyo wakiillada ku boorineysaa in ay nidaamka ka ilaaliyaan goobaha codbixinta isla markaana ay ka fogaadaan inay xirtaan ama qaataan qalabka ololaha

english: IEBC urges citizens to unconditionally embrace peaceful elections & shun violence that is retrogressive to our economic growth and social cohesion.
ekegusii: IEBC yaboririe abamenyi gochika gotaiyo ase okorenda omorembe ase chikura na koanga chiburaburu echio chigotoirani magega keboncjoreri na okoigwanana ase ebinyoro
kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi raia kukumbatia uchaguzi wa amani bila masharti na kuepuka vurugu ambazo zinarudisha nyuma ukuaji wetu wa uchumi na mshikamano wa kijamii.
dholuo: Duol mar yiero e piny kenya jiwo raia mondo orwak yiero mar kwe maonge chik kendo gitang' gi timbe mahundu ma nyalo thiro dongruok mar ohala kod winjruok e kind oganda.
somali: IEBC waxay muwaadiniinta ugu baaqeysaa inay si shuruud la'aan ah u aqbalaan doorashooyinka nabadeed & ka fogaadaan rabshadaha ka soo horjeeda koritaanka dhaqaalaha iyo isdhexgalka bulshada.

english: EACC urges all professional bodies in the country to infuse integrity and accountability in their self-regulatory mechanisms to enhance corruption intolerance among Kenyan professionals
ekegusii: EACC yaboririe chinsagia chionsi chiobokoreri gosangia chiumbu chingiya na oboasioku ase ogwekorerana erio gokanya obokurumi ase abasomu ba Kenya
kiswahili: EACC inazihimiza taasisi zote za kitaaluma nchini kuingiza uadilifu na uwajibikaji katika mifumo yao ya kujidhibiti ili kuongeza uvumilivu wa ufisadi miongoni mwa wataalamu wa Kenya.
dholuo: EACC jiwo jolony duto e pinyno mondo otim gik moko e yo makare kendo e yo mowinjore mondo omi joma olony e Kenya obed gi chuny mar tiyo maonge gi mibadhi
somali: EACC waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhamaan hay'adaha xirfadeed ee dalka inay daacadnimo iyo mas'uuliyad ku darsadaan nidaamyadooda is-xakamaynta si kor loogu qaado dulqaadka musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhexeeya xirfadlayaasha Kenya

english: The Commission urges Machakos voters to turn out & exercise their democratic right
ekegusii: Ekeombe ekio giasegetire abaaki chikura Machakos gocha ase obonge kobwatia obosibore bwabo bwerichiko
kiswahili: Tume yawahimiza wapiga kura wa Machakos kujitokeza na kutumia haki yao ya kidemokrasia
dholuo: Kamisen'no dwaro ni josiasa ma Machakos owuog oko kendo giti gi ratiro ma gin-go mar timo yiero.
somali: Guddiga ayaa ugu baaqay codbixiyayaasha Machakos inay soo baxaan oo ay adeegsadaan xuquuqdooda dimuqraadiga ah

english: The registrar @ORPPKenya, Anne Nderitu urges parliament to fast track the enactment of election-related legislation. Late enactments negatively affect the planning of elections.
ekegusii: Omoriki oyo Orosagia bwe,Biombe bia siasa [ORPP], Anne Nderitu obooriri ekegambiro gie' bunge kobwatia bwango obokoreri bwa'amachiko yobochori na korara ngokare emeremo Ababunge baise konyoria amachiko ayi, nabo aratebania emeroberio emiya ya' obochori
kiswahili: Msajili @ORPPKenya, Anne Nderitu anahimiza bunge kuharakisha utekelezaji wa sheria zinazohusiana na uchaguzi. Kupitishwa kwa sheria kuchelewa kunaathiri vibaya upangaji wa uchaguzi.
dholuo: Anne Nderitu, ma en jagoro mar @orppkenya, jiwo Bura mondo orit mapiyo kaka chike motudore gi yiero tiyo. Keto chike modeko thiro chenro mag yiero.
somali: Diiwaanka @ORPPKenya, Anne Nderitu waxay Baarlamaanka ugu baaqeysaa inay si dhakhso leh ula socdaan ansixinta sharciyada la xiriira doorashooyinka.

english: NGECKenya representative Winnie Wambua calls for collaboration & asks participants to work together to ensure violence does not impede women from vying for political seats & urges participants to start a campaign to have men support women secure positions of leadership
ekegusii: Omorai o'NGEC Kenya, Winnie Wambua obooriria okobwaterana na kobooria emeremo yobwamo, eburaburu tetanga abangina tibaboria amabaga asiasa na gosegeta abasacha bae okoboko abasubati bokoboria ebirogo bia' siasa
kiswahili: Mwakilishi wa NGECKenya Winnie Wambua atoa wito wa ushirikiano na kuwaomba washiriki kufanya kazi pamoja ili kuhakikisha vurugu hazizuii wanawake kugombea viti vya kisiasa na kuwahimiza washiriki kuanzisha kampeni ili wanaume wawaunge mkono wanawake kupata nafasi za uongozi.
dholuo: Jachung' mar NGECKenya, Winnie Wambua, ogwelo ji duto mondo oriwre lwedo mondo timbe mahundu kik geng' mon kik donj e loch mag siasa kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo ochak kampen mar konyo chwo mondo oriw lwedo mon e migepe mag telo.
somali: Wakiilka NGOECKenya Winnie Wambua waxay ku baaqeysaa wada shaqeyn & waxay ka codsaneysaa ka qaybgalayaasha inay wada shaqeeyaan si loo hubiyo in rabshaduhu aysan ka hortagin haweenka inay ku tartamaan kuraasta siyaasadda & waxay ka codsaneysaa ka qaybgalayaasha inay bilaabaan olole ay raggu ku taageeraan haweenka si ay u helaan jagooyin hoggaamineed oo ammaan ah

english: Canada wishes IEBC success in #ECVR2021, urges citizens to register as their vote matters.
ekegusii: Canada yaganeirie IEBC chingaki chingiya ase obokoreri bwaye #ECRV2021, ni koa omoyo abaaki chikura berike ekiagera chikura chiabo nechi' engecho enene
kiswahili: Kanada inaitakia IEBC mafanikio katika #ECVR2021, inawasihi raia kujiandikisha kwani kura zao ni muhimu.
dholuo: Kanada dwaro ni IEBC otim dongruok e #ECVR2021, dwaro ni ji duto odonjre kaka joma biro goyo ombulu nikech ombuchgi en gima duong ahinya.
somali: Kanada waxay u rajeyneysaa IEBC guul #ECVR2021, waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta inay isdiiwaangaliyaan sida codkooda ay muhiim u tahay.

english: The Commission Chairman Wafula Chebukati urges Faith Based Organizations to have a collective responsibility to ensure we have a peaceful free and fair election in August 2022.
ekegusii: Omonyakerogo bw'obochori Wafula Chebukati obooririe ebiombe bia abegeni koba riboa erimo koeneki chikura nchire nomorembe, chiobosibore na chiancheranete omotienyi ogatano na gatato 2022
kiswahili: Mwenyekiti wa Tume Wafula Chebukati anahimiza Mashirika ya Kidini kuwa na jukumu la pamoja la kuhakikisha tuna uchaguzi huru na wa haki wa amani mwezi Agosti 2022.
dholuo: Jakom mar Komiti miluongo ni Wafula Chebukati, jiwo riwruok mar dinde mondo obed gi ting ' mar neno ni yiero e dwe mar Aboro higa mar alufu ariyo piero ariyo kod ariyo otim e yo ma ayanga.
somali: Guddoomiyaha guddiga Wafula Chebukati wuxuu ugu baaqay ururada ku saleysan iimaanka inay lahaadaan mas'uuliyad wadajir ah si loo hubiyo inaan helno doorasho nabadeed oo xor ah oo cadaalad ah bisha Agoosto 2022.

english: Evans Misati, Chairperson of Political Parties Liaison Committee (PPLC) National Steering Committee urges PWDs to register as members of political parties to claim their rightful share in national representation
ekegusii: Evans Misati, Omonyakerogo bwe' komiti yebiama bia siasa orongo rwa Kenya, obooririe abanto bare noboremaru koira ribaga riabo ria bene ase okoraagwa
kiswahili: Evans Misati, Mwenyekiti wa Kamati ya Uongozi ya Kitaifa ya Kamati ya Uhusiano ya Vyama vya Siasa (PPLC) anawasihi watu wenye ulemavu kujiandikisha kama wanachama wa vyama vya siasa ili kudai sehemu yao halali katika uwakilishi wa kitaifa.
dholuo: Evans Misati, ma en jakom mar Komiti mar Riwruok mar duond od buche (PPLC) komiti matayo sirkal mamalo jiwo PWDs mondo odonjre kaka jokanyo mag riwruoge mag siasa mondo giyud migawo mowinjore mar bedo jokanyo mag pinje
somali: Evans Misati, Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Xiriirka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed (PPLC) Guddiga Hogaaminta Qaranka ayaa ku booriyay dadka PWD inay iska diiwaangeliyaan xubnaha xisbiyada siyaasadeed si ay u codsadaan saamigooda sharciga ah ee wakiilka qaranka

english: Commissioner Cherera urges women to mobilise and bring out those not registered to enlist as voters
ekegusii: Omokomishona Cherera oboririe abangina gocha amo na koerikia buna abaaki chikura
kiswahili: Kamishna Cherera awahimiza wanawake kuhamasisha na kuwaleta nje wale ambao hawajajiandikisha kujiandikisha kama wapiga kura
dholuo: kamisona Cherera jiwo wakeini mondo ojiw kendo ochiw joma pok ondikre kaka joma biro yiero.
somali: Guddoomiye Cherera wuxuu ku booriyay haweenka in ay soo uruuriyaan oo ay soo saaraan kuwa aan diiwaangashanayn si ay u diiwaangeliyaan codbixiyeyaasha

english: In the meantime, KRA urges all the patriotic citizens of Kenya to stand with the Government, especially during this difficult and unprecedented time.
ekegusii: Ase ebiro ebioebio, KRA yakureire abakenya bare nogwancha okuya gotenena neserekari, ase chingaki echi chitamanyereire
kiswahili: Wakati huo huo, KRA inawasihi raia wote wazalendo wa Kenya kusimama na Serikali, hasa wakati huu mgumu na usio wa kawaida.
dholuo: E kindeno bende, KRA jiwo raia duto mag Kenya mondo ochung ' kor sirkal, to moloyo e kinde matekni.
somali: Dhanka kale, KRA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhammaan muwaadiniinta wadaniyiinta ah ee Kenya inay taageeraan dowladda, gaar ahaan xilligan adag oo aan hore loo arag.

english: Commissioner Francis Wanderi urges media, in the spirit of transparency, to send staff in all polling station to report results as declared by Presiding & Returning Officers.
ekegusii: Omokomishona Francis Wanderi obooririe abariki bamangana, ase omoyo bwoboasioku, gotoma abakoreri ase kera egetaseni gia chikura, korwa chiropoti buna chikura chikorarigwa na abobisa batenerete chikura
kiswahili: Kamishna Francis Wanderi anahimiza vyombo vya habari, kwa roho ya uwazi, kutuma wafanyakazi katika vituo vyote vya kupigia kura kuripoti matokeo kama yalivyotangazwa na Wasimamizi na Maafisa wa Kurudi.
dholuo: kamisona Francis Wanderi jiwo jofwambo e chuny mar ler e tich mondo oor jotich e kombe duto mag yiero mondo ochiw ripode kaka ne oland gi jotelo mochung' ne lendo mag yiero.
somali: Guddoomiye Francis Wanderi wuxuu warbaahinta ugu baaqayaa inay si hufan u dirto shaqaale dhammaan goobaha codbixinta si ay u soo sheegaan natiijooyinka sida ay ku dhawaaqeen madaxweyneyaasha iyo saraakiisha soo celinta.

english: Director SCM, Harley Mutisya urges suppliers and service providers to communicate with accuracy on any issues that may hinder their ability to deliver on time to IEBCKenya
ekegusii: Omorai omonene oyo SCM Harley Mutisya obooririe abaereri na obokreri goteba kengima gose bokongu bonde mborabeo boratange chinguru chiabo tibaikerani ase IEBC kenya
kiswahili: Mkurugenzi SCM, Harley Mutisya anawasihi wasambazaji na watoa huduma kuwasiliana kwa usahihi kuhusu masuala yoyote ambayo yanaweza kuzuia uwezo wao wa kuwasilisha kwa wakati kwa IEBCKenya.
dholuo: Jatend SCM, Harley Mutisya ojiwo jouso kod jochiw mwandu mondo owuo e yo makare e wi weche duto manyalo monogi chwalo mwandu e kinde mowinjore ne duol mar yiero e piny kenya.
somali: Agaasimaha SCM, Harley Mutisya wuxuu ku boorinayaa alaab-qeybiyeyaasha iyo bixiyeyaasha adeegyada inay si sax ah ula xiriiraan arrimaha kasta oo caqabad ku noqon kara awooda ay ku gaarsiiyaan IEBCKenya waqtigeeda

english: The Commission urges voters, candidates and agents to maintain order at all polling stations, avoid wearing or carrying campaign materials and to avoid campaigning while on the queue #October14thBy-elections.
ekegusii: Ekomishoni yaboririe abaaki chikura, abarai bakobori oborai na abaechenti babeke omochoko ase ebitaseni biobochori naende gokora chikampeni ase omorobiri #Omotienyi o'ikomi 14 chikura chinke
kiswahili: Tume inawasihi wapiga kura, wagombea na mawakala kudumisha utulivu katika vituo vyote vya kupigia kura, kuepuka kuvaa au kubeba vifaa vya kampeni na kuepuka kufanya kampeni wakiwa kwenye foleni #UchaguziMdogo wa Oktoba14.
dholuo: Komisenano jiwo jogo ombulu,joland kombe kod jochung' mondo orit kwe e kuonde duto mag goyo ombulu , kik girwak kata ting'o gige kampen kendo kik girwak gige kampen ka gin e opara mar yiero #Oktoba14th By elections.
somali: Komishanku wuxuu codbixiyayaasha, musharixiinta iyo wakiillada ku boorinayaa inay nidaamka ku ilaaliyaan dhammaan goobaha codbixinta, ka fogaadaan inay xirtaan ama qaataan qalabka ololaha iyo inay ka fogaadaan ololaha inta ay safka ku jiraan doorashada #October14thBy.

english: Did you know? That you can apply for special number plates? Apply online via the serviceportal.ntsa.go.ke
ekegusii: Nkwamanyete? Nosabe enamba yabene? Saba ase intaneti ntsa
kiswahili: Je, unajua? Kwamba unaweza kuomba nambari maalum za simu? Tuma maombi mtandaoni kupitia serviceportal.ntsa.go.ke
dholuo: Be ing'eyo ni inyalo kwayo mondo omiyi plede makenda ? kwa e mbui kokalo kuom tond mbui mar serviceportal.ntsa.go.ke
somali: Ma ogtahay in aad codsan karto lambarrada gaarka ah? Codso khadka tooska ah adigoo adeegsanaya bogga adeegga.ntsa.go.ke

english: Returning Officer for the Nguu/Masumba County Assembly Ward (CAW) by-election Moureen Kerebi Oyaro urges voters and media to observe Covid-19 protocol.
ekegusii: Omobisa bwe'chikura Nguu/Masumba chikura chinke Moreen Kerebi Oyaro obooriri abaaki chikura na abariki amangana kobwatia amarago a korona
kiswahili: Afisa Msimamizi wa Uchaguzi mdogo wa Wadi ya Bunge la Kaunti ya Nguu/Masumba (CAW) Moureen Kerebi Oyaro anawasihi wapiga kura na vyombo vya habari kuzingatia itifaki ya Covid-19.
dholuo: Apisa mochung'ne yiero maduondo Nguu/ e wod mar Kaunti mar Masumba Moureen Kerebi Oyaro, kwayo jogo ombulu mondo oluw chik mar tuo mar Covid-19.
somali: Sarkaalka soo noqnoqda ee doorashada gaarka ah ee Nguu/Masumba County Assembly Ward (CAW) Moureen Kerebi Oyaro wuxuu codbixiyayaasha iyo warbaahinta ku boorinayaa inay u hoggaansamaan borotokoolka COVID-19.

english: IEBCKenya Chairman Wafula Chebukati urges PWDs to walk with the Commission in its onward march to a stronger democracy & reiterates IEBC s commitment in delivering a free, fair and credible 2022 General Election that meets the democratic aspirations of Kenyan citizens
ekegusii: Omonyakerogo o'IEBC Wafula Chebukati obooriri abaremaru gotara amo koeneki obochori bwobosibore, obuya, bokoegeneka 2022 chikura chinene, echio chikogenda na amagani ya abanto bonsi
kiswahili: Mwenyekiti wa IEBCKenya Wafula Chebukati anawasihi watu wenye ulemavu kutembea na Tume katika harakati zake za kuelekea demokrasia imara na kusisitiza kujitolea kwa IEBC katika kutoa Uchaguzi Mkuu wa 2022 ulio huru, wa haki na wa kuaminika unaokidhi matarajio ya kidemokrasia ya raia wa Kenya.
dholuo: Jakom mar duol mar yiero e kenya IEBC Wafula Chebukati ojiwo PWDs mondo owuoth gi Komison e dhi nyime gi loch mar demokrasi motegno kendo ochiwore mar neno ni yiero ma ayanga kod yiero ma higa mar alufu ariyokod piero ariyo gi ariyo ochopo ratiro mar jopiny Kenya.
